plot: A hijacked passenger plane has only 97 minutes of fuel left before it crashes. As officials consider destroying it to prevent a catastrophe on the ground, an alleged hijacker and undercover agent becomes the passengers’ best hope for survival.

title: Mujer Perversa
plot: Victoria, an intrepid Latina in a cartel world, falls in love with her bodyguard and stepsister, leading to a risky love triangle. In the midst of the dangerous world of drug trafficking, he must make difficult decisions to survive.

title: Lily Darling
plot: It's 2006, and the most important things in Darling's life are skinny jeans, black eyeliner, and punk rock music. When the shy and mysterious Ollie catches her eye at a bus stop, the two teens form a bond that makes Darling question her rocky relationship with a troublesome older boy.

title: Custody
plot: A police officer is assigned to escort a witness to court, but discovers that members of the police service are determined to eliminate him. As danger closes in, the officer and witness begin a desperate escape while facing threats, pursuit, and shifting loyalties.

title: I Want to Jump
plot: A teenager overwhelmed by intrusive thoughts tells friends he wants to end his life, sending shockwaves through his family. As his parents struggle to help him and navigate care, they face fear, misunderstanding, and strain in their marriage while their community wrestles with how to respond.

title: The Story of Nintendo
plot: Over 133 years in the making, from humble beginnings manufacturing 'Hanufuda' cards came one of the world's most recognized videogame companies, from the birth of Mario and Luigi to Donkey Kong and Zelda... to beating its competition and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

title: Morgan's Mask
plot: Stuck inside during quarantine, a cosplayer's world begins to fall apart. With nowhere to go, she turns within to find the answers.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: Part Two
plot: In 968 AD, assassins and rival kingdoms unite against the Chola dynasty. As princes confront enemies from within and beyond their realm, rumors of a lost heir, betrayal by a powerful noble, and a bitter romance driven by revenge threaten to reshape the kingdom’s future.

title: Born to Fly
plot: A talented trainee pilot joins a prestigious program to virtually test a new fighter jet. As demanding flights, technical challenges, rivalry, and personal risks push the team to its limits, he must prove he has the discipline and determination to succeed.

title: Paachuvum Albhuthavilakkum
plot: A shopkeeper in Mumbai agrees to help his landlord’s elderly mother with an unexpected mission, hoping it will secure ownership of his shop space. The journey takes him from city life into unfamiliar situations, where humor, emotional connections, and questions about education, loss, and doing the right thing gradually emerge.

title: The Rage
plot: During a rabies outbreak in the taiga, increasingly aggressive wolves turn the wilderness into a deadly threat. A desperate father isolates his son at a remote hunting lodge, where they join local residents in fighting to survive against the infected animals and other dangers in the forest.

title: Dungeon
plot: In a town where people keep disappearing, a real estate agent’s latest listing turns into a nightmare when a tenant refuses to leave and takes him captive. As time runs out, the search for answers pulls others into a tense mystery where personal motives and hidden connections start to surface.

title: War of the Worlds: The Attack
plot: Three young astronomers fight to survive a deadly Martian invasion.

title: Final Summer
plot: In the wake of a tragedy during the summer of 1991, a group of camp counselors find themselves fighting for their lives against a masked killer.

title: Old Man Jackson
plot: Mr. Jackson, an award winning automotive mechanics shop owner, and high strung hypochondriac, has a premonition. With no children of his own to pass the legacy that his grandfather started, he has one last mission to accomplish.

title: Baian the Assassin, M.D. Part 2
plot: The main character, Baian Fujieda, is a dark hero who has two faces: one as a skilled acupuncturist who saves lives, and the other as a criminal who buries evil that cannot be kept alive for the sake of others. Popular writer Shotaro Ikenami's historical novel series of the same title, on which the film "BAIAN The Assassin, M.D." is based, is a blockbuster bestseller with a total of over 6 million copies in print and has been made into a timeless entertainment film many times in Japan.  Many famous actors have played the role of Baian, including Ken Watanabe. The year 2023 marks the 100th anniversary of Shotaro Ikenami's birth. In the anniversary year of 2023, a new "BAIAN The Assassin, M.D." is born.

title: Bholaa
plot: After ten years in prison, an ex-convict sets out to meet his daughter, but a dangerous night filled with criminals, violence, and unexpected obstacles forces him into a perilous journey. Along the way, he becomes caught up in a larger struggle involving law enforcement and powerful gangs.

title: Viduthalai: Part 1
plot: A humble police constable is drawn into a dangerous operation targeting a separatist movement in a remote village. As authorities confront local resistance, he witnesses the devastating effects of police brutality and must navigate the conflict between duty, conscience, and the fight against oppression.

title: Ranga Maarthaanda
plot: After retiring from the stage, an acclaimed theater actor divides his property between his two children and hopes to enjoy a peaceful life with his wife. Their lack of gratitude leaves the older couple facing hardship, prompting a deeply emotional look at family, friendship, aging, and the roles people play in everyday life.

title: Opal
plot: In a magic kingdom, the young princess Opal is struggling to remain joyful, as her sadness has the magic power to destroy the entire world.

cast.name: Dawn-Lissa Mystille
cast.role: Opal / Hofu / Huzuni / Jeraha / Hatia / Chuki / Aibu / Hasira

title: Gulmohar
plot: A family has only a few days left in the home they have lived in for decades. As they prepare to leave, old tensions, hidden feelings, and private truths begin to surface, turning a difficult transition into an emotional reckoning.

title: Play Dead
plot: A criminology student fakes her death to enter a morgue and retrieve evidence that could help her younger brother. Inside, she discovers a dangerous coroner exploiting the dead, turning her risky plan into a tense fight for survival.

title: The Death of April
plot: Meagan Mullen, freshly moved in her new home, keeps in touch with her friends and family through a video blog. As her entries (and her life) become more complex and emotional, strange things begin to happen in her room and the camera captures all of it.

title: Avarice
plot: A gifted archer’s family vacation turns into a violent home invasion when mercenaries abduct her husband and daughter. Forced into a dangerous pursuit, she draws on her skills and determination to confront their captors and fight for her family’s safety.

title: Nenevaru
plot: A young man’s romance turns into a dark spiral when his partner disappears, pushing him toward violent choices. As a new friend grows closer and learns his past, hidden motives and a dangerous investigation begin to close in around him.

title: Freddy
plot: An introverted, socially awkward dentist desperately searches for a soulmate through arranged dates. When he meets a woman who seems to offer the connection he wants, their relationship takes a painful and increasingly dangerous turn, drawing him into a dark romantic thriller.

title: India Lockdown
plot: When a country announces a sudden 21-day lockdown during a pandemic, millions face uncertainty as everyday life comes to a halt. This drama follows four individuals from different circumstances, capturing their struggles, emotional upheavals, and attempts to cope with an unprecedented period of isolation and disruption.

title: Qas
plot: Set during the harsh years of colonization and famine in the 1930s, the story follows a gravedigger confronting an agonizing choice. His decision will shape the future of an entire village as survival, duty, and uncertain consequences collide.

title: 23 décembre
plot: On December 23, the holiday season is in full force and the destinies of strangers intertwine: a hardened bachelor wants to find love; a couple expect their first child; a singer returns to the stage after a break; a mother tries to organize the perfect Christmas; a teen carries a big secret; a man struggles with the modern world; and the new manager of a large hotel must prove her worth.

title: Bhediya
plot: Inspired by folklore from Arunachal Pradesh, this horror comedy follows a contractor who is bitten by a mythical wolf and begins transforming into the creature. As he and his eccentric friends search for answers, they confront the danger within him while facing questions about nature, human expansion, and life in a local town.

title: Twisted
plot: A young woman seeks independence from her protective mother, only to be questioning her own sanity when newfound friends die, and her mother suggests she is the cause of their death.

title: The Debt Collector
plot: Frank Vaughan is a debt collector pushed to breaking point. In a frenzy of revenge, he tracks down the priests who abused him in boarding school and stole his childhood. Not even prayers can save them. But Frank's actions pit him against Melbourne's criminal underworld, unleashing a wave of violence across the city. Rescuing stripper Sarah from the bloody chaos, together they must fight their way out, one dead body at a time. Despite the danger, Frank won't stop until every guilty person meets their fate. Welcome to the seventh circle of hell. Every. Debt. Must. Be. Paid.

title: Gaalodu
plot: Raju, a reckless guy from a village, escapes to Hyderabad after a fight with a local leader’s son. Raju saves  Shukla ,a good hearted wealthy girl  from some thugs. Shukla introduces Raju to her father and hires him as a driver. And so their acquaintance leads to love.

title: Drishyam 2
plot: Seven years after a case involving a family was closed, unexpected events put their carefully protected peace at risk. As authorities revisit the past, a determined father must use his intelligence and planning to shield his loved ones from renewed suspicion.

title: Merry Ex-Mas
plot: Two unwitting ex-high school sweethearts who, while stranded at a random hotel bar during a snowstorm, discover their first love memories may be more than that after revisiting their past and present lives.

title: Ditto
plot: A chance connection through a radio brings a man and a woman from different eras together. As they share conversations, their growing bond leads to a tender story about love, friendship, and the unexpected ways people can connect across time.

title: An Assassin Walks Through the Trees
plot: After a job goes wrong, a professional killer spirals into an emotional crisis. Trying to cope, he starts reaching out to the people he was meant to target, only to sink deeper into uncertainty and self-doubt as his world closes in around him.

title: Cupid's Christmas
plot: As Santa Claus searches for his lost Reindeer (Cupid) in the small town of Holly; the love story of Katie Valentine and Army veteran/firefighter Luke Murphy is re-ignited during an effort to save the historic train depot.

title: Boy in the Corner
plot: The backward system of society pushes another dream-filled boy to the curb. With his aspiration suppressed, he is at risk of falling into the attractive arms of gang life.

title: Yashoda
plot: To save her sister, a desperate woman becomes a surrogate and moves into a luxurious facility, but the situation quickly turns strange. Meanwhile, multiple high-profile deaths are linked to an unknown drug, pulling together a dangerous web of secrets and motives.

title: Uninvited for the Holidays
plot: A new age "family" Christmas comedy, a fish out of water story meets "Home Alone".

title: Brain Hunter: New Breed
plot: A new breed of Brain Hunter has emerged to hunt humans for their brains in New York City. FBI agent Maxine Richards teams up with a retired detective from Wisconsin James Slant who has come face to face and battled this creature before.

title: The Manhattan Project
plot: When a small-town cocktail-enthusiast decides to kill himself after being diagnosed with a terminal illness he must deal with the repercussion his choice has on his son and his community.

title: The Lair
plot: After her aircraft is shot down over a dangerous rebel stronghold in Afghanistan, a Royal Air Force pilot takes shelter in an abandoned underground bunker. There, she encounters deadly man-made creatures—part human and part alien—that threaten everyone trapped inside.

title: 13 Miles
plot: Two triathletes battle their personal demons while they train for the biggest event of their lives.

title: The Consultant
plot: A psychiatrist relives all of his past fears with the arrival of three new patients.

title: Ram Setu
plot: An atheist archaeologist is drawn into a dangerous race to establish whether a legendary bridge is a human-made part of India’s heritage. As powerful interests push to destroy it, he and a small research team investigate underwater evidence while confronting questions of history, faith, and belief.

title: Thank God
plot: An arrogant real estate broker burdened by heavy debts has an accident and awakens in heaven. There, he is told he must play a supernatural game based on his life, with the chance to return to Earth or face hell depending on the result.

title: MindReader
plot: A prestigious magician's association is baffled by an up and coming mentalist, The Great Dexter, in the early 1970's who can apparently read minds.

title: Won't You Cry?
plot: A man loses the ability to cry after the death of his younger brother. As he deals with grief and the separation from his wife, he tries to reconcile his job at a football website with depression and a lack of meaning in life.

title: Ginna
plot: Two childhood friends reconnect after years apart, only to find that old bonds now come with tangled feelings and uneasy secrets. As love, deception, and dangerous rivalries collide, one man must find a way through the chaos without losing everything that matters.

title: Not for Nothing
plot: NOT FOR NOTHING is a crime drama feature film about two brothers, along with a handful of their ragtag South Philly buddies, who end up sparking an old style mob type war on the streets of Philly after the girlfriend of one of the brother's mysteriously dies from an opiate overdose.

title: Beyond the Neon
plot: After a woman working as an escort is spotted in a viral video, a small crew sets out to reconnect her with her sister. As they document the search, their plan pulls them into a risky, corrupt underworld tied to exploitation and trafficking in Las Vegas.

title: Game of Love
plot: A couple travels to Sicily to prepare for the sale of a family estate, but their visit takes an uneasy turn when a mysterious woman befriends the young woman. As tensions rise and boundaries blur, the couple must confront troubling parts of their relationship and the man’s past.

title: Iké Boys
plot: Two teenagers in Oklahoma who share a love of Japan find their lives changed when a magical anime transforms them into super-powered characters. As they adjust to their new abilities, they must find the courage to become heroes.

title: Anacoreta
plot: A group of friends travel for a weekend away to an isolated cabin in the woods to shoot an experimental horror movie. Slowly the film begins to unravel, and we see the true monster appear from the shadows. The director.

title: To the Solitary Me Who Loved You
plot: At a research center, a young man and woman fall in love just as their parents begin a relationship of their own. To avoid becoming stepsiblings, the couple seeks a parallel universe where they can stay together, risking unknown consequences as they travel between dimensions.

title: The Lake at the Bottom of the World
plot: An international team of scientists venture into the virtually unknown interior of Antarctica to explore a lake buried 3,600 feet beneath the ice. Their success hinges on the performance of their custom-built hot water drill and their ability to work as a team in the harshest climate on the planet. As they struggle against the ferocity of the ice and wind to unravel mysteries buried deep under Antarctica, they consider how our relationship with nature – and with one another — will impact humanity’s future and the future of all life on our rapidly changing planet.

title: Hometown
plot: Gi-se is a failed comedian and estranged son of a mob boss who left his hometown for the city years ago. After his father’s death, his gag show shuts down and he becomes jobless overnight. He decides to return to his hometown, where he meets his old friends and first love Young-shim. He tries to find his place to belong and dreams of a new life. But soon things change radically and he finds himself inheriting his father’s position as a local crime boss that leads him to face the truth about his father’s death.

title: Father of Nations
plot: Many years after a catastrophic event has decimated society, humanity is on the verge of extinction. The last few people continue on in search of life, struggling to survive as they confront their mortality and purpose in this dying world.

title: Mei Hoom Moosa
plot: Moosa, a trooper gets back following 19 years in Prison. He finds he is assumed dead. How Moosa gets on track to demonstrate his character while additionally attempting to find some peace with all that has occurred around him during his time in a correctional facility.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: Part I
plot: A powerful kingdom faces threats from rival factions as members of the royal family become separated by political intrigue and dangerous circumstances. A brave messenger travels across the realm to protect the succession and uncover vital information, while a cunning former lover works to bring down the ruling empire.

title: Vikram Vedha
plot: An honest police officer sets out to capture a feared gangster, but their cat-and-mouse encounter takes an unexpected turn when the fugitive surrenders and begins sharing stories. Each tale challenges the officer’s ideas about justice, morality, and the difference between right and wrong.

title: The Obscured
plot: A woman suffering from bi-polar disorder, must rely on fragmented memories to help solve the murder of her lover.

title: Trigger
plot: An undercover cop has to stop the mastermind behind a child kidnapping racket, which will also lead to the redemption of his Azheimer's-affected father, a former policeman.

title: Babli Bouncer
plot: In a village where it’s not done before, Babli takes up a bouncer’s job to win over her love. What follows is a run of funny, heart-warming moments shaped by her efforts to fit in and do things her way.

title: Bandit
plot: After escaping prison, a charming career criminal adopts a new identity in Canada and embarks on an extraordinary robbery spree targeting banks and jewellery stores. As his reputation grows, a determined rogue task force closes in, turning his double life into a tense cat-and-mouse chase inspired by true events.

title: Waking Up Dead
plot: Beautiful and self-destructive, hot-shot actor Danny Maldonado was once about to conquer Hollywood. Now, just a few years later, his career has flatlined, his boyfriend has dumped him and his long-estranged drug addict mother is dying. But when he's called in to audition for the lead role in the most talked-about new series in Hollywood, Danny vows to clean up his act, win his ex back and give the greatest audition of his life. What could go wrong?

title: Middle Class Love
plot: A young college boy is frustrated being in middle-class family setup and finds love the ideal way to get out of it. However, the path to getting rid of the middle-class thinking and probing parents wasn't so easy as it seemed initially, especially when he thought love would save him.

title: Pattern
plot: Five months after the maternal death of his partner, a man is at a crossroads with how to raise their baby.

title: Saroj Ka Rishta
plot: A confident, carefree young woman navigates life in her neighborhood and unexpectedly finds herself falling in love. As the relationship grows, she must balance her self-assured spirit with the new emotions and challenges that come with romance.

title: Vendhu Thanindhathu Kaadu
plot: A young man from Tamil Nadu leaves home for Bombay hoping to build a better life. After finding work, he is gradually pulled into an underworld gang, forcing him to navigate violence, changing loyalties, and the consequences of his new path.

title: House of Darkness
plot: After meeting at a local bar, a confident man drives a mysterious woman to her secluded estate, expecting an uncomplicated hookup. As their flirtation grows more playful and unsettling, the evening takes on a sinister Gothic atmosphere, leaving him facing far more than he anticipated.

title: Loose Change
plot: A down on his luck street magician and his con artist ex-wife reunite to swindle an accounting firm.

title: Brahmastra Part One: Shiva
plot: A young man on the verge of a great romance discovers a mysterious link to an ancient, powerful weapon. As his ordinary world is transformed, he begins to uncover an extraordinary ability connected to fire and faces forces tied to a larger mythological universe.

title: All Eyes
plot: A disgraced podcast host interviews an eccentric farmer who claims to have a monster living in the woods near his house.

title: Cuttputlli
plot: When a small town is shaken by a series of killings, a rookie police officer begins investigating and pursuing the truth. As the case grows more disturbing, the investigation leads toward a dangerous conspiracy, testing the officer’s resolve and ability to protect the community.

title: Leda
plot: Haunted by memories and unsettling visions, a young woman tries to piece her life back together after sexual violence and an unexpected pregnancy. This poetic, myth-inspired story leans on mood and imagery as she navigates trauma, faith, and the blurred line between reality and legend.

title: Vikram
plot: A detective investigates a series of killings and soon realizes the case is far more complicated than it first appears. As he follows the clues, rival forces collide, drawing everyone involved toward an escalating war.

title: 4 Days to End Cancer
plot: A group of strangers come together to do the impossible, create a business solution that will end cancer globally in just 4 days.

title: Sex, Love, Misery: New New York
plot: Swiping. Dating. Ghosting. Have you wondered what was really going on in your date's head? "Sex, Love, Misery" reveals candid thoughts and encounters between diverse singles looking to mingle or marry, from initial texts to hook ups and beyond.

title: Chitrakut
plot: Chitrakut revolves around the lives of five people, their journey of change and metamorphosis as they search for love and companionship. When Debu met Alisha the beginning of a great love story blossomed in his head, unknown to him she was in a desperate attempt to get over her past love.

title: Keedam
plot: Radhika Balan, a smart cyber-security expert, advocates the use of the technology for the good but her life is turned upside down when she falls prey to a cyber-stalking incident and her privacy gets compromised

title: Puzhu
plot: A rigid, prejudiced retired police officer lives with his young son while tensions rise around his family after his sister chooses a relationship they oppose. As threats seem to close in, his fear and suspicion begin to poison everyday life for everyone around him.

title: Sarkaru Vaari Paata
plot: A finance agent travels from the United States to India after the woman he loves deceives him. He seeks to recover his money from her influential father, a powerful politician and industrialist, while the conflict expands into a broader confrontation over financial wrongdoing.

title: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
plot: The journey to Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 begins in Agnipareeksha, where commoner contestants battle for a place in the Bigg Boss House.

title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
plot: A former dark ruler lives as a reclusive shut-in until the hero who once defeated him returns as an ordinary high school girl. Hoping to change his life, he becomes a teacher at her school, where their dramatic reunion revives old tensions and unexpected romantic feelings.

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
plot: After a war ends, a hero receives a barren frontier as his reward, with no residents, villages, or signs of civilization. Determined to build a domain from nothing, he begins shaping the empty grasslands—until meeting a mysterious blue-horned girl brings unexpected life to his lonely new home.

title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
plot: A caregiver summoned as a saint is unexpectedly left alone in another world. With powerful skills, a mobile home, and a talent for survival, she embraces solo camping, cooking, and gourmet discoveries while meeting an array of wonderful companions along the way.

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker
plot: After a fatal accident, an overworked office worker is reborn in a dangerous fantasy world as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class, an all-purpose support role skilled in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and a former boss, the newcomer explores deadly dungeons and climbs the ranks.

title: Black Torch
plot: A high schooler descended from ninjas can communicate with animals and becomes involved with an injured cat hiding a powerful secret. Together with an espionage bureau, he faces swarms of supernatural creatures seeking to exploit the cat’s abilities.

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
plot: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, a young warrior is cast out after awakening a supposedly defective combat class. With memories of another life and knowledge that this world mirrors a game he once mastered, he sets out to challenge expectations, rewrite his fate, and prove the strength of the weakest path.

title: Ab Hoga Hisaab
plot: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

title: Made in India: A Titan Story
plot: In a market dominated by smuggling and foreign brands, a determined Indian man and his team set out to build a world-class watch from scratch. Facing rejection, failure, and international humiliation, they work to create a homegrown brand that becomes a symbol of national pride and innovation.

title: Azure Spring
plot: Two people who feel stuck in their lives start diving as haenyeo. Together at sea, they work through past fears and find healing and new purpose.

title: Lukkhe
plot: A young athlete enters Punjab’s volatile rap scene undercover to investigate a drug syndicate. As he moves deeper into this dangerous world, competing loyalties and emotional ties force him to weigh love, family, guilt, and brotherhood.

title: The Scarecrow
plot: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, once classmates, reunite to investigate a nationwide serial murder case. Their dangerous pursuit is complicated by unresolved feelings from the past, testing their judgment, trust, and commitment to justice.

title: Twenty Twenty Six
plot: With 48 countries and three host nations involved, a major international tournament faces plenty of potential chaos. A seasoned organizer is brought in to keep the event on track, juggling big promises, bigger pressures, and the constant question of what could go wrong.

title: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
plot: After wishing on a shooting star, a shy student suddenly sees “love meters” floating above classmates, revealing how they feel. When the meter over a longtime friend drops to an alarming low, the new power turns everyday school life into a confusing search for what her kindness really means.

title: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex
plot: A timid young man is forced to take over managing an apartment complex after a family emergency. He soon discovers the residents have extreme desires, and when a mysterious force hands out empowering outfits that trigger chaotic, raunchy rampages, he’s pushed into trying to keep the building under control.

title: Sankalp
plot: A socio-political drama about how power is built through mentorship, influence, and institutional control rather than elections. Set in modern India, it shifts political strategy from battlefields to classrooms and bureaucratic offices, drawing inspiration from an ancient teacher-and-ruler tradition.

title: Recipe for Love
plot: Two families entangled in a bad relationship for 30 years, resolving misunderstandings, healing each other's wounds, and ultimately being reborn as one family.

title: Space Gen: Chandrayaan
plot: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

title: Scum of the Brave
plot: In the mid-21st century, Tokyo's mafia can turn into ether-enhanced Demon Lords, and Braves hunt them down. Yashiro, the Grim Reaper, reluctantly takes a new apprentice named Aki Jogamine, a high school girl training to become a Brave. He soon finds himself dragged into one troublesome case after another. The supernatural story of a scumbag master and his self-proclaimed apprentice begins!

title: Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None
plot: After being betrayed by a childhood friend and cast out of a heroic group, a once-loyal enchanter is branded a jack-of-all-trades. Setting out alone as an adventurer, he faces explosive battles and dangerous rivals while finding unexpected allies and working to prove his true worth.

title: Idol Child
plot: A top criminal lawyer and longtime fan sets out to prove her favorite idol’s innocence after he is suspected of murder. Balancing her demanding profession with her passionate fandom, she becomes drawn into a case that tests her judgment and commitment.

title: Nayanam
plot: Nayan, an ophthalmologist, runs an eye clinic for people in need. But he secretly carries out experiments in the clinic that help him look at the personal lives of his patients through their lenses.

title: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
plot: A paranormal investigator’s search for answers about unexplained phenomena draws him into a dangerous spiral. After his mysterious death, a journalist examines his eerie legacy, uncovering secrets that challenge the boundary between reality and the supernatural.

title: Aukaat Ke Bahar
plot: A small-town boxer earns a spot at an elite Delhi college to carry forward his brother’s dream. As he faces bullying, class prejudice, and campus politics, he’s pulled into a complicated romance that pushes him to fight for respect, love, and his own identity.

title: Heated Rivalry
plot: Two young hockey stars begin a secret relationship while competing at the highest level of their sport. Over several years, they balance ambition, public expectations, fear, and growing love as they gradually confront what their connection means to them.

title: Arafta
plot: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart.

title: Robin Hood
plot: After the Norman invasion of England, a Saxon forester’s son and a Norman lord’s daughter fall in love despite their divided worlds. Together, they confront corruption, stand up for justice, and seek to help restore peace across a troubled land in this modern reimagining of a classic legend.

title: Hal & Harper
plot: Two codependent siblings in Los Angeles struggle to move beyond childhood while their single father pushes them toward adulthood. As family grief and old wounds surface, they navigate messy relationships, difficult memories, and the challenge of supporting one another while trying to find their own paths.

title: Search: The Naina Murder Case
plot: A veteran cop gets mired in a high-profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car. With multiple suspects, how will she unmask the killer?

title: Room of Guilty Pleasure
plot: This overworked and underpaid teacher, Mr. Sasaki, has his whole life turned upside down when he stumbles upon the "Guilty Hole." He thinks it's a dream when he sees the student's shoe lockers have been transformed into selection panels... seeing one that catches his eye, he joking picks her... When she appears in his classroom in the middle of the night, throwing insults at him, but her eyes seem to linger on him, tinged with embarassment. "I'll finish this quickly so... Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to the Guilty Hole, where anything is allowed--

title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
plot: Hinako lives alone by the sea, quietly drifting through life after losing her family years ago. One day, a mermaid named Shiori saves her from a monster and says she’s come to eat her—just not yet. Until then, Shiori will stay by her side and keep her safe. In that moment, a deep hope swells in Hinako: Maybe this girl can finally grant her the ending she’s been waiting for.

title: The Hack
plot: Set between 2002 and 2012, this drama follows two intertwined real-life investigations: a journalist uncovering phone hacking at a powerful tabloid and a detective pursuing answers in an unsolved murder. Their separate efforts expose troubling connections involving the media, private surveillance, policing, and the pursuit of justice.

title: The Guest
plot: A cleaner struggling with everyday pressures is hired by a wealthy businesswoman and welcomed into an unfamiliar world of privilege. Their friendship gradually shifts into a tense psychological contest, exposing hidden motives, class tensions, and difficult choices as trust becomes increasingly uncertain.

title: The Rainmaker
plot: Fresh out of law school, a young attorney takes on a powerful courtroom rival while navigating complicated ties to a former law school partner. With help from an unconventional boss and a scruffy paralegal, the attorney investigates connected conspiracies surrounding a client’s son’s mysterious hospital death.

title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
plot: With humour, absurdity and family cat and mouse at its center, this is a tale of family gangsters in a fictitious madhouse city, Bindiya. As the current Don is put behind bars, the gangster family's alliances shift, new love, friendships, and betrayals explode until Bindiya becomes a full-blown circus-where love is a deal, power is personal, and every one has a card and blood on their hands.

title: S Line
plot: A young woman who can see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers that her secret gift is no longer unique. When special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market, the ability begins affecting strangers’ lives and drawing them into dangerous situations.

title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
plot: When superstar adventurer Dennis gets booted from the world’s strongest party, he teams up with runaway Atelier to serve up his true passion—delicious cuisine. But this not-so-average eatery has not-so-average patrons. Dennis will battle his quirky customers’ troubles with his trusty butcher knife and wok. Visit Adventurer’s Restaurant and fill up your heart and stomach!

title: Takopi's Original Sin
plot: A cheerful alien arrives on Earth determined to spread happiness and helps a lonely fourth grader using strange devices. As the alien encounters the painful realities surrounding her and another troubled child, well-meaning attempts to help reveal that suffering and happiness are more complicated than expected.

crew.name: Toya Oshima
crew.role: Key Animation, Storyboard Artist, Director, Animation Director

crew.name: Shinya Iino
crew.role: Series Director, Series Composition, Storyboard Artist, Writer, Director

title: Code of Silence
plot: A deaf catering worker struggling to make ends meet is recruited by a police superintendent to lip-read criminals’ conversations. As she helps with a dangerous investigation, her growing involvement brings personal risks and complicated emotions.

title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
plot: "Why is a perfect specimen of a man like me getting this turned on by a guy like that?!" Thus begins the obstinate relationship of a playboy narcissist and a deceivingly frumpily-dressed, hot bodied otaku!

title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
plot: After a life-changing incident, a timid college student accepts an offer from a respected vigilante to become his protégé. Together with other unlicensed heroes, he begins confronting criminals and people with dangerous abilities while learning what it means to protect others without official recognition.

crew.name: Kenichi Suzuki
crew.role: Series Director, Storyboard Artist, Director, Co-Director

title: Witch Watch
plot: A diligent teenager moves in with his spirited childhood friend, a trainee witch, to protect her from a dangerous prophecy. As they navigate high school and everyday life together, her unpredictable magic creates plenty of chaotic, comedic situations involving their growing circle of supernatural companions.

title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
plot: Banished as useless, a self-taught healer from the slums opens a secret clinic for people ignored by the official system. Using extraordinary healing magic, he helps those in need while navigating criminal dangers, social inequality, unwanted attention, and a growing reputation that eventually reaches the royal palace.

title: The Best Thing
plot: Suffering from insomnia and migraines, a hotel manager seeks help from a traditional Chinese medicine doctor. As they spend more time together, their connection grows into a gentle romance shaped by emotional healing, everyday support, and a calm, mature approach to relationships.

title: Undercover High School
plot: After a mission failure, a demoted intelligence agent is sent undercover as a high school student to find missing royal gold. At the school, he encounters a devoted teacher who sees similarities between him and her lost first love, while school tensions, mystery, action, comedy, and a restrained romance unfold.

title: Engaged
plot: The series follows "Love Seekers" who enter a luxurious villa. While the goal is to find a soulmate for an official Roka (engagement), the path is filled with Dhoka (betrayal). Contestants are often tempted by new "Love Makers" (wild cards) who enter specifically to break existing bonds and test the strength of their "Engaged" status.

title: Amandaland
plot: After a divorce, a status-conscious mother downsizes and moves with her children to a new part of London. As her teenagers start secondary school, she faces modern parenting challenges including drinking, fake social media accounts and eco-anxiety, while trying to maintain her image and adapt to a changed life.

title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
plot: Kazuhiro Kitase’s only hobby? Sleeping, of course. Since childhood, his dreams have been a portal to exhilarating adventures with an elf girl. During one of their explorations through ancient ruins, they both get scorched by a dragon, and Kazuhiro wakes up like usual. Except this time, he finds a familiar figure in bed beside him—the elf girl from his dreams.

title: Promise of Wizard
plot: On a moonlit night, Akira Masaki finds herself in a magical world where wizards and humans coexist. Every year, they must face an enormous, deadly moon that attacks the planet. Their only hope lies with the Wizards of the Sage, appointed to fight the supernatural threat. But Akira soon discovers she wasn't summoned by chance—she was chosen to lead them in battle.

title: Alaca
plot: A young girl's life is turned upside down when her kidney is stolen during a violent kidnapping, orchestrated by her rich biological father who needs a donor.

title: Fate/Strange Fake
plot: In a western American city, powerful spellcasters and summoned heroes gather for a new wish-granting relic’s battle. But missing participants, impossible summonings, secretive authorities, and a city built as a battleground turn the conflict into a chaotic and dangerous spectacle.

title: Earth Abides
plot: After a devastating plague nearly wipes out humanity, a small number of survivors face a world where civilization is slowly failing. As they search for connection and purpose, they must decide how to endure, cooperate, and preserve the possibility of a future without relying on the systems that once shaped everyday life.

title: Family Plan
plot: People with special abilities pose as a family while trying to survive in a small town threatened by dangerous criminals. Their unusual skills, complicated pasts, and growing bonds drive a tense story that mixes mystery, dark humor, action, and family drama.

title: Asia
plot: This nature series explores Asia’s extraordinary wildlife and landscapes, traveling from vast deserts and dense jungles to icy wilderness and coral seas. Across its episodes, it highlights the remarkable variety of plants, animals, and habitats found throughout the continent.

title: Mistletoe Murders
plot: A good-natured Christmas shop owner draws on unusual skills from her hidden past when murders trouble a small community. As she helps a local detective investigate, their growing connection is complicated by questions about her history and the secrets she has left behind.

title: Aindham Vedham
plot: Anu travels to Varanasi for her mother’s last rites, where a priest asks her to deliver an ancient relic to a temple in Tamil Nadu. While she plans to disobey his command, fate has other plans.

title: Reeta Sanyal
plot: A young lawyer takes on a major case after a guilty killer describes a seemingly perfect murder. Facing an established legal powerhouse, she investigates beyond the courtroom, using unconventional disguises and bold methods to uncover the truth while balancing crime, comedy, action, and suspense.

title: The Wranglers
plot: In the cowboy paradise of Montana's Circle Bar Dude Ranch - owned by no-nonsense second-generation rancher Russell True - guests escape their fast-paced lives and experience the real American West.

title: Curfew
plot: Set in a society where all men live under 'The Women’s Safety Act', meaning they are bound by a strict curfew from 7PM to 7AM every night, with their movements tracked by an ankle tag 24 hours a day. When a woman's body is discovered, brutally murdered during curfew hours and left on the steps of the Women's Safety Center, veteran Police officer Pamela Green believes that a man is responsible. But in a world where men are bound by the curfew system, her theory is rejected.

title: Dandadan
plot: Two high school students make a bet to settle whether ghosts or aliens exist. Their investigation leads them into terrifying paranormal encounters, strange new abilities, chaotic battles, and an unexpected bond that may grow into something more.

title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire!
plot: Six childhood friends vow to become treasure hunters and eventually rise as powerful heroes. When their first quest reveals that one member is poorly suited to adventuring, the others still make him their leader, leaving him to navigate overwhelming expectations, dangerous situations, and a growing desire to retire.

title: Paris Has Fallen
plot: After a terrorist attack at a high-profile Paris gathering, a protection officer joins forces with an MI6 operative to protect key figures and uncover the truth. As suspicion turns toward a possible mole, the pair confront escalating danger while racing to stop a wider conspiracy.

title: Return to Paradise
plot: A detective leaves London under suspicion and returns reluctantly to her Australian hometown, where she joins the local police team. Using sharp observation, determination, and an unconventional approach, she tackles murder cases while adjusting to familiar surroundings and complicated personal history.

title: You Are My Secret
plot: Lobby manager Tu Xiaoning and rising business star Ji Yuheng reconnect as childhood friends with a shared goal of marriage. As their lives intertwine through work and love, they navigate the complexities of relationships, balancing their dual roles as colleagues and newlyweds.

title: Yoasobi Gurashi!
plot: Meet Kazuto, whose hopes of becoming a photographer didn't pan out, and Yayoi, who successfully achieved her dream of becoming a model. Two childhood friends who have grown apart... Suddenly find themselves living together! In the beginning, there's an awkward tension between them, and Yayoi has a secret she can't tell Kazuto... Then, one night, things start to change... Could they be more than just childhood friends...?!

title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
plot: A boisterous wizard guild embarks on a legendary quest considered more difficult than any S-Class mission. Traveling to a far northern land, the team searches for the first wizard guild while confronting powerful new beings, strange towns, and ominous enemies.

title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything with Low-Level Spells
plot: A student summoned to a fantasy world is judged useless when his classmates receive powerful abilities and he is cast into dangerous ruins. Surviving with seemingly weak spells and careful strategy, he sets out on a dark path of revenge while forming uneasy alliances and confronting the forces that betrayed him.

title: I Parry Everything
plot: A determined young man dreams of becoming an adventurer despite believing his only useful skill is parrying attacks. After years of isolated training, he returns to the wider world and becomes involved in events that challenge his modest view of his own abilities.

title: Suicide Squad Isekai
plot: A government operative sends a team of notorious criminals through a gate into a dangerous fantasy realm of swords, magic, rampaging orcs, and dragons. Forced to navigate this strange world, the chaotic group must survive perilous missions while trying to accomplish their objective.

title: Golam Mamun
plot: Mamun, the prime suspect in a double murder, faces off with a serial killer and the system to which he has dedicated his life, while the clock keeps ticking on his quest to prove his innocence.

title: Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment
plot: Colors presents an innovative blend of celebrity personalities, culinary skills, and comedy, all coming together for a delightful entertainment experience.

title: High School Return of a Gangster
plot: A gangster’s spirit unexpectedly takes over the body of an 18-year-old student and returns to high school. Using hard-earned street skills, he confronts bullying while trying to navigate school life, new relationships, and the challenges of living as someone much younger.

title: Dark Matter
plot: A family man is abducted into an alternate version of his life, leaving him desperate to return to the people he loves. His journey through shifting realities forces him to confront difficult choices, unsettling possibilities, and a frightening version of himself.

title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
plot: A struggling merchant is summoned to another world as a supposed hero, only to be rejected and abandoned after failing its tests. When he reaches level two, he gains extraordinary abilities and seeks a peaceful life, but danger, romance, and unexpected responsibilities keep finding him.

title: Lovely Runner
plot: After a beloved young star dies, his devoted fan is mysteriously sent back to their high-school years. Determined to change his future, she tries to protect him, while their renewed connection grows into a heartfelt fantasy romance about timing, fate, and second chances.

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
plot: Reincarnated in another world as the young son of a minor noble, a boy is born with a rare ability to recognize people’s talents and abilities. Though he is neither strong nor especially clever, he uses this gift to discover promising individuals and help transform his family’s small, struggling domain.

title: Wind Breaker
plot: At a school known for its delinquent students, strength is used to protect the surrounding town rather than cause trouble. A victory-obsessed newcomer arrives, challenging the existing balance while learning what it means to belong, trust others, and fight for more than personal glory.

title: Re: Monster
plot: After an untimely death, a man is reincarnated as a weak goblin in a fantastical world. A special ability lets him grow stronger by feeding, quickly changing his status as he navigates danger, power, leadership, and the harsh rules of survival.

title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince So I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
plot: A young prince remembers a past life as a sorcerer and chooses to devote his new life to mastering magic. Though his royal status brings its own challenges, his curiosity and extraordinary talent drive him through lessons, adventures, and increasingly intense magical encounters.

title: Mammals
plot: This nature miniseries explores the remarkable diversity of mammals, from tiny shrews to enormous whales. It examines how adaptability, intelligence, social behavior, and physical traits have helped this successful animal group thrive across different environments.

title: Dark City: The Cleaner
plot: By day, Joe is a cleaner at the police station. But by night, he has another line of work - he's a serial killer who's been dubbed The Christchurch Carver. When another woman is murdered, the police suspect The Carver, but Joe knows it wasn't him.

title: Wedding Impossible
plot: A struggling actress enters a fake marriage with a wealthy heir to help him keep a deeply personal secret. As the arrangement grows harder to control, his driven younger brother becomes suspicious and starts digging for the truth, putting everyone’s plans at risk.

title: Baghin
plot: A girl and a vengeful spirit share connection rooted in the past. The spirit selects the girl to seek revenge against those responsible for its demise. Fueled by justice she embodies revenge settling scores and unveiling intertwined fates.

title: Love Endures
plot:
In an aerospace city in the north, seven children who were born an only child became closer than siblings and called themselves "The Big Dipper." They all promised to conquer the college entrance examinations so they can go to Beijing together but seventeen came and went and only Huang Yingzi made it.

"The Big Dipper" was no more as everyone parted ways. Huang Yingzi went to Beijing for school and Jiang Yi left for the States. "Who do you like at the age of seventeen" has become a mystery lingering in the hearts of the seven people. As newcomers in the workplace, they were bruised and battered from the skirmishes between their ideals and reality. Their once pure emotions are like shining stars in the night sky. Huang Yingzi wants to reunite the group only to realize that there a question remains. Meanwhile, Jiang Yi and the others have already been presented their answer.

title: Late Bloomer
plot: A budding content creator tries to build a successful career while staying connected to family, community, and cultural traditions. The series follows his efforts to balance personal ambition with the expectations and responsibilities that shape his everyday life.

title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
plot: After a shy office worker unexpectedly gains the ability to read minds, he discovers that his handsome colleague has strong feelings for him. As he navigates this surprising revelation, their workplace relationship grows into a sweet and sometimes awkward romance.

title: The Unwanted Undead Adventurer
plot: A seasoned adventurer with modest ambitions discovers an unexplored path and is killed by a legendary dragon. He awakens as an undead skeleton and begins a dangerous journey to regain a human-like form, while navigating new abilities, monster threats, and the rules of adventuring.

crew.name: Takao Sano
crew.role: Character Designer, Animation Director, Supervising Animation Director, Key Animation

title: The Strongest Tank's Labyrinth Raids: A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero's Party
plot: Rud, an adventurer with the highest defence ever recorded, serves as a tank while exploring dangerous labyrinths in search of a treasure capable of curing his ailing sister. After being unjustly expelled from the Hero’s Party, he discovers the true nature of his hidden abilities and begins forging a new path alongside the companions who recognise his strength and selfless determination.

title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy
plot: After reliving the same turning point six times, a duke’s daughter enters her seventh life determined to enjoy peace and avoid an early death. Her plans change when the prince responsible for her past tragedies proposes marriage, forcing her to navigate palace life, romance, and the threat of another war.

crew.name: Tooru Imanishi
crew.role: Animation, Supervising Animation Director, Key Animation

title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
plot: An ordinary student is accidentally transported to another world alongside two classmates. There, an unusual talent for healing magic leads to relentless training, as self-healing abilities become the foundation for extraordinary strength and stamina in a fantasy adventure filled with action and humor.

title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
plot: After waking from a nap, a student discovers that he and his entire class have been transported to another world. Alongside a classmate, he must face dangerous threats and navigate their strange new surroundings while relying on an unusually powerful ability—and trying to stay awake.

title: Chained Soldier
plot: Monsters from the Mato dimension threaten Earth, while women empowered by magical Peaches fight to protect it. A young man joins their struggle and becomes the servant of a powerful commander, supporting her both in battle and in their unusual life away from the front lines.

title: Mera Balam Thanedaar
plot: Set in Rajasthan, Mera Balam Thanedaar captures the love story of an IPS officer and a spirited teenage girl.

title: Rüzgarli Tepe
plot: A respected young woman from the town’s wealthiest family falls in love with a man driven by revenge for the loss of his relatives. Their growing connection is tested by family conflict, painful misunderstandings, and the struggle between old resentment and new feelings.

title: Classified
plot: Suddenly forced to leave her mother in the US to join her father's stepfamily in South Africa, Ella is swept up in a whole new reality as an expat.

title: Kaise Mujhe Tum Mil Gaye
plot: Amruta is a romantic who believes in the bond of love and marriage, while Virat bears the scars of a broken relationship. Will this contrasting duo fall in love against all odds?

title: Spinners
plot: Ethan is a 17-year-old driver working for a local gang. Disgusted with gang life, Ethan discovers a possible way out via spinning, an extreme motorsport. But the looming gang war jeopardises that hope.

title: Only for Love
plot: A driven financial reporter pursues an exclusive interview with a reserved investment executive, but a misunderstanding brings them closer than expected. As they collaborate on a series of reports and support socially responsible businesses, their professional ambitions gradually intertwine with a developing romance.

title: Erotic Stories
plot: Erotic Stories is a bold and transgressive anthology series exploring sex and intimacy amongst diverse characters not traditionally seen as sexual leads.

title: Evilive
plot: A hardworking lawyer who randomly selects prisoners to visit and find jobs for himself meets a former baseball player who is also the second in command of a criminal organization. Will he be able to resist the temptations of evil?

title: Stardust Telepath
plot: Umika is a sweet yet shy high school girl. She has trouble speaking to others and dreams of having a friend from another planet. But her lonely school life takes a cosmic turn when she meets transfer student Yu, an alien with telepathic powers! The two become close and promise to go to space one day. So, they decide to build a rocket and shoot for the stars, making new friends along the way.

crew.name: Kaori
crew.role: Series Director, Series Composition, Director, Writer

title: The Kingdoms of Ruin
plot: Magic once helped humanity, but a new scientific age turns witches into targets of persecution. After a young boy witnesses the death of his witch mentor, he dedicates himself to revenge against the human race, setting out on a violent and uncertain path.

title: MF Ghost
plot: In a future where self-driving electric cars dominate Japan, high-performance gas-powered vehicles compete in the MFG, a motorway racing circuit. A young driver returns from Britain to enter the races while searching for his father, facing international competition and the pressure to prove himself.

crew.name: Naoyuki Onda
crew.role: Supervising Animation Director, Character Designer, Key Animation, Animation Director

title: Ragna Crimson
plot: A determined young warrior joins forces with an enigmatic ally to confront dragons threatening the world. Their goals align despite unanswered questions, leading them into a dangerous fight to protect humanity and end the dragon menace.

title: Shangri-La Frontier
plot: A devoted player of notoriously bad virtual reality games decides to challenge a hugely popular fantasy MMORPG. Relying on years of unconventional gaming experience, he explores its expansive world, faces powerful creatures, and searches for hidden secrets alongside a colorful group of players and game inhabitants.

title: Twinkling Watermelon
plot: A music-loving student from a deaf family is unexpectedly sent back in time through a mysterious music shop. In an unfamiliar era, he joins a high-school band and meets younger versions of people connected to his family, forcing him to balance music, friendship, romance, and the desire to improve their lives.

title: Campus Beats
plot: What starts as an agenda to get closure for her past , a GenZ girl uncovers her hidden dancing talent and in the process experiences the real meaning of friendship, love, freedom and justice in a modern dance academy divided sharply across socio-economic class.

title: Psycho: The Lost Tapes of Ed Gein
plot: Follows the horrifying grave robber and serial killer Ed Gein, whose crimes inspired such iconic films as "Psycho", "The Texas Chainsaw Massacre", and "The Silence of the Lambs".

title: Sunshine by My Side
plot: After a chance encounter, a recently divorced advertising director and an idealistic young designer find comfort and affection in each other. As they face workplace challenges, differences in age and status, family concerns, and social judgment, their relationship encourages both to heal, grow, and reconsider what they want from life.

title: Nikhoj
plot: Fearless and bold DCP Brinda Basu becomes desperate to track down the person behind her daughter's disappearance. Amidst the truth and lies, will Brinda be able to get back her daughter fighting against the odds?

title: My Dearest
plot: In 1600s Joseon, a noblewoman’s sheltered life is disrupted by a mysterious man who arrives in her hometown as the Qing invasion brings war and hardship. Their growing connection unfolds amid survival, shifting loyalties, and the devastating consequences faced by people from different walks of life.

title: My Lovely Liar
plot: A woman who can hear when people are lying has built her life around uncovering the truth, but the ability has made trust difficult. Her world changes when she meets a withdrawn composer whose words reveal nothing to her, drawing them into a mystery while their connection gradually grows.

title: Sixer
plot: A ragtag group of cricketers and cricket enthusiasts join forces to overcome personal struggles and support one another as they pursue victory in a local tennis-ball cricket tournament. Along the way, the team’s friendships, family relationships, and shared love of the game are put to the test.

title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
plot: Hannah Fry uncovers the secrets behind the miraculous technologies of the modern world, revealing the mind-blowing stories behind their invention.

title: Criss Angel's Magic with the Stars
plot: In each episode, two celebrities train with professional magicians and compete to create a show-stopping series of magic performances. The celebrity competitors are tasked with mastering three major categories of magic, which they perform in front of a team of judges led by magician Criss Angel. Only the highest-scoring celebrities will be invited back to the finale where they will compete for the golden wand.

title: High School
plot: Two teenage twin sisters navigate identity, self-discovery, and the complicated closeness of growing up side by side. Set against 1990s grunge and rave culture, the series explores their parallel experiences and differing memories as they find their individual paths.

title: The Ex-Wife
plot: A woman appears to have the perfect home life with her loving husband and young daughter. But her husband’s former wife refuses to stay in the past, creating an unsettling threat to the family’s sense of security.

title: Chainsaw Man
plot: A debt-ridden young man hunts devils with his loyal pet devil, hoping to earn enough money for a peaceful life. After a brutal turn of events, he gains a strange new opportunity and joins a devil-hunting team, facing dangerous threats alongside unpredictable companions.

crew.name: Tatsuya Yoshihara
crew.role: Action Director, Director, Key Animation, Storyboard Artist

title: Blue Lock
plot: Hundreds of promising high school soccer strikers enter a controversial training facility built to produce Japan’s ultimate forward. Forced to compete under intense pressure, they must balance teamwork with individual ambition as they fight to remain in the program.

title: Reincarnated as a Sword
plot: A sentient magical sword, carrying memories of a past life but no name, rescues a young cat-eared beastgirl from slavery. They form an unlikely partnership: she seeks strength and freedom, while he searches for answers about his existence, beginning an adventurous journey together.

crew.name: Atsuko Saitou
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Animation Supervisor

title: Mr. Bad
plot: A young girl, Nan Xing, who loves to write, accidentally summons the villain Xiao Wudi from the novel she wrote when she makes a wish. The clever and cunning Xiao Wudi, who just came to this world, threatened Nan Xing to allow him to stay in the apartment next to hers. They then start on their love-hate relationship and daily lives that one would never find mundane.

title: Viola
plot: A former beauty queen and fashion journalist returns to Sicily in search of her father. She begins working at a digital news company and teams up with a police inspector to investigate crimes, drawing on her unusual ability to associate sensory experiences with information.

title: Golden Boy
plot: An Istanbul playboy is pushed into marriage by his powerful grandfather after a family scandal. He becomes drawn to the younger sister of the woman he was meant to marry, setting off a turbulent romance shaped by family pressure, secrets, betrayal, and social expectations.

title: Love in Contract
plot: A professional contract-marriage partner manages an unusual schedule, dating one long-term mystery client on alternating days and a rising superstar on the others. As these carefully arranged relationships unfold, romance, personal expectations, and complicated family dynamics begin to challenge the boundaries of her work.

title: Mental Coach Jegal
plot: Je Gal-gil causes an unprecedented scandal after he loses a match that he almost won due to the referee’s biased call and injures his leg. Even though permanently expelled from the national team as a player, he overcomes the trauma and comes back as a sports psychology counselor also called a mental healthcare coach. Together with the retired masters, Gal-gil works to help athletes who are going through a hard time as he did in the past.

title: Criminal Justice: Adhura Sach
plot: A determined lawyer takes on a difficult case after a teenager is accused of killing a family member. As the courtroom battle unfolds, questions of family reputation, media pressure, social media, and adolescent struggles complicate the search for justice.

title: Sprung
plot: A convicted criminal is unexpectedly released during a pandemic lockdown after spending more than two decades in prison. With nowhere else to go, he shelters with a group of former inmates, who combine their skills to pursue a new life and put their criminal expertise to unexpected use.

crew.name: Greg Garcia
crew.role: Executive Producer, Writer, Director, Teleplay, Creator

title: Parallel World Pharmacy
plot: After dying, a gifted pharmacologist is reincarnated as a young apprentice in a medieval world where unreliable medicines harm ordinary people. Armed with medical knowledge and mysterious powers, he sets out to improve healthcare and challenge dishonest practices.

title: Black Summoner
plot: After waking in a fantasy world with no memories of his past life, a young man discovers he traded them for powerful abilities. Starting over as a Summoner and adventurer, he gathers allies, embraces challenging battles, and faces increasingly formidable enemies while building a reputation in his new world.

title: To Be a Brave One
plot: A woman wakes up from a coma only to find out that she has lost everything after being betrayed by the man that she loves. After mustering the courage to overcome grief, she betters herself to start over again as she strives hard for the future of the internet industry.

title: Hear Me
plot: After a student is seriously injured in a hit-and-run, three teenagers from a modest neighborhood receive scholarships to an elite private school. As they face bullying, social divisions, and complicated emotions, one determined student investigates the incident, convinced the person responsible is among the school’s privileged students.

title: Love Like the Galaxy
plot: Left behind while her parents serve in war, a resourceful young woman faces family tensions and navigates several possible marriages. Her connection with a powerful general draws her into a mystery involving his family, while together they confront danger, loyalty, romance, and a wider national crisis.

title: Pushpa Impossible
plot: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

title: My Daughter Joined a Cult
plot: Following the life of the controversial and self-styled godman, Swami Nithyananda whilst giving a voice to individuals who were at the epicenter of it all.

title: Playground
plot: As the world's first gaming entertainment show, Playground is all set to begin, its finally time to meet our super entertaining contestants in Playground Tryouts. Here all our 20 contestants will get a chance to interact with 4 mentors and impress one or all 4 to pick him/her.

title: Bosch: Legacy
plot: Two years after leaving the LAPD, a seasoned detective now works as a private investigator and teams up with a former adversary who has become a leading attorney. At the same time, his daughter begins navigating her new career with the LAPD, bringing fresh challenges and perspectives to the continuing crime drama.

title: Billy the Kid
plot: This romantic Western follows a young immigrant’s journey from humble beginnings to life as a cowboy and gunslinger on the American frontier. As he becomes entangled in a violent regional conflict, he struggles to choose between doing what is right and the outlaw path closing around him.

title: Shooting Stars
plot: A dynamic public relations executive must work closely with an irksome nemesis who is also a major celebrity client. As professional frustrations build, complicated feelings begin to surface, creating a lively romantic workplace clash filled with tension, misunderstandings, and emotional push and pull.

title: Swimming with Sharks
plot: A seemingly naïve intern joins a powerful Hollywood studio and becomes fascinated by its notorious chief executive. Beneath her starstruck exterior, however, she has carefully researched her idol and secured the position deliberately, driving an increasingly intense pursuit of access and influence.

title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
plot: A sweet, fun-loving high school girl seems like the perfect girlfriend, but she also has a cool, confident side that appears when circumstances call for it. Her boyfriend adores being around her, especially when that tougher side comes out.

title: Spy x Family
plot: A spy, an assassin, and a telepath form a pretend family, each concealing their unusual abilities and true motives. As they try to maintain an ordinary home life, their conflicting secrets create a mix of comedy, heartfelt moments, and exciting complications.

crew.name: Kazuhiro Furuhashi
crew.role: Series Director, Series Composition, Storyboard Artist, Director, Co-Writer

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World
plot: A gamer wakes after falling asleep and discovers he has been transported into a fantastical game world as a skeleton. Armed with powerful equipment but unable to hide his frightening appearance, he seeks a quiet life before an encounter with an elven warrior draws him into conflict and adventure.

title: Tomodachi Game
plot: After their class trip fund disappears, a group of close friends is forced into a dangerous debt repayment game. As they face escalating challenges, their friendships are tested by hidden secrets and growing doubts about who arranged the game.

title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody
plot: After an immensely powerful ruler dies lonely, he uses magic to be reborn thousands of years later as a village boy hoping for an ordinary life. Yet his memories remain, and the changed world makes fitting in far more difficult than expected.

title: I'm Quitting Heroing
plot: After saving humanity, a powerful hero is met with suspicion instead of gratitude and becomes an outcast. With nowhere else to go, he seeks work in the army of his former enemy, only to find its defeated forces in disarray and needing his help to recover.

title: Bloody Brothers
plot: Driving home late one night, two brothers, Jaggi and Daljeet run over an old man. They put the body back in his house, but when people suspect, the brothers' lives fall apart. They realise they can trust no one. Not even each other.

title: The Blue Whisper
plot: Ji Yunhe possesses the rare ability to tame demons, but she is confined to the Demon Valley by strict imperial laws. Her life takes an unexpected turn when Chang Yi, a merman, is brought to her by a cruel princess. The princess orders Yunhe to give Chang Yi human speech and legs, forcing him to pledge loyalty. As Yunhe grows sympathetic toward the merman and falls for him, she longs to set him free. But helping him may come at a great cost, putting both their lives in danger.

cast.name: Guo Xiaoting
cast.role: Ning Xiyu, Shun De Immortal Princess

title: Minx
plot: An earnest young feminist partners with a low-rent publisher to create an erotic magazine for women in the early 1970s. Their ambitious project brings together clashing personalities and competing ideas about sexuality, equality, and what female readers want, offering a provocative workplace comedy with plenty of debate and friction.

title: The Holiday
plot: The story follows Kate, a woman who discovers that her husband is having an affair during a luxurious holiday somewhere in the Mediterranean. The troubled couple are sharing a villa with four of Kate’s closest friends, one of which is the adulterous partner, but she doesn’t realise that the guilty party could be prepared to kill in order to keep their secret safe.

title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
plot: A powerful sage is reincarnated as a young boy to overcome the limits of his original magical crest. In a world where magical knowledge has declined, he must prove that his new crest is ideal for combat while challenging low expectations and helping his companions grow.

title: Campus Diaries
plot: Six students navigate life at a university, balancing friendship, romance, studies, and personal growth. Alongside the fun and nostalgia of campus life, they face difficult issues including ragging, discrimination, drug abuse, one-sided love, and toxic relationships that shape their transition into adulthood.

title: Secrets
plot: When a tragedy strikes, a group of friends learn some secrets are better left buried.

title: Sword Snow Stride
plot: In a time of turmoil, Xu Xiao rises as King of Northern Liang, defeating threats from steppe kingdoms and southern uprisings. His heir, Xu Fengnian, a free-spirited warrior, has spent years mastering his skills while forming alliances, including with the skilled swordswoman Nangong Pushe. Among the royal household is Jiang Ni, a princess from a rival kingdom who may harbor hidden motives. As Xu Fengnian ascends the throne, doubts arise about his ability to uphold his father’s legacy. When a critical campaign looms, the fate of the realm hangs in the balance.

title: Sparklers
plot: A high stakes, high-pressure cooking competition show based on great sparkling wine from around the world.

title: Blanca
plot: Blanca Ferrando is a young woman who became blind at the age of twelve, due to a dramatic fire in which her older sister Beatrice died and which was caused by her violent boyfriend, Sebastian. This tragedy made her develop a very strong sense of justice to the point of pushing her to join the police. Blanca is helped by her most trusted friends: her guide dog Linneo, a female bulldog who protects and comforts her in the most difficult moments, and her beautician friend, Stella. After overcoming her work challenges, she finds herself facing sentimental ones: torn between two men, Inspector Michele Liguori, a man of many secrets, and Nanni, a young cook.

title: Crime Puzzle
plot: "Crime Puzzle" is a story where a criminal psychologist is sent to prison for murdering a political candidate, and the criminal profiler who loses her father to the murder is conducting interviews with the murderer for a case that occurs within the prison. These two used to be lovers just a year ago, until they meet again as a murderer and a criminal profiler, and face the unexpected truth to a series of murders. The thriller focuses on the process of them putting the pieces together, like a puzzle. Adapted from the webtoon "Crime Puzzle" (크라임 퍼즐) by Meen.

title: The Faraway Paladin
plot: In a ruined city far from human civilization, a human boy is raised by three undead guardians who teach him about combat, magic, faith, love, and mercy. As he questions his identity, he begins uncovering the mysteries of the dead city and preparing to follow a greater path.

crew.name: Akio Takami
crew.role: Storyboard Artist, Animation Director, Supervising Animation Director

title: The Fruit of Evolution: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made
plot: A bullied high school student and his classmates are suddenly transported to a video game-like world of swords and sorcery. After accidentally eating a mysterious fruit, he begins a dramatic transformation from an outcast into a confident adventurer.

title: Mieruko-chan
plot: A teenage girl suddenly gains the ability to see terrifying spirits invisible to everyone else. Rather than acknowledge them, she tries to act completely normal, leading to awkward, frightening, and occasionally funny encounters in everyday life.

title: Dali and the Cocky Prince
plot: A strong-willed, unsophisticated man and an upper-class woman struggling with life and work are brought together through an art museum. As their differences create friction, they gradually find unexpected support and romance while navigating personal and professional challenges.

title: Vigil
plot: When a Scottish fishing trawler vanishes and a death occurs aboard a nuclear submarine, a detective is drawn into a tense investigation involving the Navy and British security services. Working between land and sea, she uncovers a conspiracy reaching into the heart of national security.

title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson
plot: Swedish murder investigator Sven Hjerson forms an unexpected detective duo with stubborn TV producer Klara after several years of isolation. Will she also manage to recruit him for her new TV show?

title: Deceit
plot: Based on a true case, this miniseries follows a female undercover officer recruited as sexual bait during a controversial police investigation into the murder of a young mother in London. It explores the toxic sexual politics of the early 1990s and an investigation increasingly focused on the wrong suspect.

title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
plot: A calm dog behavior expert takes on difficult cases involving canine problems shaped by well-meaning but impulsive owners. The series offers practical guidance for both new and experienced dog owners, focusing on better understanding, confidence, and everyday ways to address challenging behavior.

crew.name: Neal Tyler
crew.role: Camera Operator, Producer, Supervising Producer, Co-Executive Producer

title: Mother of the Goddess' Dormitory
plot: After losing his home and struggling to get by, a teenage boy is offered a place at a women’s college dormitory. There, he takes on the unusual role of managing a group of unruly residents, whose eccentric personalities make maintaining order—and his own composure—a constant challenge.
