title: Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist
plot: Reiji Kirio was a corporate wage slave, who did nothing but work all day, every day. On a typical day of walking to work with a hollow look on his face, he suddenly found himself in the forest of another world. "Oh, this must be one of those isekai reincarnations people keep talking about." The two skills he has are "Appraise" and "Drug Discovery." Those don't sound too impressive... well, whatever. Except these turn out to be particularly overpowered skills! And so, a story about following the slow life philosophy while running a drugstore in another world begins.

title: Tsukimichi: Moonlit Fantasy
plot: An ordinary high school student is summoned to a fantasy world and chosen as its hero, only to be rejected by a goddess and cast into the wilderness. Gifted with extraordinary magic and combat skills, he encounters dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves, and other non-human tribes while seeking a place in this unfamiliar world.

title: At A Distance, Spring Is Green
plot: This coming-of-age college drama follows young people navigating friendship, romance, family troubles, financial pressure, and uncertainty about the future. Two students with sharply contrasting personalities unexpectedly become friends while working on a project, gradually opening up about their struggles and learning to support one another.

title: Indori Ishq
plot: First love always remains one of the most cherished experiences in one’s life. The butterflies in your stomach every time your crush passes by, the thoughts of being with them one day, the fear of rejection holding you back and all that comes with it is truly an eccentric feeling. MX Player’s latest original, Indoori Ishq web series explores the excursion of one such love story, which starts with a meet-cute of a high school sweethearts but ends in a rather nasty manner. The Indoori Ishq story revolves around Kunal, who is about to pass out of his school and leave his hometown. Kunal has it all in life- he is leaving his hometown of Indore to pursue his future education in Mumbai where he has a seat secured in one of the country’s best Naval colleges. Not only has he made his parents and everyone proud but is also in a secured relationship with his high school sweetheart, Tara. What could go wrong with him now?

title: 1971: The Year That Music Changed Everything
plot: This documentary series explores a pivotal year when political and cultural upheaval transformed popular music. It follows established stars reaching new heights, emerging talent breaking through, and artists expanding creative boundaries during a period of innovation, change, and musical rebirth.

title: Moonlight
plot: Chu Li joins Yuan Yue Publishing House with dreams of becoming a top editor. Navigating a changing industry, she earns the trust of prominent authors, including the seemingly aloof Zhou Chuan. When Chu Li discovers that her online friend "L Jun" is actually Zhou Chuan, their professional rivalry turns into an unexpected personal connection.

title: Live Telecast
plot: A TV crew goes to a haunted house, where a family lives, to create a new live show that captures ghost on camera, only to be trapped inside with no way of getting out.

title: Udaariyaan
plot: Hailing from a small village in Punjab, the Sandhu family's daughter Jasmine is driven by one obsession: migrate to Canada. A cruel twist of fate, has other plans for the 2 sisters when the dashing Fateh comes to their lives.

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
plot: After a troubled adult dies, he is reincarnated as a baby in a magical world, carrying memories of his former life. Determined to make better choices, he studies magic, builds new relationships, and pursues an adventurous second chance while confronting the challenges of growing up again.

crew.name: Nobuhiro Osawa
crew.role: Executive Producer, Development Producer, Development Manager

title: UFO Witness
plot: Ben Hansen is on a mission to uncover the truth behind UFO sightings across America. With unprecedented access to the archives of famed ufologist Dr. J. Allen Hynek, Ben unlocks the secrets of the past to shed light on today's UFO encounters.

title: Kemono Jihen
plot: When animal bodies mysteriously rot overnight in a remote mountain village, an occult detective investigates with help from a strange boy shunned by the local community. Their search uncovers supernatural forces, hidden truths, and questions about the boy’s unusual nature.

crew.name: Masaya Fujimori
crew.role: Series Director, Opening/Ending Animation, Director, Storyboard Artist

crew.name: Emiko Endo
crew.role: Supervising Animation Director, Opening/Ending Animation, Animation Director, Key Animation

title: Cells at Work! Code Black
plot: Alcohol, smoking, and stress—in the body subjected to these irritants, the cells responsible for maintaining life seem to fight a war that never ends. Due to a severe shortage of workers, Red Blood Cell AA2153 has to quickly learn to deliver oxygen and collect carbon dioxide, even in dangerous conditions. Meanwhile, White Blood Cell U-1196 has to do her part by dealing with germs and viruses during life-threatening situations. In the midst of these crises, they have to work together to keep the body healthy, despite not knowing if their sacrifices will be worthwhile. Cells at Work! Code Black takes a different approach by showing the grittier side of the jobs our cells perform.

title: Suppose a Kid from the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town?
plot: A young adventurer leaves his village for the capital, hoping to discover true strength. Because his hometown lies beside one of the world’s most dangerous dungeons, his idea of weakness may be very different from everyone else’s.

title: Taqdeer
plot: A freezer-van driver discovers an unclaimed woman’s body in his truck, pulling him into a dangerous criminal situation shaped by chance and fate. As he struggles to deal with the discovery, the series follows his increasingly tense journey through a dark and unfamiliar world.

title: True Beauty
plot: After being bullied for her appearance, a high school girl reinvents herself with makeup tutorials and earns a new reputation at school. As romance, friendship, and family pressures complicate her secret, she begins confronting questions about confidence, acceptance, and whether beauty can truly solve her problems.

title: Your Honor
plot: A respected judge faces an impossible moral crisis after his son is involved in a hit-and-run. When the victim’s connection to an organized crime family becomes clear, he is pulled into a dangerous struggle between protecting his child and upholding the law.

title: A Simple Murder
plot: A failed entrepreneur, Manish, has a lot going on in life, personal and professional, when he finds himself involved in a case of mistaken identity and ends up getting a contract to kill a young girl, along with an advance of five lakh rupees. The target is the daughter of an influential politician, who has his eyes on the Hoshiarpur ticket. Amid the chaos, Manish, and his wife, Richa must make choices where either greed will get the better of them or they will find their lost sense of self worth.

title: The Wolf
plot: In a turbulent imperial era, a boy raised in the wild is adopted by a powerful ruler and grows into a prince. Years later, he falls for a governor’s daughter, and their romance draws them into a dangerous struggle involving loyalty, betrayal, and power.

title: Mum Bhai
plot: MUMBhai is the story of the no-nonsense encounter specialist named Bhaskar Shetty. He is tasked with a case that involves the underworld's biggest Don. The show will also feature the rise of this Don and how from the streets of Mumbai he became one of the most feared persons in the world.

title: Something Just Like This
plot: Qian Xi Xi grew up living with Duan Ran, a second-generation heir of a rich family. The two childhood sweethearts are inseparable even after they enter the work force as e-commerce entrepreneurs. They experience ups and downs, obstacles and complications that are beyond what they had imagined. But throughout the process, they made friends with people who share similar ambitions and together, they carve out their own path. Follow their journey of discovering true love and fulfilling their dreams.

title: Heaven Official's Blessing
plot: Banished from the heavens, a deity returns to the mortal realm to carry out exorcism missions and repay old debts. Alongside a mysterious demon, he faces supernatural dangers while gradually uncovering troubling secrets connected to the heavenly gods and his own long history.

title: The Penthouse: War in Life
plot: A determined woman risks everything to earn a place in an exclusive luxury penthouse community. As ambition, rivalry, and social pressure intensify, her pursuit of status begins to change her, pushing her toward increasingly ruthless choices.

title: Moriarty the Patriot
plot: In a sharply divided late-19th-century society, a brilliant young strategist sympathizes with the suffering working class and sets out to challenge the ruling nobility. As an ambitious campaign unfolds, a celebrated consulting detective becomes a formidable obstacle, turning the struggle into a battle of intellect and ideals.

title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
plot: After 30 years without sexual experience, a shy office worker discovers he can read people’s minds through touch. The unexpected ability draws him into the inner thoughts of a popular coworker, leading to a gentle workplace romance shaped by self-doubt, trust, communication, and gradual emotional growth.

title: Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story
plot: Set in 1980s and 1990s Bombay, this miniseries follows an ambitious stockbroker who rises from a middle-class background to remarkable heights in India’s financial markets. As success brings greater attention, the story explores ambition, trust, pressure, and the consequences of challenging a powerful system.

title: Tale of the Nine Tailed
plot: A TV producer is drawn into a hidden supernatural world after encountering a former deity who has spent centuries searching for his lost love. Their connection leads her through romance, mystery, danger, and an emotional journey shaped by forces beyond the ordinary.

title: Redemption
plot: In a nocturnal and hostile Rome, Valerio must investigate the death of his son, an apparently suicide. An investigation that's also a last chance to restore a bond with that son he hadn't seen in years, facing the ghosts of the past.

title: By the Grace of the Gods
plot: After a troubled life ends, a young man is reincarnated in a magical world with extraordinary abilities and a remarkable talent for caring for slimes. Living in the forest, he researches his unusual companions until helping an injured traveler inspires him to leave home and use his skills to aid others.

crew.name: Kaho Deguchi
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Animation Director

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
plot: A physically gifted high school student gains a dangerous curse while trying to save a classmate. Guided by a powerful sorcerer, he joins a school that trains fighters to confront supernatural threats, beginning a life caught between ordinary adolescence and a hidden battle.

crew.name: Tadashi Hiramatsu
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Assistant Director, Opening/Ending Animation, Storyboard Artist, Animation Director, Key Animation

title: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
plot: A practical, solitary ninth grader and two classmates are suddenly transported to another world, where they must cooperate to survive dangerous battles. Used to doing things his own way, he has to face what it means to be part of a team.

title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
plot: A young witch sets out to explore the world she has only known through stories. Traveling from one country to another, she encounters strange, moving, and sometimes difficult situations, gathering new experiences as her curiosity broadens her understanding of people and life.

title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
plot: A young adventurer sets out to become a legendary hero, guided by loyal companions and determined mentors. As an ancient evil threatens the world once more, he trains, faces dangerous challenges, and discovers what courage and friendship truly require.

title: Love is Sweet
plot: A driven woman leaves philanthropy to honor her late father’s wish and joins a top investment firm. Facing fierce competition and a complicated history with a childhood friend turned rival, she uses intelligence and resilience to navigate workplace challenges, uncover hidden schemes, and pursue success in career and love.

title: 18 Again
plot: At a difficult point in his marriage and career, a middle-aged man receives an unexpected chance to start over when he is transformed into his 18-year-old body. Balancing school life with adult responsibilities, he begins to see his family and past choices differently.

title: Des
plot: This three-part crime drama examines the investigation and legal aftermath of a notorious case through three perspectives: a police detective seeking answers, a writer studying the accused, and the man at the center of the case. It focuses on the personal, professional, and institutional consequences of confronting an apparently ordinary but deeply disturbing criminal.

title: Aashram
plot: A charismatic spiritual leader builds an influential religious empire while hiding criminal activities involving abuse, murder, drugs, political manipulation, and forced emasculation. As the law and a few determined crusaders investigate, they confront a powerful system built on fear, loyalty, and blind faith.

title: Lego Jurassic World: Double Trouble
plot: LEGO Jurassic World is open for business, but with a few changes. A sibling rivalry has lead to new management, but things get out of hand quick when the new boss goes off the rails.

title: The Gone Game
plot: Set during the pandemic, this thriller follows a man who goes missing, and what first seems like a health tragedy soon starts pointing to something far more suspicious. As questions grow, his sister and father begin digging for the truth on their own.

title: The Deceived
plot: English student Ophelia falls in love with her married lecturer, seeing in him all the answers to her needs. When their affair is interrupted by a shocking and tragic death, Ophelia finds herself trapped in a world where she can no longer trust her own mind.

title: Flower of Evil
plot: A man hides a troubling past behind the image of a devoted husband and father. When his detective wife investigates a series of murders, their family life becomes entangled with a dangerous case that challenges trust, identity, and the meaning of love.

title: Rent-a-Girlfriend
plot: After a painful breakup, a college student turns to a rental-dating service and meets a seemingly perfect young woman. What begins as a paid date becomes complicated when their lives unexpectedly overlap, forcing them to maintain the appearance of a real relationship while feelings and misunderstandings grow.

crew.name: Takuya Wada
crew.role: Prop Designer, Key Animation, Animation Director

title: Love Is in the Air
plot: A determined young woman whose education plans are disrupted agrees to pretend to be engaged to the man who caused her setback. What begins as a reluctant arrangement soon develops into a passionate and challenging relationship that changes how they see love.

title: The God of High School
plot: A self-proclaimed strongest high schooler is invited to a tournament where powerful students battle for the chance to have any wish granted. As each contender fights for personal goals, the competition quickly becomes a chaotic showcase of extraordinary abilities and intense rivalries.

title: Ghost Dimension Lock Down
plot: Ghost Dimension Lock Down's paranormal investigators tackle the UK's most haunted buildings searching for paranormal activity. While the world is on lock down, it appears that the ghosts are not. Will the spirits come out and join the team from isolation?

title: Coyote Peterson: Brave the Wild
plot: Coyote Peterson and his Brave Wilderness crew plunge into the rain forest of Costa Rica where they encounter Central America's most lethal pit viper! The journey is strewn with obstacles and danger as we Return to the Wilderness!

title: Raktanchal
plot: Inspired by real events, this crime drama follows a young criminal seeking revenge against a powerful tender mafia leader. As rival gangs fight to control lucrative development contracts, political interests deepen the conflict, unleashing violence across the city and forcing the ambitious challenger to overcome personal obstacles.

title: And the Winner Is Love
plot: Chong Xuezhi, the young mistress of Chonghuo Palace, and Shangguan Tou, master of Yueshang Valley, overcome misunderstandings to stop Mu Yuan, who practices the dangerous "Nine Techniques of the Lotus God," and restore peace to the jianghu.

title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats
plot: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. This series looks at seven different members of the big cat family from around the world, from the tigers of Asia to the jaguars of South America.

title: Benza English
plot: The cast from the hit Japanese comedy "The Benza" returns in this outlandish, outrageous spin off series that will teach you all the English you never knew you needed to know.

title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
plot: After recovering memories of a past life, a wealthy heiress realizes she has been reborn inside a romance game as its villainess. Facing several possible disastrous endings, she uses her knowledge of the game to prepare, avoid conflict, and build unexpected friendships at a magical academy.

title: Bhaukaal
plot: A newly appointed senior police officer arrives in a lawless city and confronts the chaos surrounding him. Two powerful gangs control opposing sides of the region, forcing him to challenge entrenched criminal networks while trying to restore order.

title: When the Weather Is Fine
plot: Drained by city life, a young cellist returns to a quiet small town and reconnects with an old friend. Among its bookstore, book club, and close-knit residents, she gradually faces long-held pain while discovering the comfort of friendship, family, and a gentler way of living.

title: Maddam Sir - Kuch Baat Hai Kyunki Jaazbaat Hai
plot: Set in Lucknow, the show revolves around an all-women police station led by four quirky women. Pushpa, the oldest, is a head constable balancing work and family. Karishma, the hot-headed Sub-Inspector, struggles with the station’s reconciliation-driven philosophy. Santosh Sharma, a young recruit, navigates loneliness in the city. Their leader, S.H.O. Haseena Mallik, is witty and romantic, leading by example. Adding an amusing twist, a male constable, Cheetah Chaturvedi, works there and is smitten with Santosh. Together, they tackle unique cases with sensitivity while infusing humor and drama into their daily policing. Pushpa and Karishma’s mother-in-law/daughter-in-law banter adds comedy, while ideological clashes between Haseena and Karishma fuel the drama. The show’s blend of eccentric cases and engaging characters makes for an entertaining and heartfelt story.

title: In/Spectre
plot: A young woman serving as a supernatural community’s goddess of wisdom spends her days solving strange problems. When she teams up with a mysterious young man feared by otherworldly beings, the pair confronts unusual incidents that blend romance, mystery, and fantasy.

title: The New Pope
plot: With the current pope in a coma, a charming, sophisticated English aristocrat is elevated to the papal throne and takes on a new name. As he settles into the role, the miniseries explores power, faith, politics, and the human weaknesses within the Church.

cast.name: John Malkovich
cast.role: Giovanni Paolo III / Sir John Brannox

title: The Murders at White House Farm
plot: A factual crime drama revisits a notorious farm murder case, following the police investigation and the legal proceedings that follow. As investigators examine the evidence and competing claims, the series explores how the case develops and how different perspectives shape the search for answers.

title: Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, So I'll Max Out My Defense
plot: A young player joins a virtual reality MMO at a friend's invitation and builds a character focused entirely on defense to avoid pain. Though this choice leaves her slow and limited at first, it soon gives her remarkable protection and unexpected abilities as she explores the game world.

title: Overflow
plot: A university student’s quiet routine is disrupted when two childhood friends, who are sisters, visit him. After a petty dispute involving forgotten dessert and personal bath products, the sisters turn the situation into a provocative game that tests his ability to stay composed.

title: My Feet Are Killing Me
plot: Medical docu-format following Dr. Ebonie Vincent & Dr. Brad Schaefer as they tackle foot problems. Everything from grave ailments and cosmetic procedures to foot reconstruction. Each episode sees endearing patients undergo treatment to fix embarrassing foot problems with unbelievable results.

title: Van der Valk
plot: Set in Amsterdam, a detective and his diverse team investigate high-profile cases linked to the worlds of art, politics, addiction, mysticism and fashion. Each inquiry brings unusual suspects, complex motives and a striking city backdrop as the team works to uncover the truth.

title: My Home My Destiny
plot: A young woman raised in poverty and given up for adoption grows into an educated adult living a seemingly perfect life. When her biological mother returns, she is pulled toward the world she left behind and an intense relationship shaped by family, class, and the search for belonging.

title: Raja Rani Chi Ga Jodi
plot: Ranjit, a police officer, falls in love with Sanjeevani, a teenager. Their love faces major hurdle: their age difference. Can they overcome this obstacle?

title: Montu Pilot
plot: Trapped in the forbidden alleys of the city - is a broken man. Can he find love in the dark world of flesh trade?

title: Joy of Life
plot: A present-day student explores history through a fictional tale about a young man with a mysterious past, raised in a remote seaside town under unusual guidance. As he reaches the capital, he faces political schemes, danger, and personal trials while holding firmly to justice and goodness.

title: Vienna Blood
plot: In early twentieth-century Vienna, a young doctor interested in emerging psychological theories assists a skeptical detective investigating a series of disturbing murders. Their contrasting approaches gradually develop into an effective partnership as each case leads them through the city’s grand and shadowy social worlds.

title: Cooku with Comali
plot: Cooku with Comali, also known by the acronym CWC, is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show aired on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar where the contestants are paired each week with comedians (comalis) who are amateur cooks. The first season premiered on 16 November 2019 and ended on 23 February 2020. The second season was premiered on 14 November 2020 and ended on 14 April 2021. The third season was premiered on 22 January 2022 and ended on 24 July 2022. The contestants along with their comalis are challenged every week and judged by Chef Damu and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.

title: Taffy
plot: The series follows a grey raccoon, Scraggs, who gets adopted by Mrs. Muchmore after thinking he is a cat named Taffy. Her main pet, a blue dobermann named Bentley, is determined to reveal Taffy's secret to Mrs. Muchmore that he really is a raccoon.

title: Dhanbad Blues
plot: Mrinal Sen is a failed director whose life takes a turn when he gets an opportunity to direct a film in Jharkhand.

title: Apharan
plot: A senior police inspector is drawn into kidnapping a young woman at her request, expecting a straightforward ransom scheme. When the plan spirals out of control and competing lies emerge, he becomes entangled in a dangerous conspiracy shaped by his own choices.

title: Body Cam
plot: This series presents real body-camera footage from police patrols, showing officers facing unpredictable, high-pressure situations on the front line. Firsthand accounts and incident footage offer an intense look at the dangers, split-second decisions, and teamwork involved in trying to keep people safe.

title: Broken But Beautiful
plot: Two people, each deeply hurt after losing someone they loved, find their lives unexpectedly brought together again. As old wounds meet the possibility of new romance, they must decide whether to risk their hearts and give love another chance.

title: Clean with Passion for Now
plot: A meticulous cleaning-company boss struggles with an intense fear of germs and disorder. After meeting a carefree young woman who joins his company, their opposing habits create comic clashes, unexpected understanding, and a developing romance as he begins confronting long-held emotional difficulties.

title: The History of Food
plot: Go back in time to our earliest hunter-gatherer beginnings all the way to the future of seed storage and food production.

title: Mama Fairy and the Woodcutter
plot: A wingless fairy awaits the reincarnation of her former husband to try to locate her lost wings and return to heaven. Sun Ok Nam is a fairy who came down to Earth to take a bath during the Joseon Dynasty. A woodcutter steals her clothes, and she is unable to return to heaven. She decides to marry the woodcutter and has two children with him. But before she can find out where he hid her clothes, the woodcutter dies in an accident. Almost 700 years later, Ok Nam works as a barista in a café, awaiting the reincarnation of her woodcutter husband. To most people who see her, Ok Nam looks like an old woman, but some people can see her for her youthful beauty. When two men, Jung Ji Hyun and Kim Geum, come into the café one day, Ok Nam is convinced that one of them is her reincarnated husband. Can Ok Nam finally find her lost clothes and return to heaven?

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
plot: A family runs a remarkable wildlife zoo in northern Australia, caring for more than 1,200 animals and supporting a busy wildlife hospital. Their work also takes them on adventurous conservation expeditions, all driven by a deep love of animals and a commitment to protecting them.

title: Smoke
plot: Set in Goa, this crime series follows a dangerous web of drug trafficking, organized crime, and power struggles as rival cartels battle for control. Amid shifting alliances and mounting tension, several lives become entangled in a volatile underworld where survival is uncertain.

title: Goblin Slayer
plot: In a remote adventurers’ guild, a newly qualified priestess joins her first party for a seemingly simple mission. When the group encounters serious trouble, a highly ranked specialist devoted exclusively to hunting goblins comes to their aid, setting her on a darker path through a dangerous fantasy world.

crew.name: Takaharu Ozaki
crew.role: Series Director, Director, Storyboard Artist, Key Animation

title: Zombieland Saga
plot: Seven girls are unexpectedly brought together as zombies and pushed into forming an idol group. While trying to perform, hide their unusual condition, and build a new life, they face absurd setbacks, heartfelt challenges, and the pressure of achieving an unlikely dream.

crew.name: Munehisa Sakai
crew.role: Series Director, Sound Director, Director, Storyboard Artist, Assistant Director

title: Run with the Wind
plot: A former elite runner is taken in by a university student who hopes to assemble a team for a major collegiate marathon. Living with residents who are mostly complete novices, he must adjust to an unexpected group effort while they train toward an ambitious shared goal.

crew.name: Hideki Takahashi
crew.role: Lead Animator, Animation Director, Key Animation

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
plot: After a fatal encounter, a corporate worker is reborn in a fantasy world as a slime. Embracing this strange new life, the powerful newcomer gathers allies, navigates conflicts among different monster races, and works toward building a welcoming society.

title: RadhaKrishn
plot: A mythological drama explores an enduring bond between a young woman and a divine figure, presenting their love as something that transcends time and emotion. Alongside romance, it offers spiritual lessons, childhood stories, devotion, and challenges shaped by ideas of duty, destiny, and eternal connection.

title: Where Stars Land
plot: At a busy airport, a brilliant but distant engineer and a clumsy, idealistic rookie begin working together while facing demanding workplace challenges. As their relationship develops, personal secrets, unexpected connections, and the everyday pressures of airport life bring emotional complications and moments of warmth.

title: Beauty Inside
plot: A celebrated actress and an airline director begin a romance while dealing with unusual conditions: she transforms into a different person for one week each month, while he struggles to recognize faces. Their relationship brings comedy, emotional challenges, friendship, and questions about acceptance, empathy, and inner beauty.

title: Fights Break Sphere
plot: Once a prodigy, Xiao Yan loses all his powers and becomes the shame of his family—until he awakens a master from his mother’s ring, unlocking his true potential and setting out on a journey of revenge and redemption in the martial world.

title: Lovely Horribly
plot: Philip and Eul Soon are bound by an unusual fate: one’s happiness always results in the other’s misfortune. The two start writing a drama together, and the events in the screenplay mysteriously begin occurring in real life.

title: My ID Is Gangnam Beauty
plot: Bullied over her appearance, a young woman enters college after cosmetic surgery, hoping for a fresh start. Instead, she faces judgment, complicated relationships, and the pressure to prove that her worth goes beyond how she looks.

title: Still 17
plot: After waking from a thirteen-year coma, a young woman must adjust to a world that has changed while she searches for the life and family she remembers. A withdrawn set designer carrying painful memories becomes involved in her journey, and together they gradually find comfort, connection, and the courage to move forward.

title: Grand Blue Dreaming
plot: A college freshman joins a local diving club after meeting its rowdy upperclassmen. Instead of focusing solely on ocean adventures, his new life brings wild parties, drinking, pranks, awkward friendships, and plenty of chaotic comedy.

crew.name: Shinji Takamatsu
crew.role: Storyboard Artist, Series Director, Director, Sound Director, Series Composition, Writer

title: Yeh Meri Family
plot: Set during the summer of 1998, this coming-of-age family series follows a twelve-year-old boy as he navigates changing feelings toward his parents, siblings, friends, and everyday life. Through school, neighborhood adventures, misunderstandings, and family moments, it captures the warmth and complications of growing up in a middle-class Indian household.

title: Cells at Work!
plot: Inside the human body, trillions of cells work constantly to keep their world functioning. Red blood cells deliver oxygen, while white blood cells fight invading germs, as everyday processes and health problems become lively, educational adventures.

title: How NOT to Summon a Demon Lord
plot: A powerful MMORPG player is summoned to another world in his avatar’s form, where two girls claim responsibility for calling him there. Their attempt to enslave him backfires, leaving them bound by the spell and launching an irreverent adventure centered on an overwhelmingly strong, self-styled demon lord.

crew.name: Masaya Fujimori
crew.role: Storyboard Artist, Key Animation, Animation Director

title: Daydreamer
plot: A dreamy young woman takes a job at an advertising agency to avoid an arranged marriage and pursue her writing ambitions. There, she meets her boss and becomes caught in a whirlwind romance filled with teasing, misunderstandings, workplace complications, and difficult choices about love and dreams.

title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim
plot: A wealthy, arrogant vice-president is stunned when his highly capable secretary decides to resign after years of dedicated service. Determined to understand her decision and keep her close, he begins to see their professional relationship differently, leading to workplace banter, romantic tension, and discoveries about their shared past.

cast.name: Lee Se-young
cast.role: Staff who talked behind Kim Mi So's back

title: Are You Human Too?
plot: After the heir to a powerful company falls into a coma, his mother creates an android duplicate to take his place. The android must navigate corporate rivalries, conceal his true nature, and work with a bodyguard while questions about identity, emotion, and humanity grow more complicated.

title: Chacha Vidhayak Hain Humare
plot: A jobless young man builds his identity around a false claim that he is related to a local politician. As friends and neighbors believe him, he becomes trapped in increasingly complicated situations, balancing family expectations, romance, and the consequences of his elaborate lie.

title: Come and Hug Me
plot: When they were children, Yoon Na Moo and Gil Nak Won were each others first love. They are forced to break apart when Na Moo's father Yoon Hee Jae, a psychopath serial killer, murders Nak Won's parents. 9 years later Yoon Na Moo is known as Chae Do Jin, a passionate and kind rookie detective wishing to atone for his father's sins. And Gil Nak Won is now Han Jae Yi, an aspiring actress following in the footsteps of her mother. She suffers from a panic disorder but still has a good outlook on life. However, the sadness of their past comes to light again and their short-lived encounter is over before it began. Another three years on, Jae Yi has become a popular actress and Do Jin is now an experienced detective. When their fate becomes connected once more, will their love prove to be stronger than their past?

title: Innocent
plot: After seven years in prison, a man is acquitted of murdering his wife and tries to rebuild his shattered life. As he seeks to reconnect with his children, police reopen the investigation, while suspicion and old tensions continue to affect those around him.

title: Lawless Lawyer
plot: A former gangster turned lawyer returns to his hometown, determined to avenge his mother. Using courtroom strategy, street-hardened instincts, and the help of a bold fellow lawyer, he challenges a powerful network of corruption and fights for justice.

title: Ossan's Love
plot: First his boss shocks him with a confession of love, then his roommate. Maybe one of them is Soichi's Mr. Right after all.

title: Last Period: the journey to the end of the despair
plot: There is a world where fantastic beasts called "Spirals" are born from isolation. Those who can defeat the beasts are called "Periods." Haru is an apprentice Period who belongs to the Arc End 8th Branch. However, after a mysterious theft incident, there is an economic collapse, and the Arc End headquarters abandons the 8th Division, leaving only three Periods left, including Haru. Haru and the other two Periods start their work to rebuild the 8th Division.

title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online
plot: A college student discovers a virtual reality shooter where she can become the small, confident avatar she always wanted. After earning a fierce reputation in the game, she is invited by a gaming friend to join a competitive team battle.

title: Captain Tsubasa
plot: A passionate elementary school soccer player moves with his mother to a city known for its strong youth teams. Once the best player in his hometown, he faces tougher competition and must develop his skills while pursuing his dream of becoming an outstanding footballer.

title: Something in the Rain
plot: A coffee shop supervisor in her 30s reconnects with a younger man who has just returned from working abroad. What begins as a familiar friendship gradually develops into a genuine romance, while workplace pressures, family expectations, social norms, and personal complications test their relationship.

title: Forbidden Apple
plot: Two sisters with very different values are drawn into Istanbul’s glamorous, dangerous high society. As one pursues wealth and status while the other becomes involved with a powerful boss, marriages, rivalries and shifting alliances fuel an escalating web of desire, manipulation and betrayal.

title: Tempted
plot: A privileged young man treats love like a game when he accepts a bet to seduce a college student. As their relationship develops, genuine feelings complicate the scheme and strain the bonds among a group of wealthy friends.

title: Stargate Origins
plot: In 1928, a young woman witnesses her father uncover an ancient gateway in Giza. Years later, she embarks on an unexpected adventure to unlock the mystery of what lies beyond it and protect Earth from an unimaginable darkness.

title: Welcome to Waikiki
plot: Three struggling friends run a guesthouse in Seoul while chasing creative dreams. One hopes to direct movies, another pursues acting despite limited success, and a third wants to become a screenwriter; together, their financial troubles, failed ambitions, and chaotic daily lives create plenty of comedic situations and heartfelt moments.

title: The New Legends of Monkey
plot: A teenage girl joins three fallen gods on a dangerous journey to end a demonic reign of chaos and restore balance to their world. This playful fantasy adventure offers a modern, family-friendly take on a classic tale.

title: Mother
plot: A young girl named Hye-Na is abused by her mother, Ja-Young. Although she is not okay, she tells other people she is alright. Soo-Jin is a temporary teacher at the elementary school where Hye-Na attends. Soo-Jin is aware of her situation and decides to become her mother.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
plot: Gold miners Dakota Fred and his son Dustin are back – returning to McKinley Creek Alaska, determined to make a fortune no matter the risk. But to find the big gold payout, they'll put their lives on the line by diving deep beneath the raging waters of one of Alaska's wildest creeks.

title: Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san
plot: A middle school boy keeps trying to outsmart the clever girl who sits beside him, turning their everyday encounters into playful contests. Determined to make her blush at least once, he comes up with new plans, but her teasing and quick thinking repeatedly leave him flustered.

crew.name: Takuji Mogi
crew.role: Supervising Animation Director, Animation Director, Key Animation

title: School Babysitters
plot: After losing their parents, two brothers are taken in by the chairwoman of a school. In return, the older brother must attend classes and help run an understaffed daycare, caring for teachers’ young children alongside other students.

crew.name: Kentaro Matsumoto
crew.role: Prop Designer, Key Animation, Animation Director

title: Murderous Minds: Inside Serial Killers
plot: Regarding criminality, not many genres inspire as much horror and revulsion as that of a serial killer. A predator in the most savage form. A beastly figure usually preying on the weak, innocent and vulnerable. Deeply-embedded negative and sometimes horrific experiences are the usual catalysts for their reign of terror. Take a look inside these murderous minds.

title: Junji Ito Collection
plot: This animated horror anthology presents short, unsettling stories filled with strange curses, supernatural encounters, grotesque transformations, and deeply disturbing mysteries. Each episode offers a different nightmare, with varied characters and situations connected mainly by their eerie tone and macabre imagination.

crew.name: Shinobu Tagashira
crew.role: Series Director, Storyboard Artist, Character Designer

title: IDOLiSH7
plot: Working at an agency owned by your father, seven new idols await. They are all part of an idol unit IDOLiSH7, and each of them have unique personalities. It is your task to manage them. In order to achieve the same goals, as manager and idols together, you gather the seven ununified hearts and aim for the top.

title: Counterpart
plot: A weary bureaucrat at a secretive international agency discovers that his workplace guards a passage to a parallel world. When an investigation involving a dangerous operative reaches his personal life, he is drawn into a tense alliance and a mystery that challenges his understanding of identity and loyalty.

title: I'm Not a Robot
plot: A wealthy man with a severe allergy to human contact lives in isolation until he agrees to test an advanced humanoid robot. When the robot becomes unavailable, an inventive woman pretends to be it, drawing him into an unexpected relationship while helping him reconnect with the world.

title: Porus
plot: The story of Indian warrior Porus and his life especially the Battle of the Hydaspes with the Great Alexander.

title: A Love So Beautiful
plot: A budding artist and her handsome, emotionally distant neighbor navigate school, family challenges, friendship, and the awkward joys of growing up. As their bond changes over time, first love brings both tender moments and painful setbacks.

title: Motherland
plot: A sitcom about the competitive, chaotic, and often unromantic realities of middle-class motherhood. Working parents navigate school routines, social cliques, everyday pressures, and the awkward struggles that come with trying to keep family life on track.

title: S.W.A.T.
plot: A Los Angeles S.W.A.T. sergeant leads a highly skilled unit in the community where he grew up. Balancing loyalty to local residents with allegiance to the police, he navigates dangerous operations while managing the tensions between two worlds.

title: Woman
plot: A devoted mother raises her two children while carrying the pain of being abandoned and losing the family members who cared for her. Just when she believes she is completely alone, she meets a man she comes to love, opening a new chapter in her difficult life.

title: Mere Sai
plot: The story of a man that travelled to Shirdi in early 1856 CE to be close to the resting place (Samadhi) of his guru. Through his spiritual journey and the support he showed to the people of Shirdi, his teachings became a way of life for people and that’s how he became Sai Baba.

title: The Brave
plot: A highly trained military team carries out dangerous missions behind enemy lines while navigating the personal sacrifices that come with their work. Their operations take them through varied locations and situations, testing their unity, judgment, and ability to survive under pressure.

title: Our Story
plot: A young woman gives up school and her dreams to raise her five younger siblings after their mother leaves and their alcoholic father fails to provide for them. When a mysterious man enters her life and falls for her, she must decide whether love can fit into her overwhelming family responsibilities.

title: What the Folks
plot: What The Folks' is a journey of how modern families are breaking stereotypes, overcoming generation gaps, and growing to love one another, despite having starkly different world views.

title: Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi
plot: A mature love story follows a successful business tycoon and a nutritionist as they navigate romance, family expectations, and the complicated bonds that shape their lives. With a realistic, emotionally grounded approach, the series explores love, respect, humor, and everyday relationship challenges.

title: Descendants of the Sun
plot: After a chance meeting in a hospital, a dedicated soldier and a talented surgeon are drawn to each other. Their opposing views about duty, risk, and saving lives create obstacles as they face demanding circumstances far from home.

title: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
plot: After a traffic accident, a young man is offered a chance to start over in a fantasy world. Bringing a goddess along, he hopes for a peaceful life, but their dysfunctional group becomes entangled in adventures, monsters, money troubles, and the looming threat of a demon king.

title: The Coroner
plot: A high-flying solicitor returns to the seaside town she left as a teenager to become coroner. Working as an advocate for the dead, she investigates sudden, violent, and unexplained deaths while reconnecting with a place and community from her past.

title: Ash vs Evil Dead
plot: An aging monster hunter who has spent decades avoiding responsibility is forced back into action when a supernatural plague threatens humanity. With a chainsaw hand, reckless attitude, and unlikely allies, he battles grotesque creatures while confronting the consequences of his past.

title: Crime Patrol Dial 100
plot: Fictional representation of real life crime cases in India. The host dissects some of the most gruesome crimes encountered by police forces across India while re-enactments display the situations faced by the victims.

title: Naagin
plot: A shape-shifting snake with extraordinary powers takes human form and moves through different roles, including wife, seductress, mistress, and damsel in distress. Behind these transformations is a determined mission of revenge, blending supernatural fantasy with romance, danger, and intrigue.

title: Endless Love
plot: A young artist is forced to put her love story aside while protecting a family secret. As passion, loyalty, and hidden tensions collide, she must navigate difficult choices that threaten both her relationships and her sense of hope.

title: One Punch Man
plot: An overwhelmingly powerful hero battles monsters and other threats while struggling with boredom, lost motivation, and the everyday frustrations of life in a world filled with flashy heroes. His unusual partnership with an intense young cyborg brings comedy, action, and a fresh take on familiar superhero and anime conventions.

title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
plot: A close-knit group of friends sets out in a van for a final summer road trip filled with fun and adventure. At nearly every stop, they encounter havoc-wreaking monsters and must work together to uncover what is really behind the strange happenings.

title: Attack on Titan: Junior High
plot: Familiar characters from a serious action series are reimagined as students and teachers at a school for young Titans. This playful parody turns the original’s intense world into a cartoonish alternate universe filled with school antics, comedic situations, and callbacks aimed especially at longtime fans.

crew.name: Yoshihide Ibata
crew.role: Director, Storyboard Artist, Series Director, Writer

title: She Was Pretty
plot: A woman reconnects with her childhood first love while hiding behind a changed identity. As they work together, misunderstandings and romantic complications grow, testing their feelings and challenging assumptions about appearance, success, and who people become over time.

title: Murder Maps
plot: This drama-documentary series takes us back in time to the most shocking and surprising murder cases in London, England's history. Nicholas Day guides us into the world of the killer as we see how police ingenuity and early forensics helped bring them to justice.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
plot: At a busy veterinary clinic in Denver, an unconventional emergency vet and his team care for a wide range of animals. With no typical day on the schedule, each case brings urgent challenges for pets and the people who depend on them.

title: The Scholar Who Walks the Night
plot: When Jo Yang Sun is driven out of house and home after her father is framed for a crime, she is forced to crossdress in order to make ends meet as a bookseller, where she meets Kim Sung Yeol, a handsome, but mysterious scholar who is actually a vampire. Meanwhile, an evil presence at the royal palace stops at nothing to keep the Crown Prince from claiming his rightful throne.

title: Overlord
plot: In 2138, a dedicated gamer remains online when a popular virtual reality game shuts down, only to awaken as his skeletal wizard avatar in a changing world. As non-player characters develop emotions and loyalty, he explores his new reality and seeks to establish control over it.

crew.name: Naoyuki Ito
crew.role: Series Director, Storyboard Artist, Key Animation

title: Oh My Ghost
plot: A timid sous chef who can communicate with ghosts finds her life transformed when a seductive spirit possesses her. Suddenly more confident and outgoing, she catches the attention of her talented boss while becoming involved in a supernatural mystery that blends romance, comedy, heartfelt relationships, and danger.

title: TVF Pitchers
plot: Four young entrepreneurs leave their day jobs to build a startup together. As they search for the right investor and face the pressures of uncertainty, friendship, ambition, teamwork, and personal doubt shape their challenging journey.

title: The Producers
plot: A rookie producer joins a major television network to stay close to a secret crush and is swept into the chaotic world of variety shows. As ratings, workplace pressures, and complicated relationships collide, the new arrival learns how demanding—and unexpectedly funny—network life can be.

title: Who Are You: School 2015
plot: After an accident leaves her with memory loss, a bullied orphaned student is drawn into the life of a missing girl who looks exactly like her. At a new school, she navigates identity questions, friendships, romance, family pressures, and the lasting effects of bullying.

title: Food Wars: Shokugeki no Soma
plot: A talented young chef enters an elite culinary academy, where ambitious students face demanding tests and dramatic cooking battles. Determined to prove himself, he relies on creativity, confidence, and hard-earned experience while navigating intense rivalries and the pressures of a school where failure can mean expulsion.

title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai
plot: Two neighboring couples live side by side, while both husbands secretly admire each other's wives. Their attempts to impress them lead to playful schemes, misunderstandings, and chaotic conflicts at home, creating a lighthearted sitcom built around family life, comic personalities, and constantly changing situations.

title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
plot: Follow Award-winning pool designer Lucas Congdon and his crew as they tackle unprecedented designs, challenging clients, malfunctioning equipment, weather crises, unforgiving materials, and much more in their quest to build breathtaking natural wonders in every day backyards.

title: Kids Baking Championship
plot: Hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

title: Schitt's Creek
plot: A once-wealthy family loses everything and is forced to start over in a small town they previously bought as a joke. As they adjust to modest living, their clashing personalities create plenty of awkward situations, dry humor, and unexpected opportunities for personal growth.

title: Assassination Classroom
plot: A class of overlooked students must assassinate their extraordinary teacher before graduation, or he will destroy Earth within a year. As they train for the impossible mission, their unusual lessons help them grow stronger, face personal challenges, and form an unexpectedly meaningful bond.

title: Expedition Unknown
plot: A charismatic host travels across the globe investigating unsolved mysteries, legendary stories, archaeological questions, and unusual historical claims. Each expedition brings remote locations, local experts, challenging journeys, and hands-on research, blending travel, adventure, history, and lighthearted humor in an accessible entertainment format.

title: Kill Me, Heal Me
plot: A wealthy heir living with seven distinct personalities secretly seeks help from a young female doctor. As they work together, their unusual situation brings humor, emotional struggles, family pressure, and a deeper connection shaped by their shared past.

title: Top Million Dollar Agent
plot: Top Million Dollar Agent is a new reality television show that showcases the best in luxury real estate around the world. Each episode features a couple looking to invest in a knockout property, aided by a cast of top Toronto real estate agents. After touring four multi-million dollar properties, the couple has to choose which home is the perfect fit.

title: Healer
plot: A star reporter, an inexperienced journalist, and a mysterious man known by a code name become connected through a long-buried incident. As they investigate its hidden truths, their lives intertwine through danger, secrets, action, humor, and romance.

title: Murder Book
plot: From the moment a slaying is reported, authorities assemble a "Murder Book" to document details of the investigation, starting from the crime scene and ending with the arrest of the perpetrator. Murder Books and the stories within them have been confidential until now. Investigation Discovery's MURDER BOOK reopens recently solved cold cases to reveal the chilling details behind the crime.

title: Pinocchio
plot: Two young people pursue careers in journalism for deeply personal reasons. One hopes to follow a family example despite an unusual condition that makes lying difficult, while the other wants to uncover the truth behind a painful past, confronting the media’s influence along the way.

title: Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works]
plot: A young mage enters a deadly supernatural tournament alongside a powerful servant. After rescuing a classmate who becomes involved, she joins him and his summoned warrior to uncover the forces behind the conflict while he struggles with his determination to become a hero.

crew.name: Tomonori Sudo
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Animation Director

crew.name: Atsushi Ikariya
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Animation Director, Key Animation

crew.name: Seiji Matsuda
crew.role: Compositing Artist, 3D Animator, Assistant Director of Photography

title: Your Lie in April
plot: A gifted pianist loses his ability to play after a devastating personal loss, leaving his days empty. When an expressive violinist enters his life, her bold spirit and unusual approach to music inspire him to face the past, rediscover his voice, and reconnect with friendship, love, and the joy of performing.

crew.name: Akira Takata
crew.role: Prop Designer, Animation Director, Opening/Ending Animation

title: Parasyte: The Maxim
plot: Parasitic aliens infiltrate humanity by taking over vulnerable hosts and feeding on people. When one fails to reach a high school student's brain, it settles in his right hand instead, forcing them to coexist while confronting other parasites and the threat they pose to society.

title: Somebody's Gotta Do It
plot: Mike Rowe visits unique individuals and joins them in their respective undertakings, paying tribute to innovators, do-gooders, entrepreneurs, collectors, fanatics–people who simply have to do it. This show is about passion, purpose, and occasionally, hobbies that get a little out of hand.

title: Ghost Asylum
plot: A paranormal investigation team hunt for ghosts in asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals in this reality series.

title: Discovery of Love
plot: Han Yeo-reum is a furniture designer who owns a workshop space that she shares with other designers. For the past three years, she's been dating Nam Ha-jin, a plastic surgeon with a sweet and gentle personality. But Yeo-reum's peaceful existence is shaken when her ex-boyfriend Kang Tae-ha suddenly reappears in her life. The CEO of an interior design company, Tae-ha is a smart, confident man with a strong competitive edge who always gets what he wants. Meanwhile, Ha-jin's childhood friend Ahn Ah-rim has secretly been carrying a torch for him all these years. As she begins working with Tae-ha, Yeo-reum is forced to reevaluate her romantic history, which sets her off on a search for true love.

title: Kaisi Yeh Yaariyan
plot: Manik and Nandini's fairy tale love faces shadows that threaten their promised world of light. Can their bond prevail or will it crumble under darkness?

title: Terror in Resonance
plot: After a devastating terrorist attack strikes Tokyo, police investigate a cryptic online video that may reveal who is responsible. Two mysterious teenage boys, operating under the name Sphinx, launch a series of dangerous challenges while a troubled young woman becomes entangled in their plans and the growing national crisis.

crew.name: Kazuto Nakazawa
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Key Animation, Animation Director

crew.name: Shinichiro Watanabe
crew.role: Storyboard Artist, Original Concept, Original Story, Director

title: Tokyo Ghoul
plot: A shy, book-loving college student meets a girl who shares his interests, only to become entangled in a hidden world of flesh-eating ghouls. Struggling between ordinary human life and his new reality, he must face difficult choices while finding unexpected allies and enemies.

title: Fated to Love You
plot: After a one-night stand unexpectedly results in pregnancy, a wealthy business heir and an ordinary office worker enter a marriage neither planned. As they face family pressures, personal disappointments, and changing feelings, their awkward arrangement develops into an emotional romantic journey filled with comedy, conflict, and heartfelt moments.

title: Badi Door Se Aaye Hain
plot: Badi dooooor se aaye hai is a story of 5 extra-terrestrial people, from a different galaxy. They have come to earth in search of their lost son. These 5 aliens consist of a father, mother and their 3 children. Few years back they had lost their youngest son while travelling through our galaxy. Since then they have been searching for him from planet to planet .This hunt of theirs had got them to our planet earth.

title: Ek Hasina Thi
plot: Ek Hasina Thi is a story, set in the eastern megapolis of Kolkata. It is not a revenge story but a story of the female protagonist, Durga, seeking justice for a crime committed in the past. Her methods of claiming justice are unconventional as she steps out of the shackles of traditionalism and utilises her Mind to conquer Might! The show tracks the journey of Durga as she attempts to stand up to the power and might of the influential Goenka family. Will Durga be successful in her mission or will she too fall aside like every other person who has stood in the way of the Goenkas? Who will reign supreme in this challenging battle of wits and intellect, where everything seems to be a fair game!

title: The Tom and Jerry Show
plot: A classic cat-and-mouse rivalry returns in a colorful modern series that keeps the familiar characters and slapstick spirit. Episodes follow the pair through frantic chases, comic schemes, and occasional adventures beyond their usual surroundings, delivering fast, lighthearted fun for a new generation.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School
plot: A pair of siblings enroll at a high school where magic is treated as a science. Their differing academic standings create tension, while school life gradually expands into technical magical challenges, strategic conflicts, and larger threats.

crew.name: Kana Ishida
crew.role: Character Designer, Supervising Animation Director, Original Series Design

title: Haikyuu!!
plot: A short, determined student forms a volleyball team in middle school but suffers a crushing defeat against a gifted rival. After entering high school, he joins the volleyball club and discovers that his former opponent is now his teammate, forcing them to confront their rivalry and learn to work together.

crew.name: Hideki Takahashi
crew.role: Animation Director, Key Animation, Opening/Ending Animation, Action Director

title: Bride of the Century
plot: A wealthy heir's arranged marriage spirals into chaos when a kind-hearted lookalike replaces his cold bride, challenging a century-old family curse.

cast.name: Yang Jin-sung
cast.role: Na Doo-rim / Jang Yi-kyung / Boon Yi

title: Emergency Couple
plot: Medical school student, Chang Min, and a dietitian, Jin Hee, fall in love and marry despite his family's strong opposition. When Chang Min marries Jin Hee, he gives up his medical internship to become a pharmaceutical salesman despite the fact that the rest of his family are successful doctors. Their married life is miserable as Chang Min's family looks down on Jin Hee and Chang Min begins to treat her poorly. They finally divorce and go their separate ways until they are suddenly reunited as interns working at the same hospital. Will this couple's tumultuous feelings for each other be rekindled?

title: Amber
plot: The disappearance of 14-year-old Amber Bailey sets off a two-year search during which her family endures unimaginable pressures. As days, months and years progress, the mystery deepens, and strange and terrifying clues come to light, raising even more questions. The world becomes gripped by the mystery of the missing teen. What happened to Amber?

title: 90 Day Fiancé
plot: International couples reunite in the United States on fiancé visas, facing a 90-day deadline to marry. As they adjust to living together, cultural differences, family concerns, communication problems, and questions about their relationships put their plans for marriage to the test.

title: Noragami
plot: A minor god dreams of becoming famous but has no shrine, no partner, and little luck. After meeting a girl whose life becomes connected to his, he joins forces with a new divine weapon for adventures mixing supernatural danger, humor, action, and heartfelt character growth.

title: Heirs
plot: After a chance encounter in Los Angeles, two teenagers from very different social worlds meet again at an elite high school for Korea’s wealthiest families. Their developing relationship unfolds amid family pressures, class divisions, rivalries, and the challenges of growing up in the public eye.

title: Ace of Diamond
plot: A brash, left-handed pitcher is scouted for his potential and joins a powerful high school baseball team. Determined to become its undisputed ace, he faces intense competition while working to improve his skills and earn his place among talented teammates.

title: Mahabharat
plot: This drama series brings a modern television adaptation of an ancient Indian epic to life, exploring family rivalries, duty, moral choices, power, and the consequences of conflict. Its large ensemble portrays legendary figures as they navigate loyalty, faith, ambition, and the struggle between right and wrong.

title: Cutthroat Kitchen
plot: Four chefs receive $25,000 to spend on advantages or sabotages while competing to prepare delicious dishes. Ingredients can be stolen, utensils destroyed, and valuable cooking time lost, turning each round into a tense test of culinary skill, strategy, and willingness to outplot the competition.

title: Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories
plot: Yamishibai is a picture-story style of animation whose motif is surrounded and based off the rumors, and urban legends throughout the history of Japan.

title: Danganronpa: The Animation
plot: An ordinary student wins a place at an elite academy reserved for exceptional talents, only to discover that graduation requires committing a murder or becoming a victim. Trapped with other students, they must navigate a deadly contest filled with suspicion, investigations, and high-stakes trials.

title: Naked and Afraid
plot: Two complete strangers are dropped into extreme wilderness with no food, water, or clothing, and only one survival item each. Over 21 days, each male-female pair must work together, endure harsh conditions, find basic resources, and reach an extraction point while facing hunger, weather, wildlife, and personal tensions.

title: Inside Amy Schumer
plot: A provocative sketch-comedy series explores sex, relationships, and everyday frustrations through scripted vignettes, stand-up routines, and candid street interviews. Its themes range from denial and getting what you want to threesomes, using blunt humor to examine modern social expectations.

crew.name: Kevin Kane
crew.role: Executive Producer, Producer, Supervising Producer, Associate Producer

title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
plot: Amid rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless military commander, an undercover operative’s mission for his country turns into a violent personal war. As loyalties fracture in Lyari, he is pushed toward choices that blur the boundary between patriotism and brutality.

title: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
plot: Three young women from different parts of India choose love over tradition, but their relationships gradually become traps marked by manipulation, control, and silence. Their parallel journeys explore how emotional pressure and rebellion can be turned against personal freedom, creating an intense social drama about trust, vulnerability, and the consequences of losing independence.

title: Assi
plot: After a school teacher is sexually assaulted on her way home, a determined prosecution lawyer takes on the fight for justice. As the case exposes failures in policing, investigation, and the legal system, the story asks what justice can mean when countless reports rarely reach trial.

title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
plot: A man hoping to marry the love of his life is pulled into an absurd marriage mix-up involving three women from different religious backgrounds. As he tries to manage the resulting misunderstandings and domestic chaos, his plans become increasingly difficult to keep under control.

title: Dhurandhar
plot: A mysterious traveler enters Karachi’s criminal underworld and steadily rises through its dangerous ranks. Operating with lethal precision, the traveler navigates crime, politics, shifting loyalties, and an intelligence-linked network while pursuing a mission designed to dismantle the powerful connection from within.

title: Gustaakh Ishq
plot: A man struggling to save his family’s printing press becomes a disciple of a revered poet and falls in love with the poet’s daughter. Caught between his feelings and loyalty to his mentor, he must confront a difficult choice that could reshape his future.

title: Mastiii 4
plot: Three frustrated husbands, trapped in dull marriages, dream of freedom and excitement. After encountering an unconventional arrangement that seems to offer an escape, they pursue a similar idea, triggering a chaotic chain of misunderstandings, awkward situations, and increasingly wild attempts to change their ordinary lives.

title: Bhagwat Chapter One: Raakshas
plot: A seemingly simple missing-girl case draws a small-town police inspector into a disturbing investigation involving several disappearing young women. As he follows a trail of suspicion, the inquiry becomes a tense crime drama about hidden motives, moral conflict, and the difficult search for truth.

title: The Bengal Files
plot: A criminal investigator pursues a missing-person case that leads into a wider web of corruption. Meanwhile, someone connected to the investigation reflects on communal violence that erupted in the period leading up to India’s partition.

title: Tehran
plot: After a magnetic bomb destroys an Israeli embassy vehicle in Delhi, a determined police investigator suspects the attack is more complex than it first appears. Facing political pressure and possible international connections, he pursues the truth through a perilous investigation against formidable adversaries.

title: Kaalidhar Laapata
plot: An ageing Kaalidhar escapes his family after overhearing their plans to abandon him. He meets the free-spirited Ballu, and they embark on an adventure to tick things off Kaalidhar's bucket list.

title: Uyir
plot: A probationary police officer begins serving at a station in Kannur district, where the job brings him into contact with incidents drawn from real life. The story follows his early professional experiences and the challenges of working in a demanding local police environment.

title: Mollywood Times
plot: An ambitious filmmaker dreams of becoming Malayalam cinema’s greatest horror director, but the industry’s toxic pressures threaten to derail that goal. As he pursues recognition, he must contend with professional challenges that test his determination and reshape his understanding of success.

title: Karakkam
plot: After a drunken New Year's prank, two young men disturb sacred graves and face the consequences when restless spirits begin haunting them. As fear takes hold, they must confront what they have done and seek redemption before they can find release.

title: Athiradi
plot: An energetic student revives a banned college festival, sparking a fierce rivalry that turns a lively celebration into escalating chaos. As tensions rise, the event becomes a test of spirit, loyalty, and the ability to keep the festivities from spinning further out of control.

title: Dridam
plot: A police officer at a seemingly peaceful station faces mounting pressure after human remains are discovered. With only a week to solve the murder, he must balance demands from his department against an anxious public calling for swift justice.

title: Madhuvidhu
plot: A groom from an all-male household faces repeated rejection from prospective brides’ families. When he falls in love with a young woman, their hopes of marriage set off a hilarious chain of chaos inside his unruly home.

title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
plot: Three police officers enter a mysterious forest along a state border to search for a missing colleague. As they encounter strange time-related phenomena, their investigation leads them toward the hidden secrets of the remote wilderness.

title: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
plot: A police officer under investigation for his role in a woman’s death races to protect his son from her grieving, vengeful father. As the threat closes in, the officer must confront a dangerous moral conflict involving justice, family, deception, and redemption.

title: Baby Girl
plot: On Christmas night, a guilt-ridden hospital attendant and a determined rookie police officer race to find a kidnapped newborn. Their search unfolds alongside the painful struggle of a woman desperate to become a mother, bringing together suspense, urgency, and emotional conflict.

title: Krantijyoti Vidyalay Marathi Madhyam
plot: When a Marathi-medium village school faces closure and demolition to make way for a new international campus, teachers, students, and alumni unite to protect it. As they rally the community, personal struggles mix with a larger fight to preserve local language, identity, and school memories—while still grappling with the need for change.

title: Sarvam Maya
plot: A man who has lost his faith meets the spirit of a young woman who cannot remember her past. Their unusual connection draws him into a gentle supernatural story about family, relationships, personal change, and finding renewed purpose, blending everyday warmth with light comedy and fantasy.

title: Bha. Bha. Ba.
plot: After Kerala’s top elected leader is kidnapped, a determined investigator is assigned to find the mysterious abductor. The search uncovers hidden motives and secrets behind the crime, leading into a chaotic, reference-filled spoof that favors madness and theatrical energy over realism or strict logic.

title: The Devil
plot: A state leader is framed, prompting his secretary to recruit a kindhearted lookalike to impersonate a violent heir. When the real heir returns, the two men clash over political power and a woman they both care about, while the impersonator fights to protect her and earn the people’s trust.

title: KalamKaval
plot: In the early 2010s, a routine police inquiry in a quiet village takes an unexpected turn when minor clues connect to a series of disturbing cases. The investigation expands across state lines, uncovering unsolved mysteries that have remained hidden for years.

title: Dies Irae
plot: An affluent young man begins experiencing disturbing supernatural occurrences in his home after a troubling personal event. As he investigates the mystery, he encounters unexpected allies and unfamiliar worlds, while confronting the frightening forces that seem connected to his past.

title: Pathirathri
plot: A strange incident during their routine night duty pulls SI Jancy and Hareesh into a dangerous investigation. As secrets unfold, they must face their fears and the choices that could define their futures.

title: Balti
plot: A star kabaddi player from a small town near the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border is drawn into a dangerous rivalry involving criminal groups. As sports, friendship, romance, and revenge collide, his life takes an increasingly violent and emotional turn.

title: Mirage
plot: After learning her fiancé died in a train accident, a grieving woman teams up with a journalist to uncover what he was hiding. Their search pulls them into a dangerous web of secrets, missing information, and people who want the truth buried, forcing her to keep moving while piecing together what really happened.

title: Dashavatar
plot: When evil rises, divinity manifests to defeat it. An aging Dashavatar folk theater performer faces life's storms, guided by the wisdom of this traditional Konkan art form blending myth, music, and dance.

title: Lokah Chapter One: Chandra
plot: A mysterious woman moves to Bangalore and takes night shifts at a café, drawing the attention of two aimless neighbors. As one becomes fascinated by her unusual routines and visitors, their lives shift when he catches a glimpse of her hidden abilities, opening the door to a larger world of folklore, danger, and superheroes.

title: Su from So
plot: In a joyful coastal village, ordinary life is disrupted when a mysterious outsider linked to the devil arrives. As confusion spreads, the villagers become caught in a lively chain of comic events involving superstition, community tensions, and unexpected emotional turns.

title: Sitaare Zameen Par
plot: A disgraced basketball coach must complete community service by training a team of intellectually disabled players. Initially uncomfortable and doubtful, he gradually forms a bond with the group and discovers their determination could carry them toward the national championships.

title: Padakkalam
plot: Four comic book-loving college students are pulled into a strange adventure after a charismatic new professor brings supernatural forces into their academic world. As friendships, rivalries, and mysterious rules collide, the group must navigate a wildly unpredictable situation filled with humor, suspense, and magical chaos.

title: The Bhootnii
plot: At a college campus, a tree becomes the center of eerie activity when a spirit awakens each Valentine’s Day, drawn by the desire for true love. As unsettling incidents spread and fear grows, the authorities bring in an experienced paranormal expert to face whatever is haunting the grounds.

title: Thudarum
plot: A devoted taxi driver’s ordinary life is disrupted when corrupt police seize his beloved car over a criminal case. His determined efforts to recover it draw him into a dangerous conspiracy, forcing him to confront powerful authorities while protecting his family and seeking justice.

title: Marana Mass
plot: A mismatched group of passengers finds themselves stuck on a bus during a tense night, unaware that a notorious serial killer is among them. As suspicion, panic, and dark humor collide, the ride turns into a chaotic scramble to survive and make sense of what’s happening.

title: Alappuzha Gymkhana
plot: After failing their final school exams, a tight-knit group of youngsters looks for a fresh start by trying to enter college through a sports quota. With little experience but plenty of confidence, they pick boxing and scrape through early matches, only to face tougher challenges as the competition rises.

title: L2: Empuraan
plot: Five years after a Kerala leader aligns with communal forces, a powerful underworld figure returns with his trusted aide to defend the state and settle old scores. The political conflict expands across international criminal networks, religious extremism, and the struggle for control over Kerala.

title: Mere Husband Ki Biwi
plot: A Delhi professional finds himself caught between an old flame who returns and someone new he has begun to love. Their tangled relationships spark a series of comedic misunderstandings, romantic complications, and awkward situations in this lighthearted comedy.

title: Ponman
plot: A jewellery agent lends gold for a wedding, expecting to recover its value afterward. When only part of the gold is returned, he confronts a powerful prawn farmer and becomes caught in a tense struggle involving marriage pressures, family obligations, survival, and the burden of dowry expectations in coastal Kollam.

title: Pravinkoodu Shappu
plot: On a rainy night, a toddy shop owner is found hanging after 11 people stayed inside playing cards in the closed shop. SI Santhosh investigates, uncovering secrets to find the killer.

title: Fateh
plot: A former covert operative living quietly in Punjab is pulled back into action when a young girl becomes a victim of a dangerous cybercrime syndicate. With help from an ethical hacker, he confronts the organization while trying to expose its network and protect others from online fraud.

title: Rekhachithram
plot: After returning from suspension, a disgraced police officer seeks to restore his reputation by taking on a decades-old murder case. The investigation centers on an unidentified victim and gradually connects the unresolved crime to a film production from the 1980s, blending a present-day mystery with an emotional story from the past.

title: Identity
plot: A forensic sketch artist and a police officer team up to identify an elusive killer through a witness’s remembered image of a brutal crime. Their investigation develops into a tense mystery involving memory, justice, and dangerous confrontations.

title: Marco
plot: After an adoptive family’s son is brutally murdered, a relentless man begins a ruthless quest for vengeance. His pursuit draws him through betrayal, loss, and extreme brutality, confronting escalating danger while the story focuses on raw revenge and high-intensity action.

title: Jab Khuli Kitaab
plot: After a decades-long marriage is shaken by a painful confession, a hurt husband considers divorce while the couple tries to keep their secret from the family. Their emotional and often funny journey explores love, regret, forgiveness, and the possibility of finding togetherness again.

title: Saali Mohabbat
