plot: A small-town housewife is shattered when her husband and cousin are found dead, only to become the main focus of a local murder investigation. As suspicion grows, the story moves through tangled relationships, hidden motives, and a tense search for what really happened.

title: The Sabarmati Report
plot: A Hindi reporter confronts the deadly burning of a train carrying pilgrims in Godhra. Years later, he is drawn into an investigation seeking to challenge the accepted account and uncover buried information, while navigating pressure from media institutions and the demands of truth-seeking journalism.

title: All We Imagine as Light
plot: In Mumbai, a nurse’s routine is unsettled by an unexpected gift from her estranged husband, while her younger roommate struggles to find private space for her relationship. When a housing crisis affects an older friend, the women travel to a coastal town, where distance from the city opens room for reflection and possibility.

title: Kishkindha Kaandam
plot: Strange disturbances in a forest village lead a newlywed woman, her husband, and local officials into an investigation involving a missing gun and troubling family tensions. As they search for answers, the quiet surroundings gradually give way to an emotional mystery about memory, relationships, and carefully guarded truths.

title: Vaazha: Biopic of a Billion Boys
plot: Four friends labeled as failures face pressure from their parents and society as they move from school and college into adulthood. Through friendship, mishaps, and emotional struggles, they begin a journey toward self-discovery, acceptance, and finding their own place beyond other people's expectations.

title: Kakuda
plot: When a young man is cursed by a terrifying ghost, his determined wife teams up with an eccentric ghost hunter to find a way to save him. Their search unfolds in a village plagued by a strange supernatural rule, blending mystery, scares, and comic moments.

title: Kill
plot: A military commando boards a train to stop the woman he loves from entering an unwanted arranged marriage. When armed thieves seize control and threaten the passengers, he must use his training to protect those around him in a relentless fight through the confined train.

title: Luv Ki Arrange Marriage
plot: A young man hopes to marry the woman he loves, but family plans get complicated when his widowed father unexpectedly falls for her mother. As two romances collide under one roof, misunderstandings and cultural expectations spark a string of comic chaos and heartfelt moments.

title: Blackout
plot: A crime reporter stumbles onto a dangerous windfall after a blackout changes one ordinary night into a chaotic ride. As stolen money, crooked motives, and rising danger pile up around him, he has to figure out how to survive the mess he helped create.

title: Munjya
plot: A young man returns to his native village, where a buried family secret awakens a vengeful spirit determined to marry. As the supernatural threat targets him and the woman he loves, he is pulled into a chaotic adventure blending scares, folklore, and humor.

title: Thalavan
plot: Two police officers with a strained relationship spiral into a tense murder investigation after a body is found in one officer’s home. With the investigation led by the other officer, suspicion, pressure, and competing methods keep escalating the conflict and suspense.

title: Malayalee from India
plot: An unemployed young man is forced to leave home after an unexpected incident. His journey away from familiar surroundings ends up reshaping his life in surprising ways, mixing comedy and heartfelt moments along the way.

title: Article 370
plot: Ahead of a major constitutional decision affecting Jammu and Kashmir, a special agent is assigned a secret mission to curb violence in the conflict-ridden region. As security operations and political pressures intensify, she becomes part of a high-stakes effort surrounding a pivotal national moment.

title: Manjummel Boys
plot: A carefree trip becomes a life-or-death rescue mission when one friend falls into a perilous, uncharted abyss. As time runs short, the group must rely on trust, courage, and their lifelong bond to bring him back.

title: Bramayugam
plot: In 17th-century Kerala, a folk singer fleeing danger finds shelter in a mysterious mansion. Living alongside an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, he becomes trapped in an unsettling world of folklore, fear, and hidden power.

title: Sam Bahadur
plot: This biographical war drama follows an influential Indian Army leader across a long military career, from his early service through major conflicts and rising responsibility. It explores his courage, wit, professional values, and relationships while offering a broad overview of his contributions to India.

title: Mrs
plot: A newly married woman enters a seemingly modern household where rigid traditions define her daily life. As endless domestic demands overshadow her identity and ambitions, she struggles to find space for her own aspirations and confronts the expectations placed on wives.

title: Apurva
plot: In the merciless Chambal ravines, a regular girl must outwit hardcore dacoits to survive one night before any help comes her way.

title: Everybody Loves Sohrab Handa
plot: At an anniversary party, a man is found dead in the hall, prompting an investigation that puts friendships under pressure. As the inquiry progresses, hidden secrets emerge and the people connected to the gathering face difficult questions.

title: Tejas
plot: An Indian Air Force officer undertakes a dangerous mission to rescue a spy held in Pakistan. As she confronts terrorists and mounting danger, she must also face painful memories from her past while striving to complete her assignment.

title: Yaariyan 2
plot: Three cousins begin a new chapter in a lively city, balancing family bonds, romance, personal ambitions, and unexpected challenges. As their relationships are tested, they must find the strength to support one another while pursuing their dreams and facing difficult changes.

title: Aatmapamphlet
plot: Ten-year-old Ashish falls head-over-heels in love with his classmate, Srushti. While he grows up, the country goes through several socio-economic changes.

title: Haddi
plot: A transgender woman moves to Delhi and joins a community led by an influential figure. As she finds her place among them, her new life becomes tied to a dangerous path involving power, violence, identity, and a desire for revenge.

title: Toby
plot: An estranged man, feared as a beast, tries to escape an oppressive world and change his life for his foster daughter. Set in a rural coastal community, the story unfolds through troubled relationships, buried pain, and a difficult path toward freedom and redemption.

title: Ghoomer
plot: After losing her right hand just before an international cricket debut, a gifted young batter faces the end of her dreams. A bitter former cricketer offers her a new challenge, training her to become a bowler and pursue a place on the national team.

title: 12th Fail
plot: A young man from difficult circumstances faces academic failure and social pressure, then chooses to begin again while pursuing a place in India’s fiercely competitive civil service examinations. Along the way, he takes on demanding work, finds support from others, and struggles to reclaim his future through persistence and honest effort.

title: OMG 2
plot: A devoted father’s life is shaken when his son is blamed for immoral conduct and expelled from school. After considering leaving town, he is guided toward seeking justice in court, challenging the school system and society’s reluctance to address sex education and related health topics openly.

title: Gadar 2
plot: After a family man disappears during a skirmish and is believed to be held across the border, his son begins a dangerous rescue mission. Their journey takes them through enemy territory, where father and son must overcome escalating obstacles and find a way back to safety.

title: Baipan Bhari Deva
plot: Six estranged sisters decide to take part in a Mangalgauri competition, and reunite at their childhood home to practice. They must overcome their past and face their struggles head-on.

title: 1920: Horrors of the Heart
plot: After her father's suicide, a young woman becomes consumed by vengeance. Her search leads her to the doorstep of her estranged mother, where buried family tensions ignite a violent rampage filled with horror, drama, and emotional conflict.

title: Sirf Ek Bandaa Kaafi Hai
plot: An ordinary lawyer takes on a difficult case against a powerful godman accused of assaulting a minor. Facing pressure, threats, and formidable opposition, he remains determined to pursue justice for the victim through a demanding courtroom battle.

title: Zara Hatke Zara Bachke
plot: Kapil and Somya fall in love, marry, and settle into a close joint family life. As the romance fades, their relationship teeters toward divorce, but the families’ involvement keeps pushing the story in unexpected directions.

title: Kennedy
plot: An insomniac former cop, Kennedy has been presumed dead for years. Yet, in secret, he continues to serve a corrupt system while seeking redemption. Halfway between thriller and film noir, Kennedy chronicles a violent and bloody vendetta in the dark streets of Mumbai. At the rate of the murders, Kennedy's character reveals itself more and more and sinks into a spiral that seems to have no way out.

title: The Kerala Story
plot: A young woman who dreams of becoming a nurse is drawn into a web of manipulation and forced religious conversion. Her ordeal takes her from home and college life into extremist recruitment, trafficking, and imprisonment, while the story highlights the vulnerability of women facing coercion and radicalization.

When relentless rain triggers a catastrophic flood, people from different walks of life are caught in a fight for survival. As homes disappear and communities face mounting danger, ordinary citizens, including local rescuers, unite to help strangers and overcome the disaster together.

title: U Turn
plot: A journalism intern investigates traffic offenders making illegal turns on a city flyover, but the story takes a dark turn when a motorist dies and she becomes the prime suspect. With pressure mounting, she must clear her name while helping uncover what’s really behind the unsettling incidents linked to the flyover.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
plot: A self-defense trainer chooses bachelorhood while caring for his three younger brothers, who decide to find him a partner. When he falls for a woman whose family faces threats from its troubled past, he must reconsider his violent ways and confront dangerous old conflicts.

title: Mrs Undercover
plot: A highly trained undercover agent, now living as a middle-class housewife, is called back to duty after ten years. She must face a serial killer targeting ambitious women while trying to regain her neglected skills and balance the demands of family life.

title: Gaslight
plot: Meesha returns to her family’s royal estate after years away, only to find her estranged father is missing under mysterious circumstances. Strange occurrences shake the household, and she, along with a trusted companion, investigates what may be hidden behind the family’s calm surface.

title: Selfiee
plot: A regional transport officer gets an unexpected chance to meet the superstar he deeply admires. When their encounter goes badly, the fan and his idol become locked in an escalating clash involving pride, public attention, and a driving licence.

title: Lost
plot: A crime reporter investigates the sudden disappearance of a college student while competing theories spread through society. Her search draws her into a politically charged mystery involving questions of truth, journalistic responsibility, human values, and the forces shaping public opinion.

title: Romancham
plot: In 2007, seven bachelors living in a rented house on the outskirts of Bengaluru play a Ouija board game for fun. When they unexpectedly invite a spirit, their shared home becomes the setting for a lively mix of nervous reactions, strange happenings, and situational comedy.

title: Malikappuram
plot: An eight-year-old girl from a village is upset when her pilgrimage to Sabarimala is delayed. Determined to make the journey, she sets out with a friend, leading them into an emotional and devotional adventure filled with family bonds, fear, excitement, and moments of mystery.

title: Ved
plot: A railway colony dreamer hopes to build a cricket career while falling deeply in love. After personal and professional setbacks reshape his life, he becomes a troubled, hopeless man, while the woman who has loved him since childhood remains by his side in a complicated marriage shaped by longing and devotion.

title: Hatyapuri
plot: Feluda, Topshe, and Lalmohan Ganguly go to Puri for vacation. One evening, the trio spot odd footprints on the sand. Later, Lalmohan Babu goes to meet an astrologer who is presumably gifted with extrasensory perception. Soon they stumble upon a dead body lying on the beach. Can they figure out the mystery?

title: Shadyantra
plot: Natasha, the heir to a construction company, leads a contented life free of corporate intrigue. Soon after, a shocking murder takes place in her home, completely upending her life.

title: Govinda Naam Mera
plot: A troubled choreographer juggles an abusive marriage, a secret romance, mounting legal troubles, and an unexpected murder. As his chaotic personal life spirals, he must navigate shifting loyalties, comic misunderstandings, and a mystery that brings unexpected twists.

title: 1001 Nunakal
plot: Close friends get together and have some good time over food and talks until one of them proposes a game: each of them has to reveal a lie that they have hidden from their partners.

title: Blurr
plot: As progressive blindness takes hold, a woman must search for answers after her twin sister’s unlikely death. With reality starting to feel unreliable, she’s forced to decide whether she’s ready to face the truth.

title: Roy
plot: Unable to distinguish between his dreams and reality, Roy finds it difficult to maintain any sort of relationship with anyone except his wife Teena, who accepts and loves him wholeheartedly. When Teena, following clues from her husband's dreams, goes missing while searching for a veteran writer, it is up to Roy to find his wife and get her to safety.

title: Uunchai
plot: Three longtime friends leave their comfortable Delhi lives to undertake a demanding Himalayan trek, honoring a shared dream after a sudden loss. Along the journey, friendship becomes their main source of motivation as they face physical challenges, personal differences, and questions about age, family, and unfinished aspirations.

title: Mukundan Unni Associates
plot: An ambitious advocate is determined to achieve success, prosperity, and respect, refusing to let anything stand in the way. As his drive is fueled by greed and an uncompromising nature, the pursuit of his goals comes with a serious cost.

title: Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey
plot: Jayabharathi is denied simple joys growing up because she is a girl, and her marriage becomes another source of harm under a chauvinist, short-tempered husband. After facing domestic violence without support, she decides to push back and fight for herself.

title: Har Har Mahadev
plot: A young leader begins building the foundation of a self-ruled homeland, setting out on a defining journey that will shape his legacy. To turn this dream into reality, he must bring together powerful local factions and unite them under a shared cause.

title: Rorschach
plot: After his wife disappears, a man begins searching for her and encounters a seemingly ordinary family in a rural setting. As he grows closer to them, unsettling events unfold, drawing him into a tense psychological mystery shaped by suspicion, grief, and increasingly disturbing possibilities.

title: Eesho
plot: While working the night at an ATM, a security guard, who is the prime witness in the case against a powerful industrialist, happens across a mysterious man named Eesho. They engage in a conversation and the guard pours his heart out to the stranger before realising that Eesho may not be a friend. Who is Eesho and what does he want?

title: Chup
plot: A series of disturbing murders shakes Mumbai, with film critics targeted whenever a new movie is released. A determined police officer and a criminal psychologist work together to understand the killer’s motives and stop the escalating violence.

title: Lego One Piece
plot: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

title: Hunkkaar: The Roar
plot: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

title: Don't Be Shy
plot: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

title: Unabomber
plot: A gifted young man’s life takes a troubling turn after he is subjected to controversial psychological experiments. Decades later, an FBI-led manhunt brings his past back into focus, tracing the consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: A Different World
plot: A college freshman arrives at her parents’ historically Black college and struggles to step out of their shadow. As she builds an identity of her own, she balances campus expectations, new friendships, and the excitement of making the most of college life.

title: Shaque: Trust No One
plot: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

title: Wonka's the Golden Ticket
plot: Lucky players enter a fantastical chocolate factory for a reality competition filled with unpredictable games, challenging tests, and tempting choices. As they navigate each unusual challenge, contestants compete for the chance to claim a coveted prize.

title: The Love Hypothesis
plot: A biology PhD candidate and a demanding professor enter a fake relationship to solve their romantic dilemmas. What begins as a carefully planned arrangement soon complicates their views on love, forcing both to navigate unexpected feelings and the pressures of academic life.

title: Brothers
plot: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

title: JAŸ-Z in 8
plot: Decades after his landmark debut, an influential artist, philanthropist, and entrepreneur reflects on his career in an intimate conversation with a longtime friend, producer, and director. The series offers a personal look back at a storied creative and professional journey.

title: Best of the Best
plot: Two childhood best friends join their college’s competitive Bollywood dance team, hoping to reach the national championship. As the competition intensifies, their friendship is tested by demanding rehearsals, fierce rivalries, and the chaotic pressures of chasing victory together.

title: Lust Stories 3
plot: Across four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant stories, the anthology explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire. Each tale offers a fresh perspective on intimacy, longing, and human connection, presenting these experiences in all their complexity.

title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
plot: In a cruel Victorian-era household, a young woman faces escalating tensions that culminate in the brutal deaths of her parents, sending shockwaves through the nation. The series explores the circumstances surrounding a notorious crime and the harsh social world in which it unfolds.

title: Waiting Hai
plot: A newly joined railway protection officer investigates a Tatkal ticket scam as two entrepreneurs turn booking software into a risky business. Rivalry, betrayal, and a determined pursuit raise the stakes while authorities work to dismantle the operation.

title: Neagley
plot: A private investigator in Chicago learns that a beloved friend from her past has died in a suspicious accident. Drawing on hard-earned investigative skills and experience with an elite special-investigations unit, she pursues justice while uncovering a dangerous threat.

title: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
plot: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

title: The Revolutionaries
plot: A group of brave young Indian freedom fighters challenges British rule, driven by unwavering courage and deeply held ideals. Their shared struggle explores the determination and sacrifice involved in pursuing independence during a defining period in India’s history.

title: A Killer Story
plot: An investigative journalist reexamines a 2002 double homicide case after receiving thousands of messages from a determined citizen sleuth. She and her husband believe the accused woman is innocent and devote themselves to challenging the case and seeking answers.

title: Chumbak
plot: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

title: Crew Girl
plot: A 16-year-old rower becomes coxswain of a troubled boys’ crew at an elite prep school. As she faces team drama, romance, rival crews, and a complicated relationship with her mother, she works to unite the team and pursue victory.

title: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma
plot: An Indian cricketer makes his television hosting debut in a family-focused game show on Sony TV. Competing families come together for survey-based trivia, while his relaxed wit and humor keep the experience centered on friendly, lighthearted entertainment.

title: Last Seen
plot: An emergency dispatcher receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes may be his long-missing daughter. Overcome by hope and urgency, he begins a determined search to find her, refusing to stop until he has followed every lead available to him.

title: Dang!
plot: A brother and sister enjoy fun, messy lives in New York City until their high-achieving older sister arrives and wants to spend time with them. Her unexpected presence disrupts their routine and creates a new challenge for the siblings.

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
plot: This documentary explores the extraordinary origin story of an unlikely and beloved entertainment icon. It follows the journey from his early life to the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame that made him recognizable through major roles in popular films and television.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
plot: Several married couples reunite at a destination wedding for a family celebration, where old and new drama emerges as they reflect on their relationships, question their choices, and wonder why they have come together again.

title: Cocaine
plot: In Mumbai, a powerful drug cartel controls the cocaine trade with help from corrupt officials. A dedicated police inspector becomes trapped between enforcing the law and protecting his brother after the cartel targets his family, forcing him into a dangerous struggle for survival.

title: The Grand Tour
plot: A motoring series follows three new presenters as they travel the world, explore remarkable vehicles, attempt ambitious stunts, and share strong opinions. Each episode combines international adventure with lively automotive challenges and the energetic spirit of a much-loved car show.

title: Earle Meets World
plot: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

title: The Runner
plot: During her morning run through London, a determined lawyer receives a call saying her young son has been kidnapped. To save him, she must follow a series of ruthless instructions while racing across the city, balancing a dangerous legal case against an urgent fight to protect her child.

title: Gandhari
plot: After a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she refuses to remain helpless. Taking matters into her own hands, she sets out to hunt down the people responsible for the devastating loss and bring the circumstances surrounding the kidnapping into focus.

title: Mayday
plot: During the Cold War, a U.S. Navy pilot becomes stranded behind enemy lines while carrying out a top-secret mission. With survival uncertain, he must depend on an unlikely alliance with an eccentric former KGB agent to find a way forward.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
plot: A quarter-century after September 11, the attacks’ effects continue across generations. People who were orphaned, reported on the War on Terror, grew up in Afghanistan, or served as U.S. Marines during the 2021 withdrawal share how those events shaped their lives.

title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
plot: This docuseries examines the brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Florida and the wealthy family secrets surrounding the case. Larger-than-life suspects, a contentious custody battle, former lovers, and an unexpected family connection shape a complex investigation into an alleged murder-for-hire plot.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
plot: A former Olympic competitor becomes the focus of global attention after a viral performance sparks memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories. This documentary explores the intense public reaction and the questions surrounding an unexpected path to the world stage.

title: Babita Singh Reporting
plot: A people-pleasing police officer takes leave to attend a family celebration in her hometown, where a childhood friend is murdered. Facing dismissive relatives, an indifferent husband, and an unhelpful local police force, she quietly investigates the case while finding the courage to assert herself.

title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
plot: This documentary series retraces a woman’s promising life, troubled marriage, and the mysterious circumstances surrounding her death. It revisits her personal story and examines the questions raised by the events leading to her death, without offering easy answers about what happened.

title: The Airport Chaplain
plot: An airport chaplain believes the busy terminal depends on his constant devotion, while a newly appointed terminal manager sees him as a serious liability. Their opposing views set up a workplace clash in an unusual setting, as faith, authority, and airport operations collide.

title: The Last Salute
plot: This documentary chronicles the fighter aircraft’s final chapter in the Indian Air Force, highlighting stories from generations of fighter pilots who flew it and offering a focused look at the aircraft’s long service and the people connected to its history.

title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
plot: After a legendary Rose Bowl performance, a celebrated college football star enters the NFL with enormous expectations. Injuries, conflict, and sudden loss complicate his career, revealing a more difficult journey than the highlight reels suggest.

title: 9/11: Reunited
plot: Survivors revisit life-or-death moments from September 11, when strangers helped one another through an unimaginable crisis. The series follows their efforts to reconnect years later, meet again, and reflect on the powerful bonds formed during that day.

title: Clean Up Company
plot: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
plot: A group of close friends balances family life, business ambitions, parenting, relationships, and candid group chats. Their glamorous getaways and everyday growing pains reveal a lively circle navigating a new chapter together, with plenty of chaos, honesty, and strong bonds.

title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
plot: This miniseries goes inside a dominant college basketball program as its demanding coach and standout players pursue championships. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes perspectives, it explores the pressure, discipline, sacrifice, and determination required to build a lasting dynasty.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
plot: A decorated tennis champion returns to the Australian Open in 2025, driven by a relentless desire to compete despite having already achieved nearly everything. The documentary follows his preparation, ambition, and fierce commitment while exploring what keeps an elite athlete pushing forward when few goals remain.

title: Lion
plot: This miniseries follows a single pride over four years, offering an intimate look at the challenges facing lions and the wider species. It uses advanced technology to explore their lives, environment, and ongoing struggle to survive.

title: Lanterns
plot: Two intergalactic police officers investigate a murder in the American heartland, where an Earth-based mystery takes on a darker, more unsettling dimension. A new recruit works alongside a legendary Lantern as they follow clues that test their partnership and their understanding of the case.

title: Disney Worldbuilders
plot: Through intimate conversations, key figures behind Disney’s enduring stories reflect on their early years, creative sparks, and formative memories. The film also explores how imagined worlds are taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: Declassified: Operation Sindoor
plot: Following a terror attack, India’s military leadership weighs its options and prepares a major operation. The series recounts the planning and execution of the 88-hour mission through perspectives from operatives and experts, offering a focused look at the decisions and events surrounding it.

title: Umthetho
plot: A state prosecutor risks everything to protect her youngest brother while secretly working as a double agent within her imprisoned older brother’s criminal gang. She must balance her legal duties, family loyalty, and the growing danger surrounding both brothers.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
plot: Following the highly publicized death of a whistleblower, an investigation examines a once-iconic aviation giant amid a deepening corporate crisis. Insider accounts and startling new revelations shed light on the company’s troubles and the questions surrounding its handling of serious concerns.

title: Awarapan 2
plot: A hardened man returns to the criminal underworld, where moving forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, each difficult choice tests his resolve and shapes the course of his destiny.

title: My Brilliant Career
plot: A restless, sharp-minded 17-year-old refuses to conform as she tries to shape her own future in a time when women are expected to marry and settle down. Her determination to become a writer places her at odds with the expectations surrounding her.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
plot: This documentary miniseries examines the rise of a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and the ensuing trial. It draws on unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage to explore the case and its central figure.

title: The End of Oak Street
plot: After a mysterious cosmic event tears an ordinary suburban neighborhood from its surroundings, a family finds itself in an unknown, prehistoric wilderness. With familiar streets transformed and danger closing in, they must work together to survive, protect one another, and find a way forward.

title: Mourinho
plot: This documentary follows a celebrated football manager’s rise through the highest levels of the sport. Drawing on insider perspectives, it explores a trophy-filled career, his status among football’s elite managers, and the pressures of leading top-level clubs around the world.

title: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
plot: Outrageous misadventures unfold as feral cats cause chaos across city streets in this no-holds-barred animated comedy. The series follows their unruly adventures through street-level mayhem, delivering a wild and irreverent take on life among the alleys, where disorder and unexpected trouble run rampant.

title: Operation Safed Sagar
plot: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, an Air Force squadron takes on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines. The series follows their efforts amid a conflict that puts their skills and resolve to the test.

title: Possession
plot: A biracial lawyer travels to a haunted Jamaican plantation to challenge an inheritance claim. As she investigates the property’s troubled history and its links to present-day injustice, the legal dispute becomes an increasingly frightening ordeal.

title: Monsters of God
plot: A filmmaker follows his lifelong fascination with reptiles into the dangerous world of exotic-animal smuggling. As he investigates this billion-dollar trade, he encounters outlaw traffickers, wealthy collectors, and determined law-enforcement agents pursuing rare species, immense fortunes, and elusive criminals.

title: Let's Marry Harry
plot: A prospective groom puts his love life in the hands of three close confidants, who meet potential brides and help decide who might be the right match. Together, they guide him through the challenges of moving from a carefree dater toward a committed life partner.

title: The Shards
plot: At an elite prep school, a 17-year-old student finds his final year disrupted by the arrival of a mysterious new classmate. As the newcomer’s unsettling presence draws attention, a serial killer’s activities cast an increasingly ominous shadow over the school community.

title: Sterling Point
plot: After inheriting a remote Canadian island from an estranged grandfather she never knew, a 17-year-old girl travels there to investigate. Her search opens the door to buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and a complicated family history that others tried to keep hidden.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
plot: A comedian spends 28 days eating fried chicken while traveling across the UK and US. The experiment explores the effects of a powerful craving and investigates the industry behind one of fast food’s most popular meals.

title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
plot: This documentary examines the murders of four university students through bodycam footage, text messages and interviews with people close to them. It follows an investigation into a horrifying crime and the impact it had on those connected to the victims.

title: Furious
plot: An FBI agent pursues a mysterious, calculating serial killer whose actions are tied to a disturbing criminal world. As the investigation deepens and their lives become increasingly connected, both women are forced to confront difficult questions about justice, morality, and where the boundary between right and wrong truly lies.

title: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
plot: A relaxed principal takes on a failing public school and attempts to rebuild it with the help of a group of unconventional teachers. Their efforts create a messy, light-hearted transformation filled with classroom challenges, awkward relationships, and the unpredictable energy of school life.

title: Musafir Cafe
plot: A man feels an undeniable connection with a woman, but life takes him in another direction. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with someone else, while memories of the past continue to linger.

title: Drag Race Down Under vs The World
plot: Fan-favourite drag queens from one region face off against fierce competitors from around the world, all chasing the ultimate crown. Expect bold new looks, heightened rivalries, dramatic challenges, and spectacular lip-sync battles as the contestants compete for global drag supremacy.

title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
plot: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, a comic book store owner must find a quantum-interference device to restore reality. The search unfolds as an absurd, chaotic adventure centered on an ordinary person facing an impossibly large problem.

title: The Dink
plot: A washed-up tennis pro faces a difficult choice when a struggling country club needs saving and he wants to earn his father's respect. To help, he must break a deeply held vow and take up the unlikely sport of pickleball.

title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
plot: This historical documentary series explores the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the Roman city preserved in its aftermath. It examines the disaster’s impact and the archaeological evidence that continues to reveal life in the ancient world.

title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
plot: A young woman searching for her unknown grandfather makes a shocking discovery that connects her family to a notorious criminal. As she investigates his life through family members, disputed accounts, records, and audio, the search strains her relationship with her father and raises questions about family legacy.

title: 72 Hours
plot: An anxious middle-aged advertising executive joins a much younger group for a chaotic Miami bachelor party after being added to their group chat by mistake. Over 72 hours of escalating mishaps, he tries to keep up while protecting his career and proving he still belongs.

title: The F Ward
plot: Failed medical interns receive one final chance at a struggling Sydney hospital. As they face demanding patients, limited resources, personal shortcomings, and past mistakes, they must prove they can grow into capable doctors while navigating the pressures of working together.

title: Young Farts Trailer Parts
plot: Two small-town brothers run a thriving RV-parts business while turning discarded trailers into profitable opportunities. Their outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks fuel one wild idea after another as they work to support their family and grow their business.

title: The Hawk
plot: A legendary golfer nearing the end of his career sets his sights on one last major championship. His relentless pursuit pulls family, friends, and everyone around him into an unpredictable mix of pressure, rivalry, and personal chaos.

title: Ride or Die
plot: Two best friends go on the run across Europe after one discovers the other has been hiding a dangerous secret. Pursued by a mysterious figure and drawn into a web of corruption involving a husband, they race to uncover the truth while staying alive.

title: Lucky
plot: After a multi-million-dollar heist goes wrong, a con artist is forced to run. With federal agents and a ruthless crime boss closing in, she must stay alive while searching for a way to escape the dangerous fallout.

title: Heartstopper Forever
plot: As a new school year begins, two young men in a loving relationship face difficult personal struggles while preparing for life after graduation. Their bond is tested by anxiety, recovery, growing intimacy, and uncertainty about whether teenage love can endure the transition into adulthood.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
plot: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts revisit a 2012 luxury cruise shipwreck and the disaster that followed. This immersive documentary examines the evacuation, the dangers faced by passengers and crew, and the decisions made during a chaotic emergency at sea.

title: Ikka
plot: With a loved one’s life at stake, a celebrated lawyer takes on the defense of a man he suspects is guilty. As he battles his conscience, he must navigate the personal and professional pressure surrounding this difficult case while trying to fulfill his duty as an advocate.

title: Dhamaal 4
plot: A group of lovable troublemakers sets out on another treasure hunt, chasing the mysterious Treasure of Life while stumbling through a series of hilarious challenges. Their chaotic journey promises comic confusion, unexpected obstacles, and plenty of lively misadventures.

title: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars
plot: Nine returning queens compete for the title of Canada’s Ultimate All-Star and a $100,000 cash prize. With unfinished business to resolve, the competition brings familiar performers together for another chance to prove themselves and claim the top spot.

title: The Five Star Weekend
plot: After losing her husband unexpectedly and enduring a highly public breakdown, a celebrated cook invites her closest friends to an elaborate weekend gathering on Nantucket. As the group comes together, the retreat creates space for old relationships, personal grief, and unresolved emotions to surface.

title: Little House on the Prairie
plot: A close-knit family leaves familiar surroundings to build a new life on the Western frontier, where nature brings both beauty and danger. As they adapt to the demands of survival, daily joys and hardships shape their experience and test the strength of their family bond.

title: Evil Dead Burn
plot: After her husband’s sudden death, a grieving widow visits his isolated family, whose history is tied to research into demonic possession. When relatives begin changing into fear-feeding creatures, she must confront a terrifying supernatural threat while reckoning with the bonds and trauma that connect the family.

title: Pritam and Pedro
plot: A seasoned cop who trusts old-school methods is paired with a tech-savvy investigator who relies on modern tools. As their contrasting approaches clash, the unlikely partners work together to solve crimes and navigate the challenges of their new partnership.

title: Simpsley
plot: A penniless con artist travels to Italy to bring a wealthy man home, but becomes distracted by his luxurious lifestyle. Her scheme grows more complicated when she encounters his clingy, dim-witted houseguest, leading to a tangle of deception, romance, and money.

title: Baby Do Die Do
plot: A deaf, non-speaking woman in Mumbai becomes a serial killer, carrying out murders while hearing only the voice of her dead sister. Her actions are driven by mysterious motives, creating a dark crime story centered on isolation, violence, and unanswered questions.

title: Worst Neighbor Ever
plot: This documentary miniseries explores true stories of neighbors whose conflicts escalate into fraud, intimidation, and violent retribution. Each episode examines how seemingly ordinary community disputes can become deeply disturbing cases, drawing on the experiences of people caught in these destructive situations.

title: Elle
plot: Set in 1995, a spirited high school student navigates complicated friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. This coming-of-age chapter explores the experiences that shape her confidence, ambitions, and memorable personality before college, as she finds her way through the tumultuous waters of adolescence and the social pressures surrounding her.

title: Enola Holmes 3
plot: A young detective travels to Malta with hopes of marriage, but those plans unravel when a family disappearance draws her into a dangerous case. She must follow clues through unfamiliar surroundings while confronting difficult questions about independence, love, and finding her own voice.

title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: an Almost History of America
plot: An improvised comedy series takes a playful approach to major events in American history, created to celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. The series presents familiar historical subject matter through loose, comedic performances and an intentionally unconventional perspective on America’s past.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
plot: The longtime stunt-comedy crew reunites for one final round of outrageous challenges, painful pranks, and reckless antics. Blending familiar chaos with the feeling of a farewell, the film celebrates the bond behind their outrageous adventures while pushing their tolerance for embarrassment and danger.

title: Welcome to the Jungle
plot: A group of quirky characters becomes stranded in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. As confusion and criminals complicate their escape, the mismatched survivors must work together to navigate hilarious situations and find their way out.

title: The American Experiment
plot: This sweeping historical documentary series explores how the ideals of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness shaped the founding and development of America. It follows the nation’s evolving story through the ideas that inspired its creation.

title: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
plot: After Arkham Asylum is destroyed, dangerous inmates flood Gotham City. A determined vigilante races to contain the chaos, but relentless battles push him toward physical and mental exhaustion as he faces a calculating new enemy who is determined to break him.

title: Cocktail 2
plot: A vacation in Sicily pushes longtime partners to reconsider their love and commitment when they reunite with one partner’s old friend. As the trio spends time together, their relationship faces new questions about trust, attraction, and the future.

title: I Will Find You
plot: A wrongfully imprisoned father begins a desperate search after discovering that the son he was convicted of killing may still be alive. As he pursues the truth and a chance at rescue, he must confront the forces that kept him behind bars.

title: Little Brother
plot: A tightly controlled realtor’s picture-perfect life is disrupted when his chaotic younger brother suddenly returns. As their opposing personalities collide, the two must navigate embarrassing mishaps, family tension, and an unexpected bond that challenges the life he has carefully built.

title: Strung
plot: A talented violinist accepts a prestigious tutoring position with an enigmatic, wealthy family. As she enters their secretive world, an opportunity that promises a better future begins to threaten her safety and peace of mind, forcing her to question her instincts and how much she is willing to overlook.

title: Million Dollar Nannies
plot: A young group of elite nannies goes to Ibiza to create an agency built by nannies, for nannies. They chase VIP families and life-changing money, but fierce competition, personal drama, and a past scandal threaten to derail their summer plans.

title: Your Fault: London
plot: A young couple begins separate new chapters, with one entering the business world and the other starting university. As new people, temptations, rivalries, and betrayals complicate their lives, their relationship faces mounting pressure and they must decide how hard to fight for it.

title: Little Singles
plot: Set in an everyday world, this series explores challenges around accessibility, stigma, dating, and self-confidence. A carefree trip among friends grows into a chosen-family bond, as the group navigates love, honesty, and belonging together.

title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
plot: After surviving a devastating plane crash, a legendary drummer undertakes a raw, personal journey through trauma, recovery, and renewal. This intimate portrait explores how he confronts pain and channels it into music, strength, and a transformed sense of purpose.

title: Raakh
plot: When two teenagers disappear, a close-knit family is devastated and a city is left on edge. A determined police officer launches a nationwide search, following a trail of violence into the darkest sides of human behavior.

title: Governor: The Silent Saviour
plot: During India’s 1990 economic crisis, a reluctant bureaucrat is unexpectedly appointed to lead the central bank as the country nears bankruptcy. With inflation climbing, fuel supplies dwindling, and public panic spreading, he faces intense political pressure while trying to steady a system close to collapse.

title: In the Hand of Dante
plot: A Vatican priest discovers what may be Dante’s original Divine Comedy manuscript and seeks help authenticating it. A literary expert becomes entangled in a dangerous criminal scheme involving the priceless text, while a parallel historical story follows Dante’s spiritual and creative struggle to complete his masterpiece.

title: Maternal Instinct
plot: Police stop a woman who says she has just given birth, but troubling inconsistencies quickly emerge: the baby and the blood are not hers. This true-crime documentary follows the investigation as conflicting accounts and hidden details come to light.

title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
plot: An elderly man shares with his grandson the story of a childhood romance shaped by love, loss, and the upheaval of the 1947 Partition of India. As memories of migration and separation surface, a bond that spans generations begins to take shape.

title: The Rest Is Football
plot: Gary Lineker, Alan Shearer, and Micah Richards lead lively, topical debate around football. Expect strong opinions and outrageous stories drawn from their careers.

title: Outlast: The Jungle
plot: On a remote tropical island, 16 players face harsh conditions while trying to outmaneuver rivals and stay with a team. They must balance cooperation, competition and survival as they pursue a chance to win a $1 million prize.

title: Every Year After
plot: Over six summers, two people find themselves drawn together by a powerful first love. Years later, a single week gives them one more chance to face what happened, understand what they want, and discover whether their connection can survive the passage of time.

title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
plot: Two tennis legends look back on their paths to sports stardom, exploring the rivalry and friendship that shaped their lives. As they face the shared challenge of cancer treatment, they continue to support one another through a deeply personal chapter.

title: Dragon Striker
plot: In a world where sports and magic combine, a farm boy discovers an extraordinary natural talent. As he trains and faces new challenges, he begins to learn that he may have a legendary role to play as the Dragon Striker.

title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
plot: A larger-than-life public-access pioneer reflects on her groundbreaking sex-positive call-in show and decades of advocacy for free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex. The documentary explores her distinctive legacy and the private life she kept out of the spotlight.

title: Alice and Steve
plot: A woman is devastated when her best friend begins dating her adult daughter, threatening both relationships at once. Determined to stop the romance, she launches a campaign against them—but her friend is ready to fight back, turning a close friendship into an escalating feud.

title: They Fight
plot: A reformed ex-convict returns home hoping to rebuild his family, but finds a new purpose at a boxing gym in a Washington, D.C., youth center facing closure. Working with a veteran coach, he mentors young boxers preparing for a major tournament while helping them navigate friendship, ambition, and tough choices.

title: 100 Cooks
plot: Terry Crews hosts a massive home-cook competition featuring 100 elite cooks battling in a stadium kitchen arena. Challenges are driven by a “Challenge Mixer,” with judges Nick DiGiovanni and Alex Guarnaschelli deciding who advances as prize money grows from $100,000.

title: The Pyramid Scheme
plot: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

title: Brown
plot: A recovering alcoholic works for the Kolkata Police, juggling personal recovery with professional pressure. When a young woman from a prominent family is murdered, he leads an investigation that tests his limits and determination.

title: Squatters: Get the F*** Out of My House
plot: Experienced squatters are exploiting legal loopholes to live rent-free while homeowners across America fight impossible battles to evict them. From con artists to an extremist, these manipulators weaponize the law and devastate lives.

title: The Witness
plot: After a woman is murdered, her partner struggles to protect their two-year-old child, the sole witness, while confronting a flawed investigation. The miniseries follows the family’s fight for safety, answers, and accountability in the aftermath of the crime.

title: Cape Fear
plot: After a convicted murderer is released from prison, he targets the family of two married attorneys who helped secure his conviction. As he works his way into their lives, the family faces an escalating threat built on fear, pressure, and unresolved consequences.

title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
plot: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common, in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case, focusing on the crime and the investigation that followed while exploring its lasting impact on those connected to it.

title: Maa Behen
plot: A dark comedy follows a woman who calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news: a dead body is in her kitchen. The unexpected call draws the family into an unsettling situation filled with tension and uneasy humor.

title: Bandar
plot: A television star’s life spirals after his former partner accuses him of rape when he blocks her contact. While beginning a new relationship, he faces arrest and confronts a corrupt justice system that challenges his personal life and sense of security.

title: Office Romance
plot: A powerful airline executive enforces a strict ban on workplace relationships, determined to keep business and romance separate. When a charismatic in-house lawyer joins the company, professional boundaries become harder to maintain, forcing her to reconsider the policy and how it affects employees.

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
plot: After leaving his marriage because of conflicting priorities, a man begins a new romance abroad. Unexpected revelations challenge his understanding of love, loyalty, and commitment, pushing him to reconsider what he truly wants and whether he can honor the responsibilities that come with lasting relationships.

title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
plot: This documentary examines a controversial trial and the complicated legacy surrounding one of pop music’s most famous figures. Through accounts from people connected to the courtroom, it explores the allegations, public debate, and enduring questions about fame, evidence, and how the case continues to divide opinion.

title: Not Suitable for Work
plot: Five work-obsessed twenty-somethings chase professional success while trying to make room for personal happiness in Manhattan’s glamorous Murray Hill neighborhood. Their ambitions, relationships, and limited free time collide as they navigate the pressures and pleasures of young adult life in the city.

title: Bring Me the Beauties: A Model Cult
plot: A fashion model is drawn into a spiritual group led by an enigmatic figure, finding himself increasingly involved in its unusual world. This miniseries explores the group’s influence and the circumstances that brought him into its orbit.

title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
plot: A celebrated comedy performer marks a landmark film career in a star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles. The event brings together guests to honor his accomplishments and reflect on the work that made him a trailblazer in comedy and film.

title: Rafa
plot: This documentary series retraces a legendary tennis champion’s remarkable journey through testimonies from people who know him on and off the court, alongside previously unseen moments that offer a closer look at the person behind the sporting legacy.

title: The Breadwinner
plot: When his wife leaves for a lengthy business trip after landing a major opportunity, a lifelong breadwinner must become a stay-at-home dad for the first time. He faces the everyday chaos of childcare, household responsibilities, and changing family roles while learning what truly keeps a family together.

title: Star City
plot: In the same alternate-history universe as For All Mankind, this series shifts perspective behind the Iron Curtain. Cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers face personal and political risks as the Soviet Union competes in the race to reach the Moon.

title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
plot: A documentary follows a former football enforcer’s turbulent journey from notorious hard man to FA Cup winner. It explores his rise, fall, setbacks, and determined comeback against the odds, tracing a remarkable path shaped by football, controversy, and resilience on and off the pitch.

title: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
plot: Sofia attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she learns she holds exceptional magic. As she meets new royal friends, she must discover how to master her powers and grow into her role.

title: Spider-Noir
plot: In 1930s New York, an aging, struggling private investigator is forced to confront his former life as the city’s only superhero. A gritty mystery unfolds amid Depression-era hardship, morally conflicted characters, and the shadowy atmosphere of classic noir.

title: Mating Season
plot: Set in the animal world, this series follows bears, raccoons, deer, foxes, and other forest creatures as they navigate love, sexual relationships, and the search for a partner. Their stories explore the universal desire for connection, intimacy, and romance.

title: Chand Mera Dil
plot: Two college sweethearts see their passionate romance tested when adulthood arrives sooner than expected. As they pursue their ambitions while facing new responsibilities, they begin to understand how love can change and grow over time.

title: The Boroughs
plot: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a group of unlikely older heroes faces an otherworldly threat that wants to steal the one thing they cannot replace: time. Together, they must confront danger while proving that age does not limit courage, connection, or purpose.

title: Ladies First
plot: An arrogant but charismatic ladies’ man sees his life of wealth, influence, and casual relationships upended when he awakens in a parallel world where women hold the power. Forced to navigate unfamiliar rules, he must reconsider the assumptions that shaped his former life.

title: Desi Bling
plot: Glitzy parties and delicious secrets rule the lives of ultra-wealthy Indian expats as they spare no expense — or drama.

title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
plot: A reluctant intelligence operative is drawn back into espionage when an international mission exposes a dangerous conspiracy. Working with trusted agency allies and a skilled foreign intelligence officer, he races to stop a rogue covert unit in a tense, personal action thriller.

title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
plot: A newly divorced mother is drawn into a dangerous situation after witnessing an apparent attack during a paid online conversation. As threats, blackmail, and murder enter her life, she investigates while trying to manage a custody battle and youth soccer responsibilities.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
plot: Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley. They self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: Dutton Ranch
plot: A hardened rancher and a fiercely determined woman gamble everything on building a new life in South Texas. Their hopes of escaping the past soon clash with brutal realities and a powerful rival ranch willing to do whatever it takes to protect its empire.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
plot: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn after one decision sets off a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos. As tensions rise, the couple must navigate the increasingly complicated consequences of their situation.

title: Nemesis
plot: A relentless police officer becomes fixated on stopping a master thief responsible for a string of daring heists. As their pursuit intensifies, each must outmaneuver the other in a high-stakes battle of determination and skill.

title: The Crash
plot: After a teenager crashes her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend, the incident is initially treated as a tragic accident. As investigators look more closely, the case develops into a murder inquiry, raising difficult questions about what really happened.

title: Driver's Ed
plot: A lovesick high school senior impulsively steals a driver's education car, pulling three classmates into an urgent road trip to reconnect with his girlfriend at college. Along the way, the unlikely group faces growing-up uncertainties, awkward situations, and plenty of goofy misadventures.

title: Is God Is
plot: Two twin sisters set out on an epic revenge quest after learning that their estranged mother is alive and asking them to confront the man who devastated their family. Their journey through a charged, stylized world tests their bond and pushes them toward increasingly extreme choices.

title: Off Campus
plot: A college student tutors a hockey captain to help him win over someone he likes, but their arrangement grows into a genuine connection. As they confront difficult past experiences, their friends navigate relationships, friendship, and everyday college life.

title: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
plot: This miniseries offers an inside look at the United States Men’s National Soccer Team during the run-up to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. Filmed over four years, it tracks the squad’s personal and collective journeys toward the sport’s biggest stage.

title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
plot: A grandmother’s social media mishap creates turmoil among her children and puts her granddaughter’s wedding plans at risk. As the family reacts, the story explores generational differences, family expectations, and the complications that can arise when private matters become public.

title: Dug Dug
plot: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

title: M.I.A.
plot: Restless in the Florida Keys, a young woman dreams of Miami’s glittering world. After tragedy shatters her family’s drug-running business, she enters the city’s dangerous underbelly, beginning a journey that will test her identity and reveal what she may be capable of.

title: Legends
plot: As drugs spread through the streets of 1990s Britain, a team of civil servants is sent undercover. Their mission is to challenge the gangs behind the crisis, placing them in a dangerous struggle against organized criminal networks and the forces driving the drug trade.

title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
plot: This documentary traces a legendary heavy metal band’s journey from modest East London pubs to worldwide stadiums across five decades. Drawing on official archives, personal recollections, contributor interviews, fan stories, and new animated sequences featuring its iconic mascot, it explores the group’s enduring ambition and global connection.

title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
plot: During quiet night shifts at a local aquarium, an elderly widow forms unexpected bonds with those around her. A life-changing discovery gradually opens the door to renewed joy, connection, and wonder, helping her face long-held loneliness and old wounds.

title: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft
plot: A concert film captures a celebrated singer during her sold-out world tour, bringing her live performances, audience connection, and behind-the-scenes moments to the big screen. Presented in immersive 3D, it also explores the staging, effects, and production behind the show.

title: Sairaab
plot: Single mother Dr. Noyonika lives a serene life with her daughter, Ujjayani. Then enters pop star Ishaan, reigniting her world, albeit with uncalled chaos!

title: Glory
plot: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a difficult reunion with their father, a renowned coach. The story combines family tensions, crime, and the pressures surrounding a close-knit sporting community.

title: Ek Din
plot: A shy office worker is in love with his colleague but cannot bring himself to confess. During a company trip, he makes a wish to spend one day with her—and unexpectedly gets the chance to do so.

title: Prisoner
plot: A young, ambitious prison officer is drawn into a dangerous struggle within the criminal underworld as powerful figures seek to evade justice. To navigate the threat, she must quickly decide whether to trust one of the very men she is determined to imprison.

title: Man on Fire
plot: Haunted by his past and pursued by enemies, a former Special Forces veteran takes on the dangerous streets of Rio de Janeiro to protect a teenage girl. Their fight for survival puts his skills, resolve, and ability to trust to the test.

title: Should I Marry a Murderer?
plot: A pathologist’s engagement takes a disturbing turn when her fiancé confesses that he and his twin brother were involved in a cyclist’s death and the concealment of his body. The series follows the unsettling personal and criminal questions raised by this revelation.

title: The House of the Spirits
plot: A proud family’s passions, secret loves, and long-held struggles unfold across a century of sweeping social change. As revolution brings violence and upheaval, a powerful patriarch and his beloved granddaughter are drawn onto opposing sides of a deepening conflict.

title: Hokum
plot: A troubled novelist retreats to a remote Irish hotel to scatter his parents’ ashes, only to become fascinated by stories of a witch trapped in its honeymoon suite. As unsettling visions, local superstition, and a disappearance draw him deeper into the hotel’s secrets, he must face painful parts of his past.

title: The Cult of NatureBoy
plot: In 2016, a rising social media personality known as “NatureBoy” drew followers into a group called Carbon Nation, urging them to leave their families behind for his vision of a self-proclaimed utopia. What started as an alternative lifestyle community turns into something darker and more sinister.

title: Widow's Bay
plot: A New England mayor sets out to transform a small coastal town into a major tourist destination, brushing aside long-standing warnings that the place is cursed. As the ambitious plan takes shape, the town’s close-knit community must reckon with an unsettling reputation that refuses to stay in the past.

title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2
plot: A mismatched pair is drawn into a lively story involving a wrestler and a vibrant young woman. Blending romance, comedy, and drama, the film follows their relationship as their contrasting personalities bring them into unexpected situations and emotional complications.

title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
plot: In the winter of 1985, Hawkins is once again a town crawling with secrets. Its beloved heroes face fresh mysteries and an all-new breed of strange, bringing the unusual back to a place already full of secrets and unanswered questions.

title: Unchosen
plot: A young mother raised in a sheltered cult encounters a mysterious stranger and begins a risky affair. As her desires awaken, she is drawn toward dangerous choices and troubling secrets that challenge the world she has always known.

title: 4X20: Quick Hits
plot: This anthology brings together four twenty-minute films exploring one of the world’s most beloved plants and the people who feel strongly about it. Each short offers a different perspective on the plant’s cultural appeal and the communities surrounding it.

title: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
plot: A comedian travels across the country with help from established comedy figures to discover the next stand-up star. Contestants face a range of challenges and performances, while viewers ultimately choose the winner, who receives the chance to earn a Netflix special.

title: Matka King
plot: In 1960s Mumbai, an ambitious cotton trader seeking legitimacy and respect creates a new gambling game called Matka. As it spreads across the city, the game opens a world once limited to the wealthy, bringing opportunity, risk, and social change.

After a sudden road-rage incident leaves a father’s son in critical condition, grief and anger push him into an increasingly dangerous search for vengeance. As emotional turmoil takes hold, he must confront the consequences of following a dark and destructive path.

title: Jerry West: The Logo
plot: A legendary basketball figure builds dynasties, breaks barriers, and becomes an enduring symbol of the game. Through rare interviews with family members and basketball icons, this documentary explores the personal pressures, perfectionism, and pain beneath an extraordinary public legacy.

title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
plot: A veteran naturalist recounts the story of a remarkable gorilla group, tracing the connection from a first encounter decades ago through the present day. The documentary explores their lives while offering a deeply personal perspective on the animals and the bond formed over time.

title: Normal
plot: A quiet substitute sheriff with a troubled past expects an uneventful assignment in a sleepy town. When a bank robbery alarm disrupts the calm, he is drawn into a dangerous situation involving armed criminals, hidden wealth, and local secrets that make the town far less ordinary than it seems.

title: Bhooth Bangla
plot: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans to hold his sister’s wedding there. When strange supernatural events unsettle the property and panic spreads among local residents, he begins investigating the palace’s mysterious past.

title: Balls Up
plot: Two marketing executives pitch an outrageous condom sponsorship tied to the World Cup. When a drunken celebration in Brazil ignites an international scandal, they face furious fans, criminals, and powerful officials while scrambling to protect their careers and find a way home.

title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
plot: A recent college dropout and aspiring writer faces the pressures of caring for a new baby while bills pile up and financial options disappear. Coming from a complicated family background, she must find a practical way forward without giving up on her ambitions.

title: Untold: Jail Blazers
plot: This documentary examines how a championship-caliber professional basketball team in Portland unraveled amid volatile player behavior, criminal charges, and intense national media attention. It offers an unflinching look at the pressures and conflicts surrounding a team whose public image changed dramatically.

title: Boy Band Confidential
plot: This series looks at how pop groups were built into massive fame and what that process demanded behind the scenes. Through candid interviews, it explores control, pressure, and exploitation, along with the personal toll that came with success.

title: Roommates
plot: A shy college freshman asks a confident classmate to become her roommate, hoping for a blossoming friendship. Instead, their living arrangement gradually turns into a tense battle of passive aggression as differences and expectations collide.

title: Big Mistakes
plot: Blackmailed into working for dangerous criminals, two deeply incapable siblings find themselves pulled into organized crime. As they try to handle increasingly risky tasks, their partnership becomes a disorganized blend of panic, poor judgment, and reluctant cooperation.

title: Thrash
plot: When a catastrophic hurricane strikes a coastal town, stranded residents face rapidly rising floodwaters and ravenous sharks. Trapped in an increasingly dangerous environment, they must find ways to survive the storm, the confined spaces, and predators lurking beneath the surface.

title: The Testaments
plot: Growing up inside Gilead, a new generation of young women confronts a future shaped by oppression and control. As they begin questioning the world they inherited, they must find allies—both familiar and unexpected—to help them seek freedom.

title: Untold: Chess Mates
plot: A rising online chess star defeats an established champion in a major tournament, triggering allegations that threaten his reputation. Determined to clear his name and return to the top, he pursues redemption while preparing for a high-stakes rematch.

title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
plot: After the Clone Wars, a powerful former Sith seeks to rebuild a criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire. The series follows his calculated rise through a slow-burning, cyberpunk-inspired underworld filled with dangerous alliances, mentors, and lightsaber action.

title: Outcome
plot: A famous actor who has been in the spotlight since childhood learns of an extortion plot connected to a mysterious video. He begins a redemption tour, trying to repair damaged relationships, face personal struggles, and protect his public image before the scandal overwhelms him.

title: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
plot: In a small coastal community where everyone knows everyone, family names carry real weight and old loyalties run deep. Longstanding friendships and carefully guarded secrets begin to unravel when betrayal exposes cracks beneath the surface.

title: Secrets of the Bees
plot: An immersive nature miniseries explores the extraordinary world of bees, revealing their intricate architecture, remarkable intelligence, and complex behavior. Using advanced filming techniques and expert insight, it captures rarely seen moments that offer a closer look at how these fascinating insects live and interact.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
plot: Follows parents confronting the unthinkable truth that their child has grown into a monster who committed horrifying crimes, featuring first-person interviews.

title: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
plot: An Australian comedian explores the absurdities of life in the United States, turning everyday experiences into dry observations. The stand-up special touches on New York City sidewalk riddles, unexpected sources of news, and the strange details that make ordinary life feel surreal.

title: The Predator of Seville
plot: A friendly guide known for organizing inexpensive trips across Spain becomes linked to a disturbing pattern of abuse. The case emerges as several young women compare experiences that once appeared unrelated, prompting a closer look at the image he presented to international students.

title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
plot: A father-to-be investigates the rapid rise of artificial intelligence, speaking with influential voices who see its possibilities, dangers, and uncertain future in very different ways. The documentary explores AI’s history and growing impact on society while asking what could happen if humanity fails to guide this powerful technology responsibly.

title: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
plot: A bride is convinced that something horrifying will happen at her wedding. As the ceremony draws closer, her fear intensifies, transforming what should be a joyful occasion into an increasingly unsettling ordeal filled with dread and uncertainty.

title: They Will Kill You
plot: A woman takes a housekeeping job in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that its residents are connected to years of disappearances. As danger closes in, she must navigate a bizarre, violent community possibly controlled by a Satanic cult.

title: Jury Duty Presents: Company Retreat
plot: A real temp joins a hot sauce company’s annual retreat, which is the last one before its CEO retires. As the CEO’s son tries to demonstrate his leadership, a private-equity team pursues an acquisition, bringing competing pressures into the workplace gathering.

title: Do Not Enter
plot: A group of young explorers enters an abandoned hotel to investigate its mysteries, but their search brings them face to face with a strange supernatural presence. Their expedition becomes more dangerous when another group arrives, pursuing a legendary treasure hidden somewhere inside.

title: Imperfect Women
plot: A murder shatters the lives of three lifelong friends, forcing them to confront the strain on their bond. As the investigation unfolds, hidden betrayals and unsettling truths challenge what they thought they knew about one another.

title: Preschool
plot: Two determined fathers enter an escalating, absurd competition to secure one coveted place at an elite preschool for their children. As their rivalry grows increasingly chaotic, the contest pushes them to reconsider what matters most about supporting their kids.

title: The Plastic Detox
plot: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples facing unexplained infertility as they reduce their exposure to plastics, hoping the lifestyle change may help them conceive. Along the way, it explores concerns about everyday plastic use and reproductive health.

title: Rooster Fighter
plot: A remarkable rooster sets out to defend humanity against towering monsters, relying on fierce determination, unusual powers, and a mighty battle cry. Along the way, he encounters allies and travels between cities as he confronts increasingly dangerous threats while seeking answers about a devastating past encounter.

title: The Madison
plot: A comfortable New York family leaves city life behind for Montana’s Madison River Valley, seeking connection amid vast wilderness and personal loss. As they adjust to their new surroundings, the family confronts grief, strained relationships, and the possibility of healing through a slower, more intentional way of living.

title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
plot: Two gangsters and the woman they love face the most dangerous night of their lives, with survival complicated by the arrival of a time machine. Their chaotic ordeal blends crime, romance, comedy, action, and time-traveling sci-fi into one unpredictable adventure.

title: Over Your Dead Body
plot: A dysfunctional couple travels to a remote cabin to reconnect, but each secretly intends to kill the other. As their getaway unfolds, the pair must contend with a dangerous relationship shaped by mutual distrust and hidden motives.

title: Dynasty: The Murdochs
plot: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

title: Sniper: No Nation
plot: A skilled sniper and a covert agent lead a dangerous rescue mission in Costa Verde after their friends are taken hostage. They must navigate hostile territory and mounting threats while working together to bring the captives home.

title: Pizza Movie
plot: A group of college students heads to their dorm lobby to collect a pizza delivery. After taking a homemade drug, their trip down two flights of stairs becomes a strange, mind-bending quest that transforms an ordinary errand into an unpredictable adventure.

title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
