plot: This documentary explores the formative years of a groundbreaking rock band and the profound influence of its original guitarist. Through memories, personal reflections, and an emotionally focused account of the group’s early history, it traces the relationships, ambitions, and circumstances that shaped their beginnings.

title: Pretty Lethal
plot: A troupe of ballerinas is stranded at a remote inn when their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition. As they try to escape, they must fight to survive against an escalating threat, turning their physical skills into a surprising means of defense.

title: The Gates
plot: A road trip takes a terrifying turn when three friends witness a murder inside a gated community. Trapped and blamed by the residents, they struggle to stay safe as pressure mounts and their friendship begins to fracture.

title: Undertone
plot: A paranormal podcast host, already strained by caring for her seriously ill mother, receives disturbing recordings that seem to document a couple’s increasingly sinister nighttime experiences. As she investigates the audio with her co-host, skepticism gives way to an unsettling mystery that begins to affect her isolated home life.

title: Scarpetta
plot: A renowned forensic pathologist returns as Virginia’s chief medical examiner and faces a haunting murder connected to her earliest major case. Set across the present day and 1998, the series follows investigations into brutal stranglings alongside a detective and an FBI agent, while personal relationships and old tensions complicate the work.

title: Reminders of Him
plot: After serving time for a tragic accident, a young mother returns to her hometown hoping to reconnect with the daughter she has never known. Facing resistance from the child’s guardians, she finds an unexpected ally in a local bar owner, and their growing bond brings complicated emotions, difficult choices, and the possibility of a fresh start.

title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
plot: A celebrated documentarian enters the online world of ultra-masculine influencers, exploring their views on masculinity, dating, money, and status. Through calm conversations and unusual access to their private lives, he observes how performance, controversy, and attention shape this controversial internet culture.

title: Rooster
plot: On a college campus, an author takes on a teaching role while navigating a complicated relationship with his daughter. The series blends low-stakes comedy, family tension, and eccentric characters as he adjusts to an unfamiliar setting and the changing dynamics of his personal life.

title: The Dinosaurs
plot: This epic documentary miniseries traces dinosaurs across 165 million years, exploring how changing environments and other forces shaped their evolution. Through dramatic recreations of prehistoric life, it presents a broad journey from the earliest dinosaurs to their final era on Earth.

title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
plot: After his estranged son becomes involved in a Nazi plot, a self-exiled gangster returns to Birmingham. He must protect his family while confronting divided loyalties, wartime danger, and the difficult legacy of his criminal past.

title: Young Sherlock
plot: A disgraced young man becomes entangled in a murder case that threatens his freedom. His first investigation expands into a globe-spanning conspiracy, forcing him to confront danger, family complications, and the choices that will shape his future.

title: The Bride!
plot: In 1930s Chicago, a lonely reanimated man asks an ambitious scientist to help create a companion. Together, they bring a murdered young woman back to life, but her awakening leads her toward independence as their strange experiment draws attention and unleashes consequences neither creator expected.

title: Marshals
plot: After leaving a family ranch, a highly trained cowboy and former Navy SEAL joins an elite U.S. Marshals unit in Montana. He and his teammates pursue dangerous criminals while trying to balance family responsibilities, professional duty, and the emotional toll of standing between the region and escalating violence.

title: DTF St. Louis
plot: A love triangle unfolds among three adults facing the frustrations of middle age, strained marriages, and unspoken desires. When one of them ends up dead, detectives piece together the relationships, deceptions, and choices that led to the tragedy.

title: Ghost Elephants
plot: In Angola’s mist-shrouded highlands, three master trackers begin a spiritual search for legendary elephants believed lost to time. Guided by ancestral memory, trance, ritual, and deep knowledge of the land, their journey explores the ties between indigenous communities, wilderness, myth, and humanity’s longing to rediscover what may have vanished.

title: Nukkad Naatak
plot: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

title: One Mile: Chapter Two
plot: A former special forces operative is drawn back to a remote island when a secretive, violent community abducts his daughter. Facing enemies who anticipate his tactics, he must use planning, endurance, traps and close-quarters combat to pursue them through a dangerous landscape.

title: Lost Women of Alaska
plot: After two Alaska Native women are brutally murdered, investigators race to piece together clues across a harsh landscape. The series follows the unsettling search for answers and the determined effort to bring a sadistic killer to justice.

title: Scrubs
plot: Two longtime medical friends return to Sacred Heart, where changing medicine and a new generation of interns bring fresh challenges. Familiar faces and newcomers balance workplace pressures, friendship, heartfelt moments, and comedy as they find their place in a different era.

title: CIA
plot: A by-the-book FBI agent joins a secretive joint task force in New York, where he is paired with a rule-bending CIA officer. Together, they tackle covert operations involving international plots, terrorist cells, and sensitive geopolitical secrets while navigating their very different approaches.

title: One Mile: Chapter One
plot: After leaving special forces, an estranged father takes his daughter on a college tour, hoping to rebuild their relationship. Their trip turns into a dangerous fight for survival when a murderous cult begins pursuing them, forcing them to rely on each other in unfamiliar wilderness.

title: Do Deewane Seher Mein
plot: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while wrestling with self-acceptance, personal insecurities, and societal pressure. Their relationship unfolds through family expectations, everyday misunderstandings, and a journey from the city's hectic energy to the calm of the mountains.

title: Psycho Killer
plot: After her husband is brutally murdered, a Kansas highway patrol officer begins tracking the killer herself. The pursuit leads her toward a sadistic serial murderer whose occult clues and disturbing agenda make the case more dangerous and twisted than a straightforward manhunt.

title: Murder in Glitterball City
plot: In Louisville, Kentucky, a shocking killing unsettles a neighborhood known for its historic charm and glitterball lore. This documentary revisits the case through shifting timelines, a volatile relationship, and conflicting testimony, as two former partners face trial and the truth remains hard to pin down.

title: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
plot: In this emotional interview, an actor and ALS advocate shares a final message for the world, knowing it will not air until after his death. The conversation focuses on his personal words and the significance of their delayed broadcast.

title: I Can Only Imagine 2
plot: A successful touring musician struggles to balance fame with family, especially his fragile relationship with his son. When a hopeful new bandmate joins the tour, their friendship brings renewed gratitude and challenges the musician to confront painful patterns, repair damaged relationships, and remember what matters most.

title: 56 Days
plot: After an unidentified body is discovered in a luxury apartment, two detectives investigate the relationship between a couple whose romance unfolded over the previous 56 days. Moving between the investigation and the past, the series explores attraction, secrecy, manipulation, and the warning signs surrounding a deadly crime.

title: Epic: Elvis Presley in Concert
plot: Rare concert, rehearsal, interview, and home-movie footage brings a legendary Las Vegas performer’s 1970s residency to the big screen. Newly rediscovered recordings let him reflect in his own words, while archival material celebrates his musical range, stage presence, personal life, and connection with audiences.

title: The Bluff
plot: A former pirate’s peaceful life on a remote island is disrupted when a vengeful ex-captain arrives with a ruthless crew. As her family faces a siege, she must draw on her dangerous past and long-forgotten skills to protect them.

title: Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association
plot: This four-part documentary explores the ABA’s nine-year rivalry with the NBA and its lasting impact on basketball. Former players, coaches, and sports figures discuss the league’s groundbreaking ideas, including the three-point shot and Slam Dunk Contest, alongside its cultural and social significance.

title: Love Story
plot: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

title: How to Get to Heaven from Belfast
plot: Three lifelong friends reunite after an old friend’s suspicious death and find themselves drawn into a chaotic mystery. As they investigate across Ireland, their shared history, complicated lives, and a closely guarded secret make the search increasingly difficult to control.

title: Tyler Perry's Joe's College Road Trip
plot: A sheltered, college-bound teen sets out on a cross-country road trip with his outspoken great-uncle, who hopes to introduce him to the wider world. Along the way, their clashing perspectives make room for comedy and lessons about history and heritage.

title: Love Me, Love Me
plot: After her brother’s death, a young woman moves to Milan and starts over at an international school. She finds comfort with a seemingly perfect student, but his troubled best friend draws her into a dangerous rivalry and intense attraction, forcing her to weigh emotional risk against the safety she once wanted.

title: Crime 101
plot: An elusive Los Angeles thief plans one final high-stakes job along the 101 freeway, while an insurance broker facing professional and personal crossroads becomes part of his scheme. A determined detective follows the robbery pattern, and a dangerous rival raises the pressure as the operation takes shape.

title: Solo Mio
plot: After a wedding-day heartbreak derails his plans, a man travels through Italy alone on the honeymoon he had arranged. Along the way, he embraces local culture, food, and scenery, while unexpected friendships and a meaningful connection with a woman invite him to reconsider what comes next.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
plot: After surviving the previous ordeal, a battered young woman remains trapped in a dangerous small town, where masked killers continue targeting anyone who crosses their path. As she faces an unavoidable confrontation, the story explores her psychological strain and reveals more about the forces behind the violence.

title: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
plot: This documentary examines a high-profile criminal case involving a former nurse convicted of harming infants, following the investigation, trial, and questions surrounding the evidence. It presents perspectives on the case while exploring how the justice process shaped the public understanding of events.

title: Dog Park
plot: In the grip of a mid-life crisis, Roland meets the eternal optimist Samantha and her life-loving group of dog-parkers. As Roland begrudgingly keeps returning to the park, he realises he might need a community to belong to.

title: Under Salt Marsh
plot: In a close-knit Welsh town threatened by a gathering storm and rising seas, a former detective now working as a teacher finds the body of a young pupil. The discovery stirs painful memories of her niece’s disappearance three years earlier and draws the community back into an unresolved mystery.

title: Miracle: The Boys of '80
plot: This documentary revisits the 1980 U.S. Olympic hockey team’s stunning victory over the Soviet Union during the Cold War. Using rare 16mm footage and reflections from the players, it explores the team’s journey, the era’s national tensions, and the lasting meaning of their underdog achievement.

title: Melania
plot: This documentary follows a First Lady-elect during the 20 days before a presidential inauguration, offering access to planning meetings, private conversations, family life, and the transition back into public service. It presents her efforts to organize the event while navigating the demands and visibility of a powerful political role.

title: Wonder Man
plot: Two actors at very different points in their careers pursue life-changing opportunities in Hollywood. As one navigates the pressures of a demanding industry alongside emerging superpowers, their developing friendship brings humor, vulnerability, and a grounded perspective to the superhero world.

title: Queen of Chess
plot: This documentary follows a Hungarian girl raised through an intense chess-focused upbringing as she pursues success in a male-dominated world. It traces her family life, rapid rise, major competitions, and long rivalry with a reigning world champion while exploring the barriers she faced as a woman.

title: In the Blink of an Eye
plot: Three interwoven stories unfold across thousands of years, exploring how hope and human connection endure through changing eras. As the narratives gradually intersect, the film reflects on mortality, relationships, and the recurring patterns that link individual lives to the larger circle of existence.

title: Honey Bunch
plot: After a life-threatening accident leaves a woman with memory loss, her husband brings her to an experimental trauma facility hidden in the wilderness. As the treatment gradually unlocks fragments of her past, the isolated setting and the couple’s relationship become increasingly unsettling, raising questions about trust, consent, and what really happened.

title: Border 2
plot: Three idealistic soldiers serving in the army, navy, and air force endure harsh combat conditions during the 1971 Indo-Pak war. As they face danger and uncertainty, the film follows their courage, duty, camaraderie, and the personal cost of serving during wartime.

title: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
plot: A two-part documentary traces the life and legacy of a celebrated comedian, from his childhood and wartime service to a wide-ranging career in comedy, film, television, and theater. Through candid reflections and interviews, it also explores the friendships, family relationships, and personal experiences that shaped his work.

title: Free Bert
plot: A loud, unconventional father and his equally outspoken family create chaos while trying to fit in with the judgmental crowd at their prestigious new school. Their attempt to navigate unfamiliar social rules brings plenty of awkward situations, family friction, and opportunities to stay true to themselves.

title: Disneyland Handcrafted
plot: An archival documentary explores the immense effort behind bringing Disneyland from an ambitious dream to reality. Through restored footage and firsthand accounts, it highlights the workers, challenges, decisions, and passion involved in creating a place that would inspire millions.

title: The President's Cake
plot: In 1990s Iraq, a nine-year-old girl is chosen to prepare a cake for a mandatory presidential birthday celebration. With ingredients scarce, she travels from the marshes into the city alongside her grandmother, loyal friend, and pet rooster, facing vendors, police, and the pressures of life under fear and deprivation.

title: Clika
plot: An ambitious small-town musician chases a breakthrough after a performance clip goes viral. As he pushes to claim a spot in a rising Mexican-American music scene, new opportunities bring pressure, tough choices, and a risky situation that’s more dangerous than he expected.

title: Send Help
plot: After a plane crash leaves two colleagues stranded on a deserted island, they must overcome old grievances and cooperate to survive. As their struggle continues, the island becomes the setting for an increasingly tense battle of wills, wits, and shifting power.

title: The Beauty
plot: When international supermodels begin dying in mysterious, gruesome circumstances, two FBI agents travel to Paris to investigate. Their case leads to a sexually transmitted virus that creates extraordinary physical beauty while bringing frightening consequences, drawing them into a dark mystery about desire, appearance, and danger.

title: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart
plot: This documentary recounts the abduction of a teenage girl from her family’s Utah home, her months-long ordeal, and the extensive search that followed. Told through her testimony and previously unseen material, it explores family trauma, investigative failures, manipulation, survival, and the lasting effort to help others.

title: Whistle
plot: A group of high school students discovers an ancient cursed whistle that summons visions of their future deaths and brings them dangerously close to reality. As the threat pursues them, the students must uncover the artifact’s rules and find a way to escape its deadly curse.

title: Mercy
plot: In the near future, a detective is accused of murdering his wife and placed before an advanced AI judge he once supported. With only ninety minutes to challenge the evidence and prove his innocence, he must navigate a ruthless justice system before it decides his fate.

title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
plot: A disgraced former football player is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
plot: A young, inexperienced knight travels across Westeros with his clever, diminutive squire. In a realm still ruled by the Targaryens, the unlikely companions encounter dangerous challenges, powerful opponents, and the first steps toward destinies far greater than either expects.

title: Killer Whale
plot: Two best friends become trapped in a remote lagoon, stranded in the water with a dangerous killer whale circling nearby. As they search for a way to escape, their isolation turns a simple trip into a fight for survival.

title: Night Patrol
plot: An L.A. police officer uncovers a hidden threat within a local task force, placing the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger. As the investigation deepens, the patrol’s actions force him to confront a disturbing conflict between law enforcement, the community, and a supernatural menace.

title: Ponies
plot: In 1977 Moscow, two overlooked embassy employees are drawn into CIA work after their husbands, secretly involved in espionage, are killed. As they investigate what happened, the unlikely partners take on increasingly dangerous missions and uncover a wider Cold War conspiracy.

title: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
plot: At a lavish country house party in 1925 England, a practical joke takes a deadly turn. An unexpectedly inquisitive young woman sets out to unravel a chilling mystery, uncovering a plot that could change her life and open up a wider world of country house intrigue.

title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
plot: A dedicated customs officer leads a specialized team investigating a powerful smuggling network operating through airport routes and international connections. As the operation grows more complicated, the team faces corruption, dangerous obstacles, and mounting pressure to bring the syndicate down.

title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
plot: A young survivor is drawn deeper into the grip of a brutal cult leader, while a compassionate doctor studies a powerful infected person whose unusual behavior could reshape understanding of the outbreak. Their separate journeys unfold amid violence, belief, and fragile attempts to preserve humanity in a devastated world.

title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
plot: A celebrity host embarks on a 100-day journey from one pole to the other, facing extreme environments alongside scientists, explorers, and local experts. Along the way, the series explores remarkable landscapes, environmental change, scientific discoveries, and the people whose lives are shaped by these places.

title: The Internship
plot: A CIA-trained assassin brings together graduates of a secret childhood program to take down the organization that created them. As the CIA responds with deadly force, the group faces a dangerous fight shaped by loyalty, betrayal, and their unusual training.

title: The Rip
plot: When a team of Miami police officers discovers millions of dollars in a rundown stash house, suspicion spreads through their ranks. As trust breaks down, the officers must question their loyalties while confronting the pressure and temptation created by the unexpected find.

title: Girl Taken
plot: In a quiet rural English town, twin sisters’ lives are shattered when one is abducted by a trusted local teacher. After years held captive, she escapes and must face the difficult realities of freedom, while her family struggles with the lasting psychological consequences and painful changes brought by her return.

title: His & Hers
plot: Two estranged spouses—a detective and a news reporter—become rivals in the investigation of a murder. As each suspects the other may be involved, the case exposes hidden tensions, strained relationships, and secrets within their community.

title: Harlan Coben's Final Twist
plot: Known for his twisting narratives and intricate plots, Harlan Coben guides audiences through gripping tales of murder and high-profile crimes. Each story is meticulously unraveled to reveal hidden truths. With exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, each episode provides an in-depth look at stories where nothing is as it seems.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
plot: Follows the Andrea Yates case, exploring how a rogue street preacher's fire-and-brimstone teachings allegedly brought the vulnerable Texas mother under his control, leading to the drowning of her five children in 2001.

title: Run Away
plot: A desperate father searches for his runaway daughter after her friend is murdered, drawing him into a dangerous investigation beyond the police. As he follows a trail of lies, secrets, and troubling connections, his efforts threaten to unsettle his family and expose painful truths.

title: Primate
plot: A college student returns to her family’s Hawaii home with friends, where they spend time alongside the household’s beloved chimpanzee. After the animal contracts rabies, its behavior becomes dangerously violent, forcing the group into a desperate fight to survive their isolated surroundings.

title: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story
plot: This documentary examines a disturbing case involving a therapist and a parenting influencer whose authority and religious beliefs were used to control vulnerable families. It follows the events surrounding their arrests and explores manipulation, child abuse, and the warning signs that allowed harm to continue.

title: Members Only: Palm Beach
plot: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

title: Redux Redux
plot: A grieving mother travels through parallel universes to repeatedly hunt down the person responsible for her daughter’s death. As her relentless quest erodes her humanity, she rescues a sharp-witted teenager targeted by the same killer, forcing vengeance and survival into uneasy conflict.

title: The Copenhagen Test
plot: When an intelligence analyst discovers that his senses have been hacked and monitored, he becomes part of an elaborate operation created by his own agency. As he navigates shifting loyalties, surveillance, and layered deceptions, he must determine what is real while helping draw out the forces behind the intrusion.

title: The Testament of Ann Lee
plot: This historical musical follows a determined religious leader who rises from humble beginnings in 18th-century England and leads followers across the Atlantic. Facing persecution and resistance, she builds a new community around spiritual devotion, gender equality, social ideals, and an unconventional form of worship.

title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
plot: A carefree wedding planner and a headstrong novelist meet during a lively summer in Croatia. Their playful clashes gradually deepen into romance, but differences over love, family, and tradition put their growing connection under pressure.

title: Anaconda
plot: A group of longtime friends facing midlife disappointments travel to the rainforest to remake a beloved movie from their youth. Their low-budget filmmaking adventure takes a dangerous turn when natural disasters, giant snakes, and violent criminals transform the project into a fight for survival.

title: Elway
plot: This documentary traces a legendary quarterback’s journey from early football dreams through professional setbacks, personal challenges, and eventual Super Bowl redemption. Told largely in his own words, it combines career highlights, difficult moments, family perspectives, and reflections on the patience and perseverance behind lasting success.

title: Jake Paul vs. Anthony Joshua
plot: A headline boxing event pits a brash challenger against a proven heavyweight force in a live, career-defining super fight. With major stakes and plenty of hype, both fighters look to prove they belong at the top under the bright lights.

title: Cover-Up
plot: This documentary explores the career of an investigative journalist who spent decades uncovering stories powerful institutions wanted buried. Through interviews, personal reflections, archival material, and accounts from colleagues, it examines his reporting on war, government secrecy, abuse, corporate misconduct, and other major public controversies.

title: Is This Thing On?
plot: As a long marriage begins to unravel, a middle-aged father turns to stand-up comedy while his wife explores a new direction of her own. While co-parenting and adapting to separation, they confront questions of identity, personal fulfillment, and whether their relationship can change without disappearing.

title: Breakdown: 1975
plot: Against the backdrop of America’s political and social upheaval, this documentary explores how movies reflected and influenced the national mood around 1975. Historical events, film clips, and commentary connect a turbulent cultural moment with an extraordinary period of American filmmaking.

title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
plot: A determined young sponge sets out to prove his bravery by joining a mysterious ghost pirate on a seafaring adventure. Their journey plunges into the deepest parts of the ocean, where he faces strange creatures, escalating challenges, and lessons about loyalty, perseverance, and growing up.

title: Song Sung Blue
plot: Based on a true story, two struggling musicians meet and form a spirited tribute act devoted to Neil Diamond’s music. As their partnership grows into love and family life, they pursue bigger opportunities while facing personal setbacks that test their recovery, resilience, and shared dreams.

title: David
plot: A young shepherd with deep faith is chosen for a greater purpose as a powerful king faces growing threats. Armed with courage, music, and a sling, he confronts a fearsome giant and navigates danger, loyalty, family, and the responsibilities that come with being marked for leadership.

title: Dust Bunny
plot: A ten-year-old girl convinced a monster under her bed has taken her family hires a mysterious hitman neighbor to destroy it. As assassins close in, the unlikely pair confronts danger, fear, and the possibility that the girl’s terrifying claims may be true.

title: Fallout: The Ghoul Log
plot: A holiday special follows a hardened wanderer and a bizarre burning-arm companion through an unusually festive 90-minute adventure. With an irreverent tone and strange seasonal premise, it offers a very different kind of holiday viewing experience.

title: Merv
plot: After a breakup, two former partners share custody of their unhappy dog. A Florida getaway at a dog-friendly resort brings them back into close contact, where awkward moments, lingering feelings, and their pet’s recovery create a chance to reconsider their relationship.

title: Merrily We Roll Along
plot: A gifted Broadway composer leaves his theater career and longtime friends behind to pursue Hollywood success. Told in reverse order, this filmed stage musical traces the defining moments of three intertwined lives, exploring ambition, friendship, love, and the choices that shape who they become.

title: Oh. What. Fun.
plot: An overworked mother plans a special holiday outing for her family, only to be accidentally left behind. Feeling overlooked, she sets off on an unexpected adventure while her family scrambles to find her, leading everyone into a Christmas experience far different from the one they planned.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
plot: A year after a supernatural nightmare at a family pizza restaurant, local stories have turned the tragedy into a campy legend celebrated by a new festival. A young girl secretly returns to the abandoned attraction to reconnect with its animatronic figures, unleashing terrifying events and uncovering dark secrets about the restaurant’s origins.

title: Father Mother Sister Brother
plot: Three understated stories explore adult children reconnecting with emotionally distant parents and siblings. Across rural, urban, and domestic settings, uneasy visits, formal rituals, and the sorting of family belongings reveal strained bonds, loneliness, affection, and the ways relatives conceal or misunderstand one another.

title: Me No Pause Me Play
plot: Me No Pause Me Play is a heartwarming and empowering story of women navigating life's transitions, rediscovering their strength, and redefining identity beyond age, delivering a powerful message of awareness and acceptance around menopause.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
plot: A psychology student attempts to rehabilitate a volatile young man, but their connection evolves into an intense and doomed romance. As their feelings deepen, the relationship brings emotional conflict and difficult choices, creating a passionate story about love, pain, and the limits of trying to change someone.

title: Perfect Family
plot: A Punjabi family appears happy but deals with hidden issues, attending therapy together to address mental health and family bonds while fighting cultural stigma.

title: Raat Akeli Hai: The Bansal Murders
plot: After several members of a wealthy family are murdered, an honest police inspector takes charge of the investigation. As he questions relatives, allies, and outsiders, he encounters conflicting accounts, hidden tensions, pressure from powerful interests, and a wider story involving privilege, inequality, and corruption.

title: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder
plot: Explores the murder of Byron Griffy, a respected mortician, who was found dead on his remote ranch, shot execution-style.

title: Turbulence
plot: A young married couple takes a hot-air-balloon journey over the Italian Dolomites to reconnect. Their trip becomes a tense fight for survival when a pilot and an unexpected passenger join them high above the mountains, forcing the group to confront danger and distrust in an increasingly confined setting.

title: Wake Up Dead Man
plot: A young priest arrives at a troubled rural parish led by a forceful senior cleric. When a seemingly impossible murder shocks the congregation, a local police chief and an eccentric detective investigate a tightly knit community where suspicion, faith, power, and long-held tensions collide.

title: Jingle Bell Heist
plot: Two financially struggling hourly workers join forces to rob an upscale London department store on Christmas Eve. As their risky plan unfolds, their partnership grows more complicated, blending festive comedy, romance, and a scrappy fight for a better future.

title: Chris Hemsworth: A Road Trip to Remember
plot: A family sets out on a deeply personal road trip after a father receives an Alzheimer’s diagnosis. Revisiting meaningful places and connections, they explore how shared experiences may support memory while preserving treasured recollections as a family home movie.

title: The Age of Disclosure
plot: This documentary presents testimony from senior government, military, and intelligence officials about an alleged decades-long cover-up involving non-human intelligent life and secret efforts to study advanced technology. It examines the possible consequences for humanity and follows the bipartisan push for greater public disclosure.

title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
plot: In an enchanted kingdom, a fairy princess and an elf become friends and go on playful adventures with their families and companions. Their small world is filled with magic, everyday mishaps, imaginative stories, and gentle comedy for young viewers and the adults watching alongside them.

title: Rental Family
plot: A struggling American actor in Tokyo finds work with a rental-family agency, taking on stand-in roles for people who need a missing relative or companion. As he enters clients’ lives, the job challenges his ideas about honesty, purpose, loneliness, and whether paid performances can lead to genuine human connection.

title: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
plot: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

title: Wildcat
plot: A former black-ops team reunites for a desperate heist after their leader’s eight-year-old daughter’s life is threatened. The mission sends them into London’s criminal underworld, where they must rely on old skills, loyalty, and each other to complete the dangerous job.

title: Wicked: For Good
plot: As public fear turns against an outcast witch, two former friends in Oz must confront their divided loyalties and the forces shaping their world. Their bond is tested by political manipulation, personal commitments, and a destiny that connects their choices to the familiar story unfolding around them.

title: Champagne Problems
plot: A determined American business executive travels to Paris before Christmas to acquire a struggling champagne brand. While competing against other potential buyers, she unexpectedly develops feelings for the heir to the family business, forcing her to balance professional ambitions with a growing romance.

title: Tu Juliet Jatt Di
plot: The star of the story—Heer—is an ambitious Kudi! Poles apart, Nawab is a rich, spoiled Munda. Destiny brings them together in a love saga inked by betrayals.

title: Son of Sara
plot: A pregnant woman past her due date is haunted by strange urges and disturbing visions. After accepting an invitation to dinner, she discovers that her hosts have a deeply unsettling interest in the impending birth of her child.

title: Malice
plot: A charming tutor enters the world of a wealthy family, becoming closely involved in their lives while pursuing a sinister agenda. Set amid luxury and growing unease, the series explores manipulation, hidden motives, and the danger of welcoming a stranger too easily.

title: Agra
plot: In a cramped family home, a young man struggles with sexual frustration, loneliness, and the lack of privacy that shapes everyday life. As he searches for intimacy and personal space, the household’s buried tensions and conflicting desires come increasingly into focus.

title: The Beast in Me
plot: A grieving, successful author becomes fascinated by her wealthy new neighbor, a charming and unsettling man suspected of murder. As she investigates him for inspiration, their uneasy connection develops into a psychological game filled with suspicion, obsession, and paranoia.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
plot: A middle-aged man and his younger girlfriend seek her family's approval, but their age difference triggers outrage and a series of comic attempts to break them apart. As awkward meetings, family expectations, and emotional disagreements unfold, the couple must stand up for their relationship while navigating the resulting chaos.

title: A Merry Little Ex-Mas
plot: A recently separated couple attempts to share one last Christmas with their children before their divorce is final and their home is sold. Their carefully planned holiday becomes chaotic when the ex-husband arrives with his younger new girlfriend, sparking awkward tensions, comedic complications, and plenty of family friction.

title: Keeper
plot: A couple heads to a secluded cabin for a romantic anniversary weekend, but their getaway changes when one partner leaves unexpectedly. Alone in the woods, the other begins experiencing unsettling visions and encounters an evil presence tied to the cabin’s disturbing history.

title: Being Eddie
plot: A celebrated comedian and actor reflects on his journey from growing up and discovering stand-up to becoming a major Hollywood star. Through personal conversation, archival clips, and commentary from fellow performers, the documentary explores his family, career, cultural impact, and decision to pursue a quieter life.

title: The Running Man
plot: A desperate working-class father enters a deadly televised competition to afford medication for his sick daughter. Hunted across the country by professional killers and ordinary citizens drawn into the spectacle, he relies on grit and quick thinking while challenging a system built on fear, ratings, and public attention.

title: BAT-FAM
plot: Batman and his young son, who has taken on the name Little Batman, share Wayne Manor with Alfred and a few newcomers. Together, they face the fun and frustrations of family life while balancing their lives as a superhero household.

title: A Very Jonas Christmas Movie
plot: Three musician brothers face escalating obstacles while trying to travel from London to New York in time to spend Christmas with their families. Along the way, their difficult journey tests their bond and pushes them to reconnect beyond their busy careers.

title: Eternity
plot: In an afterlife where new arrivals have one week to choose their eternal destination, a woman faces an impossible decision. She must weigh a lifetime of marriage against the enduring pull of her first love, while counselors and memories help her consider what love, loss, and forever truly mean.

title: Stumble
plot: A determined coach rallies a newly recruited junior college cheer squad as they pursue a record-breaking championship. Along the way, the team’s shared ambitions, unusual personalities, and everyday obstacles create plenty of opportunities for growth, laughter, and heartfelt moments.

title: All Her Fault
plot: In Chicago, a mother arrives to collect her young son from a playdate, only to discover that the woman at the door is a stranger and her child is missing. As the search begins, suspicion spreads through a web of family tensions, hidden conflicts, and uncertain motives.

title: In Your Dreams
plot: A young girl and her little brother enter a wildly imaginative dream world to find the Sandman, hoping he can create the perfect family. Along the way, their strange journey explores sibling bonds, family struggles, and the difficult truth that happiness does not always look perfect.

title: The Choral
plot: During World War I, a British choral society struggles to continue after many of its men leave for military service. A controversial new musical leader takes charge, bringing together townspeople whose lives are shaped by grief, class tensions, romance, patriotism, and uncertainty as they prepare for an important performance.

title: Death by Lightning
plot: A little-known politician rises from obscurity to become America’s 20th president, while an increasingly obsessive and unstable man becomes fixated on him. Set against fierce political rivalries and personal ambitions, the miniseries explores power, idealism, mental illness, and the events surrounding a pivotal moment in American history.

title: Pluribus
plot: When a strange force spreads across humanity and turns everyday life into a cheerful collective, one stubbornly unhappy holdout becomes the unlikely obstacle to a world of enforced bliss. As the pressure to “just be happy” grows, they’re pushed to resist, investigate, and find a way to stop it before everything familiar is rewritten.

title: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson
plot: A behind-the-scenes documentary follows a visionary filmmaker and the cast and crew as they bring a beloved classic tale to life. It explores the project’s ambition, dedication, detailed universe, and the extensive work involved in creating its sets, makeup, effects, and overall production.

title: Baramulla
plot: A police officer investigates a series of child kidnappings in a tense Kashmir town while unsettling supernatural events begin threatening his family. As the case deepens, the investigation connects personal fears with the region’s troubled past, creating a moody blend of crime, horror, suspense, and family drama.

title: Sarah's Oil
plot: In early 20th-century Oklahoma, a young Black girl believes oil lies beneath the seemingly barren land allotted to her—and she is proven right. As determined outsiders try to seize control, she draws strength from family, friends, and unexpected allies while fighting to protect her future and her community.

title: Nuremberg
plot: In postwar Germany, an American psychiatrist evaluates imprisoned Nazi leaders to determine whether they can stand trial for war crimes. His work brings him into a tense psychological contest with a brilliant, charismatic senior Nazi official, while Allied leaders struggle with the legal and moral challenges of creating an unprecedented international tribunal.

title: Playdate
plot: An out-of-work accountant joins a stay-at-home father for what should be a relaxed playdate with their sons. When mercenaries begin chasing them, the unlikely adults must protect the children and survive a string of increasingly absurd obstacles.

title: Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
plot: This documentary revisits the troubled life, crimes, and death-row interviews of a notorious female serial killer. Using archival footage and perspectives shaped by her traumatic past, it examines questions of guilt, self-defense, fairness, and how the media and public remember both the perpetrator and her victims.

title: Anniversary
plot: At a couple’s 25th anniversary party, their son introduces a girlfriend who once studied under his mother. Her controversial ideas and growing influence gradually place the family under pressure, turning a private celebration into a tense struggle over loyalty, belief, and an unsettling shift in society.

title: Christy
plot: A determined young woman from West Virginia discovers a talent for boxing and rises through the sport with help from a trainer who becomes her husband. As her public success grows, she faces painful conflicts involving family, identity, addiction, and an increasingly controlling relationship.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
plot: In 1962, unexplained disappearances unsettle a small town as a group of misfit children investigates signs of an ancient evil. Their search unfolds alongside frightened townspeople joining forces and a military operation pursuing its own goals, creating a tense blend of supernatural mystery, community conflict, and period drama.

title: Bugonia
plot: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap a powerful company CEO, convinced she is an alien planning to destroy Earth. As they try to prove their theory, the tense standoff becomes an unsettling clash of paranoia, power, and uncertainty.

title: Lazarus
plot: After his father dies under suspicious circumstances, a forensic psychiatrist is drawn into a dangerous search for answers. Haunted by visions of people he knows are dead, he must confront buried trauma, family secrets, and a possible conspiracy while trying to identify the killer.

title: Hedda
plot: A woman trapped in an unhappy marriage hosts a lavish party where a former love and other complicated guests bring old desires and rivalries to the surface. Over one charged night, she manipulates those around her as passion, resentment, and hidden tensions threaten the life she has built.

title: Regretting You
plot: After a devastating accident, a mother and her teenage daughter struggle with grief as revelations challenge what they thought they knew about their family. As they navigate strained relationships, new romances, and painful secrets, they must find a way to reconnect and begin moving forward together.

title: Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere
plot: A young musician nearing worldwide fame retreats from the spotlight while wrestling with painful memories, depression, and uncertainty about his future. As he develops a raw, stripped-back album, creative pressure, personal relationships, and the expectations of his record label challenge his need to follow his own artistic path.

title: Wife Swap: The Real Housewives Edition
plot: When a “Real Housewife” takes off her stilettos and steps into a real housewife’s shoes, all bets are off as two of entertainment’s most iconic franchises are mashed up leading to laugh-out-loud moments, personal epiphanies and an opportunity to see if the grass is truly greener.

title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
plot: A powerful politician falls intensely for a strong-willed superstar, but their passionate romance soon becomes a dangerous clash of obsession, pride, and resistance. As his behavior grows increasingly troubling, she is pushed toward a life-changing decision and an unusual way to respond.

title: Border Hunters
plot: After a loved one is killed by a drug dealer who escapes across the border, a determined American with experience in law enforcement and the military heads into Mexico. With the fugitive sheltered by powerful cartel ties, the pursuit becomes a dangerous, personal mission for justice.

title: Boston Blue
plot: An experienced New York detective starts a new job with the Boston Police Department, where he is paired with a detective from a prominent law enforcement family. While adjusting to his new partner and surroundings, he also hopes to reconnect with his son in Boston.

title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
plot: This documentary explores the life and legacy of a Deaf champion bodybuilder who found fame on a hit 1990s television competition. Through the perspective of another Deaf woman in Hollywood, it examines fame, identity, beauty, mental illness, addiction, and the personal struggles behind a charismatic public image.

title: Stiller & Meara: Nothing Is Lost
plot: A documentary memoir explores the marriage, careers, family life, and cultural impact of a legendary comedy duo. Through archive footage, photos, letters, and candid family reflections, it examines how creative ambition, personal struggles, and parenting shaped a household where everyday life and performance often overlapped.

title: The Twits
plot: When a cruel couple scheme to take over their town, two brave children join forces with a family of magical animals. Together, they face the villains’ plans and fight to protect their community, in a colorful animated adventure filled with mischief, unusual creatures, and a clear message about standing up to cruelty.

title: Blue Moon
plot: On opening night of a groundbreaking musical, a brilliant but troubled lyricist waits at a New York bar for his former creative partner to arrive. As colleagues, friends, and an aspiring young artist enter, he wrestles with professional jealousy, loneliness, self-doubt, and the consequences of his self-destructive habits.

title: Frankenstein
plot: A brilliant but arrogant scientist attempts to overcome death by creating new life. His experiment produces a lonely, misunderstood being, setting creator and creation on a dark, gothic journey shaped by rejection, responsibility, compassion, and the consequences of unchecked ambition.

title: Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy
plot: After a teenager disappears, investigators uncover a wider pattern involving missing young men and boys. The miniseries follows the search for answers while giving attention to victims, their families, and the law-enforcement efforts surrounding the case.

title: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
plot: A suburban couple hires a seemingly sweet nanny to care for their newborn, but her presence gradually raises troubling questions. As unease grows inside the household, the family must confront the possibility that the caregiver’s intentions are far more dangerous than they first appeared.

title: The Mastermind
plot: In a quiet Massachusetts suburb around 1970, an unemployed family man and amateur art thief plans his first museum robbery. Though the heist appears carefully arranged, the choices he makes afterward place increasing pressure on his family and send him into an uncertain, restless life beyond his original plan.

title: Murdaugh: Death in the Family
plot: A wealthy legal dynasty faces mounting pressure after a son becomes involved in a deadly boat crash. As investigators uncover troubling connections and hidden tensions, the family’s privilege, loyalty, and carefully protected public image begin to unravel.

title: Ballad of a Small Player
plot: In the glittering casinos of Macau, a debt-ridden gambler hiding from his past becomes drawn to an enigmatic woman at the baccarat table. As his mounting troubles threaten to catch up with him, he searches for a way forward amid temptation, loneliness, and uncertain redemption.

title: Black Phone 2
plot: Four years after surviving captivity, a troubled teenager is still struggling with its aftermath. When his younger sister begins receiving mysterious calls in her dreams and seeing visions connected to a snowbound camp, the siblings investigate a disturbing mystery involving missing children and a supernatural threat.

title: Splinter Cell: Deathwatch
plot: In a shadowy espionage world, a retired operative is drawn back into action alongside a new recruit. Together, they investigate a global conspiracy while facing dangerous missions, shifting loyalties, and the demands of working across generations.

title: Good Fortune
plot: A well-meaning but inexperienced angel interferes in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy capitalist, triggering an unexpected life swap. As he tries to put things right, all three confront money, work, purpose, and what might truly bring fulfillment.

title: The Chair Company
plot: After an embarrassing incident at work, a suburban family man becomes fixated on what first appears to be a minor event. His search for answers pulls him into a strange, far-reaching conspiracy, blending awkward humor, personal frustration, and an increasingly surreal mystery.

title: Kurukshetra
plot: An epic 18-day war between rival branches of a royal family unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors. As battles rage, each faces personal doubts, difficult choices, and questions about duty, morality, and the cost of victory.

title: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
plot: Chefs, restaurant owners, and their teams pursue the coveted Michelin Star while navigating intense pressure, financial risks, and demanding kitchens. Along the way, the series explores the ambition, sacrifice, and uncertainty behind high-end dining, as anonymous inspectors and their mysterious evaluations remain central to the challenge.

title: Soul on Fire
plot: After a devastating childhood fire leaves a young boy with severe burns, he faces a long physical and emotional recovery. Supported by his family, faith, community, a compassionate medical worker, and a longtime idol, he works toward self-acceptance and a purposeful life.

title: Victoria Beckham
plot: A former pop star turned fashion designer invites viewers into her London atelier while preparing for Paris Fashion Week. She reflects on her career, the challenges of building a label, and the pressure of establishing a new identity beyond her earlier fame.

title: The Last Frontier
plot: After a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness, dozens of dangerous inmates escape into the region. A determined marshal must protect his community and family while pursuing the fugitives, as a broader espionage threat complicates the race to restore order.

title: The Travellers
plot: Stephen Seary, a stage designer, returns to Australia to visit his dying mother, but a quick trip descends into family tensions, past conflicts, and romantic complications, jeopardizing his return to Europe and the opera that awaits.

title: The Woman in Cabin 10
plot: A journalist aboard a lavish yacht witnesses a passenger go overboard, but the other guests deny anything happened. As doubt closes in, she must rely on her instincts and investigate the unsettling mystery before her own safety is threatened.

title: After the Hunt
plot: A philosophy professor is caught between a student’s accusation against a colleague and the demands of her own career. As tensions rise across the university, she must confront difficult questions about loyalty, responsibility, and a buried part of her past.

title: Tron: Ares
plot: A highly advanced program leaves the digital world and enters human reality on a dangerous mission. As this unprecedented encounter unfolds, competing technology interests and questions about artificial intelligence’s place in the world drive the action between two realms.

title: Maintenance Required
plot: A fiercely independent mechanic struggles to keep her women-run shop afloat after a flashy corporate competitor opens nearby. While seeking support from an anonymous online confidant, she unknowingly connects with the rival threatening her business, complicating both her professional future and her growing romantic feelings.

title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
plot: In Elmore, a blue cat and his family face bizarre everyday problems involving powerful businesses, unusual technology, chaotic classmates, and other surreal threats. Alongside his brother and sister, he turns ordinary moments into unpredictable adventures filled with strange situations, wild humor, and the town’s familiar cast of eccentric residents.

title: Die My Love
plot: After moving to a remote Montana home with her partner, a new mother faces loneliness, creative frustration, and growing emotional turmoil. As rural isolation and strain on the relationship deepen, her behavior becomes increasingly unpredictable, blurring the boundaries between love, identity, motherhood, and reality.

title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
plot: The shocking true-life tale of Ed Gein, the infamous murderer and grave robber who inspired many of Hollywood's most iconic on-screen killers.

title: Anemone
plot: A middle-aged man travels from his suburban home into the woods to reconnect with his estranged, reclusive brother. As they spend time together, their tense yet occasionally tender relationship exposes the lasting effects of painful family history, military experiences, and unresolved trauma.

title: A House of Dynamite
plot: When an unexplained missile heads toward the United States, military leaders and government officials race against time to determine its origin, assess their limited options, and decide how to respond. The crisis unfolds through overlapping perspectives, highlighting the pressure, uncertainty, and moral weight surrounding a potentially catastrophic threat.

title: The Friday the 13th Murders
plot: Explores real killings that unfold on or around the infamous date, revealing how Friday the 13th transforms from superstition into a real-life horror story.

title: Good Boy
plot: A loyal dog moves with his owner into a rural family home, where he senses supernatural forces hiding in the shadows. Unable to explain what he sees, the dog grows increasingly determined to protect his human companion as unsettling events and a worsening situation threaten their safety.

title: The Smashing Machine
plot: In the late 1990s, a rising mixed martial arts fighter pursues greatness while facing opioid dependence and a turbulent relationship with his girlfriend. As his career gathers momentum, the pressures of competition, pain, and life outside the ring begin pulling him in opposing directions.

title: Chad Powers
plot: Years after a career-ending mistake derails his college football dreams, a determined quarterback attempts a comeback by adopting a new identity. Disguised as a talented oddball, he joins a struggling team, hoping to prove himself while navigating teammates, second chances, and the risks of keeping up the act.

title: Play Dirty
plot: A highly skilled thief is offered a chance to pull off a major heist. To succeed, he and his crew must navigate competing threats from a powerful South American ruler, New York’s criminal underworld, and an extraordinarily wealthy target.

title: Janaawar: The Beast Within
plot: A police officer investigates a missing-person case in a remote jungle town. As the search uncovers a series of bodies and points toward a possible serial killer, the case draws him into a tense world shaped by crime, social divisions, and difficult choices.

title: All of You
plot: Two college best friends have long sensed that their connection is more than platonic. When a futuristic test points one of them toward a supposedly ideal partner, they must decide whether to protect the lives they have built or risk exploring the love between them.

title: The Astronaut
plot: After returning from a space mission, an astronaut is placed in an isolated, high-security home for rehabilitation and medical testing. As unsettling events unfold around the property, she begins questioning whether the disturbances are connected to her health, her perception, or something extraterrestrial that may have come back with her.

title: Wayward
plot: A small-town police officer grows suspicious of a school for troubled teenagers and its charismatic founder. As unsettling details emerge, the officer is drawn into a tense mystery involving the academy, its students, and the community around it.

title: House of Guinness
plot: In 1868 Dublin, the death of a powerful brewery patriarch leaves his four children competing over the family business and inheritance. As they face political pressure, social expectations, personal secrets, and tensions within their family, each must decide how far to go to protect their future.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
plot: After surviving a brutal attack, a young woman wakes in a hospital only to learn that the masked killers have returned to find her. Her desperate escape leads through isolated surroundings, where she must fight to stay alive while questioning whom she can trust.

title: Haunted Hotel
plot: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mother moves in with his ghost and takes on a building filled with unusual supernatural residents and demanding guests. As she adjusts to this strange new home, family complications and paranormal chaos create a quirky horror-comedy adventure.

title: My Father's Shadow
plot: During Nigeria’s 1993 election crisis, two young brothers spend a day exploring Lagos with their estranged father, who works far from home. As they discover the city, its hardships, and pieces of their father’s past, growing political unrest threatens their journey back.

title: The Lost Bus
plot: When a wildfire rapidly spreads through a small community, a determined bus driver and a dedicated teacher work together to rescue students trapped at their school. Their evacuation journey takes them through smoke, flames, blocked roads, and mounting chaos as they search for a safe route out.

title: Adulthood
plot: Two siblings return to their family home and discover a dead body buried in the basement. Their shocking discovery sends them into a widening web of crime and murder, forcing them to confront buried family secrets and make increasingly desperate decisions as they search for answers.

title: Black Rabbit
plot: A rising-star New York restaurateur is pulled into the criminal underworld when his chaotic brother returns with loan sharks close behind. As pressure mounts, the family business, personal relationships, and their safety are threatened by a spiral of dangerous choices.

title: Him
plot: After a potentially career-ending brain injury, a promising football player is invited by his legendary idol to train at an isolated desert compound. As demanding exercises and strange rituals intensify, the young athlete begins questioning the mentor’s methods, motives, and the culture surrounding greatness.

title: The Senior
plot: Decades after leaving college, a 59-year-old man returns to his alma mater seeking one more chance to play football. As he faces physical doubts and strained family relationships, his unlikely comeback becomes a personal effort to confront regret, repair old wounds, and find purpose beyond the game.

title: Matchroom: The Greatest Showmen
plot: Matchroom is home to the biggest names in sport - from snooker to darts to fishing to boxing - and is the epicentre of some of the most lucrative deals and sporting events globally. With unprecedented access to Barry Hearn, his son Eddie and the whole Matchroom team at the Essex based HQ, this documentary series will dive into the drama of the family empire that has become synonymous with British sporting culture.

title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
plot: Two single strangers meet at a wedding and set off on a strange, fantastical journey together. Guided through doors into important moments from their pasts, they revisit memories, confront experiences that shaped them, and consider how those moments might influence their future and their chance at love.

title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
plot: During a road trip, a beloved dollhouse is accidentally taken by an eccentric cat lover. A young girl sets off on a real-world adventure to reunite her playful cat friends and recover her treasured possession, encountering new places, characters, songs, and lessons about friendship, imagination, and growing up along the way.

title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
plot: Estranged members of a legendary heavy metal band reunite for a one-night concert, pulled back into rehearsals, old rivalries, and the absurd pressures surrounding their comeback. As they prepare to perform again, their bickering and musical misadventures put their uneasy reunion to the test.

title: The History of Sound
plot: In 1917, two young music students bond over their shared love of folk music. Reunited after the war, they travel through rural Maine collecting traditional songs on early recording equipment, while their connection is shaped by music, changing expectations, and the passage of time.

title: The Man in My Basement
plot: A financially struggling homeowner agrees to rent his basement to a mysterious stranger for a large payment. As unusual conditions and an increasingly tense relationship take hold, the arrangement becomes a disturbing confrontation involving power, history, guilt, and identity.

title: The Wrong Paris
plot: A woman believes she is joining a dating show in Paris, France, but arrives in Paris, Texas instead. She plans to leave, yet her plans shift when she develops a connection with the local cowboy bachelor.

title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
plot: A grand household faces public scandal and financial uncertainty as long-held traditions meet a rapidly changing world. While tensions rise among the family and staff, the next generation must consider what comes next for the estate and everyone who calls it home.

title: The Long Walk
plot: In a dystopian America, fifty teenage boys enter an annual walking contest with a deadly rule: anyone who falls below the required pace faces execution. As the exhausting journey continues, the participants form uneasy bonds while confronting fear, ambition, violence, and the harsh demands of survival.

title: Swiped
plot: A determined young woman enters the male-dominated tech world and helps build a groundbreaking dating app. After facing workplace mistreatment, betrayal, and pressure, she draws on her resilience and ingenuity to pursue a new vision centered on women’s empowerment.

title: Task
plot: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, an FBI agent leads a task force investigating a string of violent robberies. The investigation brings law enforcement into the orbit of a family man whose criminal actions are shaped by family pressures, moral compromises, and mounting danger.

title: Baaghi 4
plot: After waking from a coma, a grieving man searches for answers about his girlfriend’s disappearance. His journey leads into a high-energy mix of romance, mystery, and exaggerated action, as he tries to separate painful memories from the truth.

title: The Paper
plot: A documentary crew searches for a new workplace to follow after covering a paper company in Pennsylvania. They find a historic newspaper in Toledo and an eager publisher determined to bring it back to life, joining a staff whose relationships and ambitions develop along the way.

title: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
plot: When a security company is attacked, a former agent and his partner flee across Europe with their daughter. As they investigate who is targeting them, the pair must navigate danger, unresolved feelings, and the challenge of learning to trust each other again.

title: Twinless
plot: Two grieving men meet at a support group for people who have lost their twin siblings and form an unlikely friendship. As they offer each other comfort and companionship, buried secrets and uneasy details begin to strain their bond, turning a heartfelt connection into an unpredictable emotional journey.

title: The Cut
plot: A retired boxer is offered one last chance at a title, but he must first lose a dangerous amount of weight in just days. Confined to a Las Vegas room with a ruthless trainer, he endures an illegal regimen that pushes his body and mind toward breaking point.

title: Eleanor the Great
plot: After losing her best friend, a 94-year-old woman returns from Florida to New York to live with family. Seeking connection and independence, she mistakenly joins a support group and begins sharing another person’s story, forming an unexpected bond with a young journalism student as her new life grows increasingly complicated.

title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
plot: Paranormal investigators take on one final terrifying case involving mysterious entities and a troubled family. As the haunting intensifies, the investigators face personal pressures, family tensions, and a threat that challenges their faith, legacy, and commitment to confronting the supernatural.

title: The Runarounds
plot: The summer after high school, a close-knit group of young adults from different backgrounds comes together to form a rock band in Wilmington, North Carolina. As real-life pressures mount, they must decide whether to follow safer paths or risk everything pursuing their shared musical dream.

title: Time for Sunset
plot: A hit man hoping to retire from his profession, is on one final assignment when he begins receiving mysterious calls from an unknown source. As he tries to discover information about his new foe who is threatening to 'sunset' him, a dark truth emerges about his past; a truth that will shape his future.

title: Sangre Del Toro
plot: A filmmaker journeys through childhood memories, cultural myths, and monsters to explore the origins of his visionary films. The documentary traces how early experiences and enduring fascinations shaped a distinctive creative world filled with wonder, darkness, and imagination.

title: The New Yorker at 100
plot: This documentary celebrates a landmark magazine’s 100th anniversary through behind-the-scenes access, archival material, and a look at its journalism, fiction, cartoons, editors, writers, and evolving future. It explores the publication’s cultural influence while offering glimpses into the people and processes behind its work.

title: Param Sundari
plot: A North Indian entrepreneur tests his soulmate app on himself and matches with a woman from Kerala. Their meeting leads to an unexpected romance as they navigate cultural differences, local customs, family tensions, comedy, and the challenges of leaving familiar surroundings behind.

title: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
plot: A teenage couple is targeted by nearly two years of vulgar, aggressive texts from an unknown number. As the harassment affects them and people around them, a documentary follows the investigation, the people involved, and the disturbing search for answers.

title: The Toxic Avenger
plot: A struggling janitor is caught in a toxic accident and transformed into a grotesque new hero. Armed with unusual abilities and determined to protect his family and community, he takes on a powerful corporation and the corrupt forces threatening those around him.

title: The Roses
plot: A seemingly perfect couple enjoys successful careers, a loving marriage, and family life until their professional fortunes reverse. As one partner’s ambitions flourish and the other struggles, buried resentment and fierce competition begin to strain their relationship.

title: Caught Stealing
plot: A burned-out former baseball player living in late-1990s New York agrees to care for a neighbor’s cat, only to become entangled in a violent criminal underworld. With dangerous strangers closing in, he must rely on instinct and determination to survive while uncovering what has drawn them to his doorstep.

title: King & Conqueror
plot: Two former allies are drawn into a struggle for the English crown as a king’s succession leaves the kingdom’s future uncertain. Though neither had sought the throne, ambition and circumstance set them on a path toward war and the Battle of Hastings in 1066.

title: Long Story Short
plot: An animated comedy follows a family across decades, moving between childhood and adulthood as siblings grow, change, and navigate complicated relationships. With a nonlinear structure, the series blends playful humor with heartfelt moments about love, family history, and how the past shapes the future.

title: Gladiator Underground
plot: Two brothers enter an underground fighting tournament run by a dark syndicate. As brutal bouts escalate, they face a choice between following the rules or throwing honor aside to work together and dismantle the organization.

title: Hunting Jessica Brok
plot: A single mother living in a quiet South African town has tried to leave her past behind. Once a highly skilled special-ops assassin, she is pulled back toward the dangerous life she believed was over after a mission went wrong.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
plot: A group of retired amateur sleuths who enjoy investigating cold cases become involved in a real murder inquiry at their upscale retirement community. As they pursue clues alongside the authorities, their friendship, humor, and curiosity carry this cozy crime adventure forward.

title: Hostage
plot: When a British prime minister’s husband is kidnapped and the French president receives threats, two leaders face a rapidly escalating crisis. Political pressure, personal danger, and difficult choices collide as they try to protect their families and prevent wider consequences.

title: Relay
plot: A discreet broker arranges lucrative payoffs between corrupt corporations and people threatening to expose them. When a new client asks for protection, he breaks his carefully maintained rules and becomes drawn into a dangerous struggle involving harassment, surveillance, and escalating pressure.

title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
plot: A young American student arrives in Italy for a study-abroad program and is imprisoned for a murder weeks later. The miniseries follows her determined fight to prove her innocence, regain her freedom, and confront the authorities, media, and public judgment surrounding the case.

title: Afterburn
plot: After a massive solar flare devastates much of Earth, survivors face radiation-altered dangers in a harsher, more primitive world. A group of treasure hunters searches for priceless artifacts while contending with rival hunters, mutants, pirates, and other threats across the ruined landscape.

title: America's Team: The Gambler and His Cowboys
plot: A team owner takes bold risks to transform a struggling football franchise, guiding its players and coaches toward three championships in the 1990s. The series explores the ambition, personalities, rivalries, and behind-the-scenes tensions that helped build one of sports’ most valuable brands.

title: The Map That Leads to You
plot: A young woman travels through Europe with friends before beginning a carefully planned life. After a chance meeting with a mysterious traveler sparks an unexpected romance, emotional discoveries and difficult choices challenge her plans and reshape how she sees the future.

title: Are You My First?
plot: In this ground-breaking new dating experiment, the largest, hottest group of virgins ever assembled search for intimacy, love– and maybe their first–in a tropical paradise designed just for them.

title: Supercar Saints
plot: Set in Toronto, the lives of high net worth supercar owners of the exclusive Flat 6ix Club are explored. Entitled club member Swash meets a boy with a serious health condition. As the two form an unlikely bond, Swash finds his humanity.

title: East of Wall
plot: After losing her husband, a rebellious horse trainer struggles to keep her struggling ranch afloat while caring for her family and sheltering wayward teenagers. As grief, financial pressure, and difficult choices build, she must find a way to protect the community she has created without losing herself.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part I - Last Air in Moscow
plot: An American filmmaker returns to Moscow in 2021 to document independent journalists working under growing pressure. Across five chapters, the film observes their daily lives and the wider anxiety of a society undergoing immense change, shortly before the invasion of Ukraine.

title: Americana
plot: When a rare Native American artifact enters the black market, a shy waitress with big dreams joins forces with a lovelorn military veteran to claim it. Their risky plan draws attention from a ruthless criminal working for a Western antiquities dealer, sending several troubled outsiders into a tense small-town conflict.

title: Highest 2 Lowest
plot: A powerful New York music mogul faces a life-or-death moral dilemma when a ransom demand targets his family. As the situation becomes more complicated, he must weigh his personal loyalties, financial ambitions, and responsibility to someone close to him.

title: Butterfly
plot: A former intelligence operative living quietly in South Korea is pulled back into danger when a difficult decision from his past resurfaces. Hunted by a highly trained young assassin and the powerful spy organization behind her, he must confront old consequences while protecting the life he built.

title: Nobody 2
plot: A former assassin takes his family on a nostalgic vacation to a small-town theme park, hoping for time together. Their trip quickly turns dangerous after a confrontation with local criminals draws attention from a corrupt operator, a crooked sheriff, and a ruthless crime boss.

title: War 2
plot: A former elite agent has gone rogue and become a major threat. To stop him, India sends another highly skilled operative—an equally formidable officer driven by personal demons—setting the stage for a dangerous pursuit filled with high-stakes confrontations.

title: Fixed
plot: A dog learns he is about to be neutered and sets off with his friends for one last wild day of freedom. Their adventure brings crude misadventures, close friendships, romantic feelings, and moments about individuality and self-worth.

title: Alien: Earth
plot: After a mysterious research vessel crashes on Earth, a young woman and a group of tactical soldiers uncover a dangerous threat. Their discovery draws them into a tense struggle involving unfamiliar creatures, advanced technology, and questions about what it means to be human.

title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
plot: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city.

title: Holy Ghost
plot: After a kidnapped girl returns claiming a deceased police officer rescued her, a detective investigates while another child disappears. The case uncovers links to old murders and raises unsettling questions about whether a ghostly presence is involved.

title: Strange Harvest
plot: Detectives investigate the return of a long-dormant serial killer, whose grotesque crimes are linked by strange symbols and unsettling occult overtones. Presented through interviews, police footage, photographs, and testimonies, the case gradually expands from a local investigation into something mysterious and otherworldly.

title: Stolen: Heist of the Century
plot: In Antwerp in 2003, a gang carries out an audacious robbery at a heavily secured diamond center. Through interviews, archival material, and competing accounts from investigators and participants, the documentary examines how the crime unfolded and why key questions remain disputed.

title: Vicious
plot: After receiving a mysterious box, a woman must follow three unsettling instructions: place inside something she needs, something she hates, and something she loves. As the night grows more disturbing, she faces frightening visions, painful memories, and an unknown threat that may consume everything familiar.

title: Bakaiti
plot: Set in old Ghaziabad, this heartwarming series follows the Kataria family grappling with a financial crunch. When Naina is forced to share her room with her younger brother Bharat, sibling tensions rise.

title: Eyes of Wakanda
plot: Across different eras and distant lands, brave Wakandan warriors undertake dangerous missions to recover Vibranium artifacts taken by enemies of their hidden kingdom. As members of an elite team, they encounter battles, shifting loyalties, and moments that broaden the history and legacy of Wakanda.

title: Leanne
plot: After her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mother begins rebuilding her life. With support from her loving but outspoken family, she navigates fresh challenges in this lighthearted sitcom about starting over and finding humor in everyday setbacks.

title: Chief of War
