plot: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, a fierce warrior sets out to unite his people as a growing threat approaches the islands. The journey explores shifting alliances, cultural traditions, political tensions, and the daily lives of communities caught between conflict and change.

title: My Oxford Year
plot: An ambitious American arrives at Oxford to pursue a carefully planned year of study before starting her career. Her priorities shift when she falls for a charming British lecturer whose hidden circumstances challenge her expectations about love, time, and the future.

title: She Rides Shotgun
plot: A newly released father goes on the run with his estranged 11-year-old daughter after dangerous enemies target him. As they navigate a violent world with few resources and nowhere safe to turn, they build a fragile bond while learning how to survive together.

title: Red Sonja
plot: After a devastating tragedy, a young woman sets out on a harsh journey that transforms her into a formidable warrior. Along the way, she faces dangerous foes, brutal trials, and a world of swordplay and fantasy as she fights to claim her place as a legendary heroine.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes
plot: Present-day interviews and previously unheard recordings explore a serial killer’s impact on 1970s New York. The series examines the fear, public attention, and broader questions surrounding one of the city’s most notorious true-crime cases, using archival material and firsthand perspectives to revisit this disturbing period.

title: The Naked Gun
plot: A bumbling police officer follows in his father’s footsteps while trying to solve a murder and save his department from closure. As the investigation unfolds, he becomes entangled in a larger threat that could endanger the world, forcing him to rely on determination, luck, and chaotic methods.

title: WWE: Unreal
plot: A documentary series follows WWE performers and staff from Monday Night RAW through WrestleMania, showing the planning, pressure, personal effort, and emotional commitment behind the company’s biggest spectacles. It explores how stories take shape while highlighting the people who perform, prepare, and make each event happen.

title: Oh, Hi!
plot: A couple’s first weekend getaway takes a disturbing turn when one partner realizes they have very different ideas about the relationship. As attempts to prove their connection become increasingly irrational, the situation spirals into a tense, darkly comic standoff involving friendship, vulnerability, and emotional confusion.

title: Happy Gilmore 2
plot: After retiring from golf, a former champion returns to the sport to help pay for his daughter’s ballet classes. His comeback brings renewed competition, family tension, familiar faces, celebrity appearances, and plenty of chaotic, nostalgia-driven comedy.

title: The Bad Guys 2
plot: A reformed gang of animal outlaws is working hard to live honestly, but public suspicion and a new group of criminals pull them toward one more globe-spanning heist. As old reputations clash with new ambitions, the friends must navigate trust, teamwork, and the challenge of proving they can change.

title: Washington Black
plot: An enslaved 11-year-old boy escapes a Barbados plantation aboard a flying machine with an eccentric inventor. Their journey spans continents and explores freedom, identity, hope, science, and the lasting pull of the past as the boy grows into his possibilities.

title: Critical: Between Life and Death
plot: This documentary series follows London trauma centres as medical teams respond to critical emergencies, perform complex operations and support severely injured patients through treatment and recovery. Alongside the urgent care, professionals and families share personal perspectives on the pressure, uncertainty and human impact of trauma medicine.

title: The Hunting Wives
plot: A woman leaves New England for East Texas and is drawn into the glamorous, secretive circle of a powerful socialite. As the group’s risky lifestyle grows darker, hidden tensions and dangerous secrets begin to surface.

title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
plot: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

title: Billy Joel: And So It Goes
plot: This intimate documentary portrait traces a celebrated singer-songwriter’s life, career, relationships, and personal struggles through his own reflections and those of people who knew him. Rare performances, home movies, personal photographs, and extensive interviews connect his music to the experiences that shaped it across decades.

title: Four Letters of Love
plot: A sweeping Irish romance about two people who seem meant for each other, even as distance, family troubles, and uncertain timing keep pulling them apart. Blending everyday heartache with a touch of the mystical, it follows love shaped by fate, longing, and missed chances.

title: Saiyaara
plot: Two artistic souls from very different backgrounds connect through music and begin healing from past pain. As their relationship deepens, personal struggles and difficult circumstances test whether their bond can survive the pressures placed on it.

title: UNTAMED
plot: In Yosemite National Park, a woman’s death draws a federal agent into a dangerous investigation across remote wilderness. As he follows leads through a community marked by grief, secrets, and hardship, the case tests his sense of duty and exposes the uneasy relationship between people and the land.

title: Amy Bradley Is Missing
plot: This true-crime miniseries examines the 1998 disappearance of a young woman from a Caribbean cruise ship. Her family’s decades-long search explores conflicting theories, reported sightings, unanswered questions, and the challenges of investigating a case across international waters.

title: Eddington
plot: In May 2020, a small New Mexico town becomes increasingly divided as a sheriff clashes with the mayor over public safety, local politics, and a community under mounting social pressure. As tensions spread among neighbors, the conflict grows into a volatile portrait of paranoia, polarization, and communal breakdown.

title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
plot: Five friends cover up their involvement in a deadly car accident and try to move on. One year later, threatening messages and a relentless figure force them to confront their shared secret as fear, suspicion, and violence spread through their group.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call?
plot: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they’re innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

title: Human
plot: A paleoanthropologist explores humanity’s incredible story across 300,000 years of human evolution, examining how our species changed over time. The series presents a journey filled with discoveries that suggest human history is stranger and more surprising than previously imagined.

title: A Killer Among Friends
plot: After one of their friends is murdered, a close-knit group struggles with grief and fear as the investigation draws them toward unsettling secrets. Their painful search for answers forces them to examine how well they really know one another and confront a difficult truth.

title: Trainwreck: Balloon Boy
plot: A homemade flying saucer lifts off, prompting fears that a six-year-old boy may be trapped inside. As authorities and the public react, this documentary revisits the sensational incident and examines the media frenzy surrounding it.

title: Dexter: Resurrection
plot: After awakening from a coma, a troubled man travels to New York City to find his missing son and repair their fractured relationship. As questions from the past resurface, father and son confront their shared darkness while becoming entangled in increasingly dangerous circumstances.

title: One Night in Idaho: The College Murders
plot: This four-part series revisits a devastating college tragedy through the memories of those who knew the victims and those affected by the aftermath. It offers an intimate, emotionally heavy portrait of lives, families, friends, and a community changed forever, while leaving some investigative questions unanswered.

title: Aap Jaisa Koi
plot: A tradition-minded man and a confident, independent woman meet and begin an unexpectedly tender romance. Their connection brings awkward sweetness and emotional vulnerability, while family expectations and patriarchal attitudes challenge their ideas about love, marriage, equality, and personal freedom.

title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
plot: An eight-year-old girl grows up on a remote family farm in Rhodesia during the final days of the Bush War and the country’s transition to independence. Through her observant eyes, the film explores family bonds, colonial attitudes, racial tension, emotional neglect, and the lasting effects of living with danger.

title: Too Much
plot: After a painful breakup, a New Yorker relocates to London hoping for a fresh start and a new love story. She becomes involved with an unconventional indie musician, while navigating messy relationships, culture clashes, and the consequences of her own intense, impulsive behavior.

title: Madea's Destination Wedding
plot: A lively family heads to the Bahamas for a grandniece’s whirlwind wedding, with Madea bringing her unmistakable chaos along for the trip. Arguments, misunderstandings, family tensions, and unexpected situations test the celebration while the relatives try to support the couple and keep everything from falling apart.

title: Ballard
plot: A detective leads a team investigating murder and corruption while pursuing a ruthless serial killer. As the case grows more dangerous, she confronts pressure from within the police department and personal struggles that complicate her fight for justice for victims and their families.

title: State of Siege: Temple Attack
plot: During a temple siege in Gujarat, a battle-scarred commando defies orders to lead a dangerous operation against terrorists seeking a militant’s release. As the crisis unfolds, he must balance the mission’s demands with the personal burden of his past.

title: Metro in Dino
plot: Several couples face crossroads in their relationships, with each story unfolding at a different stage of life. Their interconnected experiences explore the challenges of young love, long partnerships, and the search for connection as people navigate uncertainty and change.

title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
plot: Dora, Diego, and a group of new friends venture into the Amazon jungle to find the legendary treasure of Sol Dorado. Along the way, they face dangerous terrain, ancient puzzles, traps, and determined enemies while trying to protect the treasure from falling into the wrong hands.

title: The Old Guard 2
plot: An immortal warrior and her team reunite with renewed purpose when a powerful new foe threatens their mission to protect humanity. As the group confronts fresh dangers, the sequel expands its mythology and explores questions of loyalty, destiny, power, and the burdens of immortality.

title: Smurfs
plot: When a beloved leader is mysteriously captured by two evil wizards, a determined young Smurf leads her friends into the real world to rescue him. Along the way, they meet new allies, face magical dangers, and search for the truth about their destiny while trying to protect their entire universe.

title: Ice Road: Vengeance
plot: A big-rig driver travels to Nepal to scatter his brother’s ashes on Mount Everest. When a tour bus crossing dangerous high-altitude terrain is targeted by mercenaries, he and a mountain guide must protect the passengers and local villagers while fighting to survive.

title: Sorry, Baby
plot: A young literature professor remains in the New England home she once shared with her closest friend, who has since moved away and is expecting a baby. Years after a traumatic event, she struggles with isolation, anxiety, and the uneven process of finding a way forward.

title: Smoke
plot: An arson investigator reluctantly joins forces with a police detective to track two arsonists. As the investigation unfolds, buried trauma, strained relationships, and growing suspicions complicate their pursuit, turning the case into a tense psychological game.

title: Countdown
plot: After a Department of Homeland Security officer is killed in public, a detective joins a covert task force made up of undercover agents from across law enforcement. Their investigation into the murder reveals a larger threat, forcing the team into a race against time to protect a city of millions.

title: Ironheart
plot: After returning to Chicago, a young genius inventor pursues her ambitions with a new approach to building iron suits. As technology collides with magic, she becomes entangled with a mysterious, charming figure whose presence draws her into a dangerous world.

title: Heads of State
plot: A US president and UK prime minister set aside their public rivalry after becoming targets of a powerful enemy. Stranded during a dangerous international pursuit, they team up with an MI6 agent to survive, uncover a conspiracy, and protect the free world.

title: Trainwreck: Poop Cruise
plot: An engine fire strands thousands of passengers at sea without power, working plumbing, or many everyday comforts. Through interviews and archival footage, this brisk documentary explores the resulting discomfort, confusion, passenger reactions, crew efforts, media attention, and questions about cruise safety.

title: The Stranger in My Home
plot: A handsome stranger’s claim that a couple’s 15-year-old daughter was switched at birth sends their “perfect family” into chaos. As tensions rise, buried secrets come to light and turn a tense home situation into a relentless psychological unraveling.

title: My Mom Jayne
plot: A daughter who lost her famous mother as a young child explores the woman behind the public image. Through interviews with siblings and a longtime associate, plus photographs, letters, footage, and belongings from the family’s past, she pieces together a more intimate portrait while confronting her own unanswered questions about family and identity.

title: Maa
plot: A mother and daughter arrive in a rural village marked by the disappearance of girls. As a supernatural threat emerges from local mythology, the mother must confront terrifying forces and fight to protect her child.

title: Everything's Going to Be Great
plot: When an American family is unexpectedly forced to move in with an estranged relative, they have to adjust to big hopes, personal identity questions, and the pressure of regional theater life. The story plays out as a warmly observed family comedy focused on fitting in, coping, and staying connected.

title: The Waterfront
plot: A prominent North Carolina fishing family struggles to keep its failing business empire afloat as financial pressure mounts. Family loyalty, personal conflicts, and dangerous criminal connections pull them into increasingly risky choices, forcing them to confront how far they will go to protect their livelihood and remain together.

title: 28 Years Later
plot: Twenty-eight years after a devastating virus outbreak, a fortified island community remains cut off from the mainland. When a young boy crosses the causeway with his father and later ventures beyond the island with his ill mother, he encounters evolved infected, unusual survivors, and a world shaped by fear, loss, and survival.

title: The Traitors
plot: A group of contestants arrive with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.

title: Deep Cover
plot: An improv comedy teacher worried that her best days may be behind her is recruited by an undercover police officer for an unlikely assignment. With two students in tow, she must pose as a dangerous criminal while navigating London’s gangland and trying to keep their improvised act believable.

title: Materialists
plot: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker helps clients navigate modern dating while applying strict ideas about compatibility to her own life. When she becomes caught between a seemingly ideal partner and an imperfect former boyfriend, she must reconsider what she truly values in love.

title: Room to Move
plot: Choreographer and performer Jenn Freeman has always possessed the gift of movement. From a very early age, she simply had to dance… all the time. But with that ever-present need to jump, leap, shake and squirm came a struggle to exist harmoniously in a world that seemed to assault her senses and sense of equilibrium at every turn.

title: Oxy Morons
plot: After a smuggling job goes wrong, a shipping worker ends up owing money to a dangerous dealer. To pay it back, he exploits his day job by quietly siphoning prescription products from a major corporate supply chain, pulling him deeper into risky choices and mounting pressure.

title: Broke
plot: A bronc rider facing a fading rodeo career struggles with brain injury, family pressures, and the threat of a sudden blizzard. As survival becomes more urgent, he reflects on the choices, relationships, and disappointments that shaped his pursuit of a dream.

title: Trainwreck: The Astroworld Tragedy
plot: This documentary examines the 2021 Astroworld tragedy through interviews with survivors, paramedics, festival staff and other witnesses. It explores the chaotic conditions, safety concerns and aftermath surrounding the event, offering a sobering look at how a major music festival went terribly wrong.

title: Kryptic
plot: A woman sets out to find a missing cryptozoologist and is pulled into a strange, unsettling journey that blurs reality and self-perception. As clues lead her from place to place, the search turns inward, raising questions about identity, desire, and what might be lurking just beyond the ordinary world.

title: The Best You Can
plot: A polished New Yorker’s marriage is strained as her much older husband’s advancing age changes their relationship. Her carefully ordered life is further unsettled by the arrival of a sharp but underachieving security guard, leading to a warm, humorous story about connection, hope, and imperfect people.

title: The Survivors
plot: In a sleepy seaside town, the mysterious death of a young woman reopens painful questions about the loss of three young people fifteen years earlier. As the community confronts its buried past, old tensions and unanswered mysteries rise to the surface.

title: Wylde Pak
plot: Two half-siblings spend the summer adjusting to life together in a newly blended family. As their very different interests bring plenty of friction and fun, they also pitch in with a lively pet-grooming business and discover how to become closer.

title: Housefull 5
plot: A wealthy father’s will leaves his estate to his son, but several people claim to be the rightful heir. During a birthday celebration aboard a cruise ship, the chaotic comedy takes a mystery turn when a murder occurs and everyone becomes entangled in the confusion.

title: Ballerina
plot: Set during the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, a young woman begins training in the deadly traditions of the Ruska Roma. As she grows into a skilled assassin, she sets out on a dangerous mission of vengeance that puts her against powerful enemies.

title: 1000-lb Roomies
plot: Two lifelong friends confront serious health concerns when one commits to a major weight-loss journey, while the other remains uncertain about surgery. As they face changing routines, old habits and shifting boundaries, their bond is tested by the pressures of pursuing healthier lives together.

title: Stick
plot: After a career-ending meltdown, a former golf hopeful struggles to rebuild his life. He takes a risky chance mentoring a teenage prodigy, hoping to guide the young player toward greatness while finding a way to regain his own purpose.

title: The Life of Chuck
plot: As the world faces unsettling upheaval, a mysterious ordinary man becomes the focus of widespread messages of thanks. The story then moves backward through three stages of his life, exploring family, grief, love, creativity, and the small moments that give an existence its meaning.

title: Dilli Dark
plot: Michael Okeke, a Nigerian living in New Delhi wants to get his MBA and settle in India. But his part-time job as a drug dealer will jeopardize his plans, not to mention the open racism he is facing.

title: The Better Sister
plot: After a wealthy New York lawyer is murdered, his polished wife and her estranged sister are drawn into a tense investigation. As suspicion spreads through the family, their troubled history, complicated loyalties, and carefully guarded secrets begin to surface.

title: Dept. Q
plot: A brash but brilliant police officer is placed in charge of a new department dedicated to Edinburgh’s cold cases. Working with an unlikely team of misfits, he confronts difficult investigations while navigating tense relationships and the personal damage carried by those around him.

title: Adults
plot: A group of twenty-somethings in New York navigate friendship, romance, and the messy challenge of becoming responsible adults. As they try to be good people while still figuring themselves out, their everyday lives lead to awkward conflicts, shifting relationships, and unpredictable hijinks.

title: Hot Milk
plot: A young woman travels with her wheelchair-bound mother to a seaside town in Spain, where they seek help for the mother’s mysterious illness. As the daughter cares for her and meets an enigmatic traveler, she begins to question the role she has long held in their relationship and explore a life beyond it.

title: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
plot: This true-crime miniseries revisits the cyanide poisonings that turned an everyday medicine into a source of public fear. It examines competing theories, investigative choices, grieving families, and the search for a key suspect while exploring how the unsolved case changed consumer safety and public trust.

title: Pee-wee as Himself
plot: A two-part documentary portrait follows an imaginative artist from early influences and experimental performance work to the creation of an iconic alter ego and extraordinary public success. Through candid interviews and archival footage, it explores artistic ambition, privacy, personal struggles, and the complicated relationship between the performer and his famous character.

title: The Phoenician Scheme
plot: A wealthy businessman names his only daughter, a nun, as heir while launching an ambitious new enterprise. As they work through complicated business dealings, they face scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and repeated assassination attempts that put their uneasy partnership under pressure.

title: Fear Street: Prom Queen
plot: At a Shadyside High prom in 1988, an underdog competes for the crown while rival candidates begin disappearing. As the festivities turn deadly, she must navigate vicious social pressure and uncover what is happening before the threat reaches her.

title: Earnhardt
plot: This documentary series follows a working-class racing driver’s rise into a NASCAR icon and examines how fame, ambition, and success shaped his family life. Through interviews and archival footage, it explores his complicated personal legacy alongside the growth of stock-car racing.

title: Air Force Elite: Thunderbirds
plot: An elite demonstration team prepares for a demanding training season, revealing the discipline, trust and courage required to perform precise aerial maneuvers. Alongside the pilots, the documentary highlights the families, maintainers and support staff whose combined efforts help bring each public performance to life.

title: Mountainhead
plot: Four billionaire friends retreat to an extravagant mountain home while an international crisis unfolds around them. As tensions rise, their conversations expose clashing views on technology, power, morality, and the consequences of living far removed from ordinary people.

title: Motorheads
plot: After moving to a small town, twin siblings enter a high-school world where street racing and car culture shape social status. Alongside a loner and an outcast, they work to rebuild a legendary car while confronting the shadow of their family’s troubled past.

title: Fountain of Youth
plot: A treasure-hunting mastermind gathers a team for a globe-spanning search for the legendary Fountain of Youth. To survive rival threats and solve the mystery, he must recruit his estranged sister, a brilliant curator whose expertise may be essential to their dangerous adventure.

title: Bring Her Back
plot: After their father dies, a brother and sister enter foster care together, hoping to remain a family. Their new foster home initially seems safe, but its grieving mother begins playing unsettling mind games, and the siblings gradually realize that something deeply disturbing is hidden beneath their temporary refuge.

title: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
plot: After a passenger plane explodes over a Scottish town, killing 270 people, investigators face a vast and complex murder inquiry. The miniseries follows the painstaking work of Scottish police and international agencies as they gather evidence and pursue justice, while showing the tragedy’s lasting impact on local residents and the victims’ families.

title: Tucci in Italy
plot: A charismatic food host returns to Italy for a fresh round of culinary adventures, exploring regional dishes, local traditions, and the people behind them. Along the way, the series visits homes, workplaces, restaurants, and lesser-known corners of the country to reveal how food connects with culture and everyday life.

title: Lilo & Stitch
plot: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a mischievous alien who is hiding from authorities and mistakes him for a dog. As chaos follows, their unlikely friendship helps her and her older sister face grief, family pressures, and the challenge of keeping their home together.

title: Overcompensating
plot: A closeted former football player and homecoming king starts college determined to hide his sexuality and fit in. He becomes close friends with an outsider equally eager to belong, and together they navigate messy hookups, parties, fake IDs, and the pressures of performing a version of themselves for others.

title: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story
plot: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts examine the crimes of a notorious British couple and the investigation surrounding them. This miniseries explores the case through archival testimony and recorded evidence, presenting a disturbing true-crime account without fictionalized reconstruction.

title: American Manhunt: Osama Bin Laden
plot: This documentary miniseries follows the years-long international hunt for a notorious terrorist leader, from early intelligence efforts through repeated setbacks and mounting pressure. Rare footage and firsthand interviews with intelligence insiders trace how investigators pursued leads, weighed difficult choices, and prepared for the mission that brought the search to its decisive conclusion.

title: Hurry Up Tomorrow
plot: A musician struggling with insomnia is drawn into a strange nighttime journey after meeting an unpredictable stranger. As the hours unfold, the encounter pushes him to confront fame, distress, and unsettling questions about his own identity.

title: Bad Thoughts
plot: A sketch-comedy series presents a collection of disturbing, wildly exaggerated stories rooted in familiar everyday situations. Each scenario takes increasingly unexpected turns into crude, dark, and often shocking territory, testing how far viewers are willing to follow its twisted comic imagination.

title: Gram Chikitsalay
plot: An idealistic doctor takes charge of a neglected primary health centre in a North Indian village, determined to improve local healthcare. As he faces mistrust, limited resources, village politics, and unusual local personalities, the experience challenges his assumptions and gradually changes his view of service and community.

title: Long Way Home
plot: Two longtime friends set out on a motorcycle journey from Scotland to England, choosing a scenic route across 17 European countries. Riding classic bikes, they encounter changing landscapes, local communities, regional traditions, and the everyday challenges of traveling together over a long distance.

title: A Deadly American Marriage
plot: A chilling 911 call draws attention to a brutal death inside a quiet suburban home. Told through competing perspectives, this documentary examines the evidence, family relationships, abuse allegations, and the central question of whether the killing was murder or self-defense.

title: Friendship
plot: A lonely suburban husband becomes intensely invested in a new friendship with his charismatic neighbor. As their bond takes unexpected turns, his attempts to belong grow increasingly awkward and destructive, putting pressure on his marriage, family life, and sense of self.

title: Karate Kid: Legends
plot: After a family tragedy, a kung fu prodigy moves from Beijing to New York with his mother and struggles to adjust. When a new friend needs help, he enters a karate competition and trains with two mentors, learning to combine different fighting styles for a major showdown.

title: Toxic
plot: Elizabeth Chambers, the ex-wife of Armie Hammer, is aiming to get to the root of traumatic relationships, including her own. She draws from her experience and background as an investigative journalist to delve into the dark and twisted side of relationships. Through conversations with survivors from across the country, Chambers brings viewers into the raw and real stories of those affected by destructive relationship dynamics, showcasing the lasting trauma and tragedy that can result from unhealthy relationships.

title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
plot: Two outlaws face the dangers of the galactic underworld while trying to shape their own futures. Through separate, character-focused stories, the miniseries explores shifting loyalties, moral ambiguity, survival, and the choices that define life beyond the Republic and the Empire.

title: Electra
plot: A journalist and his female companion travel to interview a famous musician in Rome where a generous invite to a country estate becomes something much more than anyone expected.

title: Clown in a Cornfield
plot: A teenage girl and her father move to a struggling small town after a factory fire, hoping for a fresh start. As tensions between residents and younger locals grow, a sinister clown emerges from the cornfields, turning the community’s divisions into a violent survival battle.

title: The Four Seasons
plot: A decades-long friendship among three married couples is strained when one husband leaves his wife, disrupting their tradition of quarterly getaways. Across changing seasons, the friends navigate marriage, parenthood, divorce, personal challenges, and the difficult question of how a close-knit group can adapt when life no longer follows familiar routines.

title: Shadow Force
plot: Two former leaders of a multinational special forces unit break protocol after falling in love and disappear to protect their son. When a bounty draws their former allies into the hunt, the family must reunite and fight to survive while confronting the dangerous organization they left behind.

title: Turning Point: The Vietnam War
plot: This documentary miniseries examines the Vietnam War and its devastating consequences, tracing events from the Gulf of Tonkin incident through the fall of Saigon. It explores political decisions, military escalation, public disagreement, shifting perspectives, and the human cost of a conflict that reshaped lives and history.

title: Castle Impossible
plot: A determined couple takes on the restoration of a historic estate, facing tight budgets, bug infestations, rumored hidden treasure and a seemingly endless stream of projects. Together, they work to transform the property and protect a family legacy while navigating the challenges of renovation.

title: Havoc
plot: After a drug heist goes disastrously wrong, a jaded detective enters a corrupt city's criminal underworld to rescue a politician's son. Pursued by gangs, compromised officials, and relentless violence, he must fight through a night of chaos while trying to escape his own troubled past.

title: Étoile
plot: Two renowned ballet companies, one in New York and one in Paris, attempt to save their struggling institutions through a bold exchange of star performers. As dancers, artists, and administrators adjust to new surroundings, cultural clashes, creative ambition, and behind-the-scenes pressures shape this lively ensemble drama.

title: Jewel Thief: The Heist Begins
plot: A clever con artist plans an ambitious diamond heist while trying to stay ahead of a ruthless adversary. Their battle of strategy unfolds through high-stakes deception, danger, and shifting loyalties, with law enforcement and personal complications adding pressure to the elaborate scheme.

title: Until Dawn
plot: A young woman and her friends travel to a remote valley to investigate her sister’s disappearance. In an abandoned visitor center, they face a masked killer and other frightening threats, only to find themselves repeatedly returned to the start of the same night, searching for a way to escape.

title: The Accountant 2
plot: After an old acquaintance is murdered, a meticulous accountant is drawn into a dangerous investigation. He joins forces with his estranged, highly lethal brother and a determined government agent, uncovering a deadly conspiracy while a ruthless network of killers closes in around them.

title: Pangolin: Kulu's Journey
plot: A rescued baby pangolin is cared for around the clock as it gains strength and learns the skills needed for life in the wild. The documentary follows the challenges of rewilding while highlighting threats facing pangolins and people working to protect them.

title: On Swift Horses
plot: In 1950s America, a newly married woman’s carefully planned life is unsettled by her husband’s charismatic brother. As he pursues a risky new direction in Las Vegas, she begins gambling on racehorses and exploring a secret relationship, while both struggle to find freedom within restrictive social expectations.

title: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
plot: During World War II, an Australian army surgeon is captured and forced to work on the Burma Railway. Years later, celebrated as a national hero, he remains haunted by imprisonment, survivor’s guilt, and a forbidden pre-war love that continues to shape his life.

title: Ransom Canyon
plot: In a small Texas town, three ranching families struggle to protect their land, preserve their legacies, and navigate complicated relationships. As outside interests threaten the community, grief, romance, family conflict, and personal loyalties pull residents in competing directions.

title: #1 Happy Family USA
plot: An animated Muslim-American family navigates life in the early 2000s, learning to code-switch amid fear, war, cultural pressure, and the rapid rise of boy bands. Through absurd humor and family conflict, the series explores belonging, prejudice, identity, and the challenges of growing up in a changing America.

title: Oklahoma City Bombing: American Terror
plot: This documentary revisits the 1995 bombing of a federal building in Oklahoma City, examining the devastating human impact, the rescue effort, and the investigation that followed. Survivors, relatives, first responders, and investigators provide personal recollections while the film considers the extremist ideas and misinformation surrounding the attack.

title: The Stolen Girl
plot: A mother allows her daughter to attend an impromptu sleepover with a new friend after meeting the girl’s mother at an impressive home. When she returns the next day, the property is an empty luxury rental, and her daughter has been abducted.

title: Your Friends & Neighbors
plot: After a financial titan becomes divorced and jobless, he begins robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. What starts as an exhilarating way to cope draws him deeper into dangerous trouble within his own social circle.

title: Jaat
plot: A mysterious stranger arrives in a remote town ruled by a ruthless crime lord. After witnessing the suffering of its people, he takes on a violent mission to challenge the tyrant and restore justice, bringing old-school action, dramatic confrontations, and larger-than-life heroics to the conflict.

title: G20
plot: When terrorists seize control of a major international summit, a president must use her leadership skills and military experience to protect her family and fellow world leaders. The crisis forces her to navigate a dangerous attack while confronting threats inside a high-profile gathering.

title: Warfare
plot: A platoon of Navy SEALs takes up a position in a civilian home in Ramadi, Iraq, to support a larger operation. As a tense period of surveillance erupts into a chaotic siege, the soldiers struggle to protect one another and survive an increasingly dangerous situation.

title: The Amateur
plot: After his wife is killed in a terrorist attack, an introverted CIA decoder seeks justice when his superiors refuse to act. Lacking traditional combat skills, he relies on intelligence, surveillance, technology, and strategy to pursue those responsible while navigating dangerous espionage networks.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
plot: In a television first, Chief Eric Winstrom allows a film crew to capture the entire operation of the Grand Rapids Police Department. From twisted high-stakes homicide investigations to adrenaline-fueled patrol stories, nothing is off limits.

title: Drop
plot: A widowed mother goes on her first date in years at an upscale restaurant, hoping for a fresh start. When anonymous messages begin appearing on her phone, the evening turns into a tense struggle as she tries to understand who is targeting her and protect the people closest to her.

title: A Line of Fire
plot: A former FBI agent leaves his dangerous career behind to raise his two daughters after losing his wife. When the niece of his old partner asks for help, he is drawn back into a dangerous world of corruption, intrigue, and difficult choices.

title: Dying for Sex
plot: After receiving a life-changing cancer diagnosis, a woman leaves her marriage and begins exploring desires she has long kept hidden. Alongside her closest friend, she confronts intimacy, friendship, mortality, and the challenge of living more honestly while navigating the emotional consequences of her choices.

title: Last Swim
plot: It’s summer in London. On her final day of freedom, Ziba, a promising British-Iranian teen, leads her friends on an eventful journey, while secretly grappling with a life-changing decision.

title: Pulse
plot: A group of emergency-room residents face relentless medical crises and complicated personal relationships at a busy Miami hospital. When a divisive workplace allegation reshapes the department’s leadership, professional loyalties, friendships, and family ties come under pressure while the team struggles to keep patients alive.

title: Eden
plot: A group of disillusioned outsiders leave modern society to build a new life on a remote island. Their vision of paradise is tested by harsh conditions, dangerous wildlife, limited resources, and increasingly strained relationships as differing ambitions and personalities turn the community against itself.

title: Hell of a Summer
plot: A 24-year-old counselor returns to his beloved summer camp, where he struggles to connect with younger co-workers and feels out of place. When a masked killer begins targeting the camp community, the counselors must deal with fear, suspicion, and survival amid a playful take on classic camp slashers.

title: MobLand
plot: Two powerful crime families collide as tensions rise and loyalties are tested, putting their businesses and loved ones at risk. As the conflict escalates, a trusted fixer tries to keep the peace while navigating shifting alliances, pressure from all sides, and the brutal cost of holding an empire together.

title: Sikandar
plot: After a tragic accident, a powerful man turns his attention to protecting vulnerable people from corruption and greed. Driven by a strong sense of justice, he confronts influential forces and uses whatever methods he believes necessary to defend those who need help.

title: Day of Reckoning
plot: Put-upon lawman John Dorsey is on the verge of losing his wife and his job as sheriff, so he posses up with bullish U.S. Marshall Butch Hayden to hold outlaw Emily Rusk hostage. A battle of wills ensues as Emily turns the posse on themselves, but as her marauding husband and his gang approach, Emily and John realize they will need each other to survive.

title: The Friend
plot: A solitary New York writer inherits a massive Great Dane after the death of her closest friend and mentor. The dog brings eviction threats, damaged furniture, and unexpected responsibility, but as they slowly grow closer, she begins confronting grief, unresolved feelings, and her own stalled creative life.

title: The Ballad of Wallis Island
plot: A lonely lottery winner living on a remote island invites his favorite musicians to perform an exclusive concert at his home. When the former musical partners reunite, old feelings, regrets, and questions about the past surface during their unusual stay.

title: The Penguin Lessons
plot: In 1976 Argentina, a cynical English teacher arrives at a prestigious boarding school just as political unrest intensifies. After rescuing an oil-covered penguin, he forms an unlikely friendship that gradually renews his compassion and courage while tensions grow around the school and its community.

title: The Life List
plot: After her mother’s death, a young woman learns that completing a teenage bucket list is tied to her inheritance. Reluctantly taking on the challenge, she revisits old dreams, navigates family relationships, opens herself to romance, and begins discovering what she truly wants from life.

title: The Woman in the Yard
plot: After her husband’s death, a grieving mother struggles to care for her two children at their isolated rural home. Their fragile routine is disrupted when a mysterious woman appears in the yard and gradually draws closer, forcing the family to confront fear, grief, and unsettling secrets.

title: Million Dollar Secret
plot: In this cutthroat competition series, twelve contestants move into a lavish estate while one secretly holds a million dollars. The hidden millionaire must blend in, complete secret tasks for advantages, and avoid elimination as the others try to identify who has the money.

title: A Working Man
plot: A former black-ops operative leaves his violent past behind for a quiet life in construction. When his employer’s daughter is abducted by human traffickers, he begins a dangerous search that draws him into a much wider network of corruption and forces him back into action.

title: The Studio
plot: A newly appointed movie studio head and his executive team struggle to balance corporate pressure, creative ambitions, and their desire to keep filmmaking meaningful. As they navigate demanding artists, commercial expectations, and the unpredictable world of entertainment, their efforts create plenty of awkward and chaotic situations.

title: Livestream
plot: A stream unravels into real-life danger when a content creator's toxic fandom and parasocial obsession collide in a chilling test of online voyeurism.

title: Hollywood Demons
plot: This docuseries explores some of Hollywood’s darkest scandals through interviews with insiders, collaborators, and survivors. Across six documentaries, it focuses on abuse, exploitation, and the personal struggles behind public image.

title: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
plot: A daring performer travels around the world to meet people whose extraordinary abilities seem almost magical. Along the way, he explores distinctive cultures, learns demanding skills from these remarkable individuals, and tests his own limits through intense, real-world challenges.

title: This City Is Ours
plot: When an established crime boss steps back, a volatile struggle for control erupts between his reckless son and a trusted lieutenant. Set against Liverpool’s criminal underworld, the series follows fractured loyalties, family pressures, rival gangs, and the personal vulnerabilities beneath a violent fight for power.

title: Baida
plot: A former spy is drawn into the sinister world of a man who has defied time and death. As strange abilities and unanswered mysteries emerge, the spy must confront a dangerous supernatural threat in a story blending suspense, science fiction, and emotional drama.

title: Last One Laughing: UK
plot: A host challenges ten British comedians to spend hours together while trying not to laugh. They use jokes, impressions, physical comedy, and unexpected antics to make their opponents crack, with each contestant balancing creative attacks against the pressure to keep a straight face.

title: Happy Face
plot: A woman whose father is a notorious serial killer is drawn back into his orbit after years of separation. When he claims an imprisoned man may be innocent, she investigates the case while confronting the lasting effects of her family history and questioning who she is.

title: Good American Family
plot: A Midwestern couple adopts a young girl with dwarfism, believing they are offering her a new home. As unsettling behavior and conflicting accounts emerge, their confidence in the situation begins to fracture, drawing the family into a tense and emotionally difficult dispute over identity, responsibility, and whose version of events can be trusted.

title: The Alto Knights
plot: Two longtime friends and powerful New York crime bosses become rivals as they struggle over control, changing business opportunities, and their place in the city's underworld. Told through one man's recollections, the drama follows their uneasy relationship as loyalty, ambition, and betrayal push them toward a dangerous confrontation.

title: Snow White
plot: After a cruel queen takes control of the kingdom, a princess escapes into the woods and finds refuge with seven magical dwarves and a young bandit. Together, they face the queen’s pursuit while seeking a way to reclaim their home and restore hope to the land.

title: The Twister: Caught in the Storm
plot: A documentary revisits the devastating 2011 tornado that struck Joplin, Missouri, through firsthand accounts from survivors and footage recorded during the disaster. It focuses on the human impact, fear, loss, and resilience of a community facing an overwhelming natural event.

title: Death of a Unicorn
plot: A father and his teenage daughter accidentally strike a unicorn while traveling to a wealthy employer’s retreat. When the hosts discover the creature may possess extraordinary healing properties, their plans set off a strange, bloody confrontation involving greed, family tensions, and the unicorn’s protective parents.

title: A Murder in Oakland: Beauty Is Deadly
plot: A four-year-old cold case has been reopened in Oakland with new evidence, uncovering a dangerous web of crime, deception, and corruption. This thrilling mystery follows the relentless pursuit of justice as detectives dig deeper into a case that was thought to be long buried.

title: Dope Thief
plot: Two lifelong friends in Philadelphia pretend to be DEA agents while robbing small-time drug dealers. Their scheme takes a dangerous turn after they target the wrong operation, drawing the attention of a powerful narcotics enterprise and forcing them to navigate escalating threats, strained loyalties, and the consequences of their choices.

title: Black Bag
plot: When an intelligence agent is suspected of betraying the nation, her husband—also an elite operative—is assigned to investigate. Torn between professional duty and marital loyalty, he navigates a tense web of secrets, suspicion, and shifting allegiances within their close-knit intelligence circle.

title: Veer Hanuman - Bolo Bajrang Bali Ki Jai
plot: 'Veer Hanuman - Bolo Bajrang Bali Ki Jai' is an extraordinary tale of a young boy’s transformation into a divine hero. It is a journey filled with courage, innocence and self-discovery, highlighting how Hanuman overcame adversity to become the eternal protector of dharma.

title: Holland
plot: A teacher in Holland, Michigan, begins questioning the life she shares with her husband after she and a colleague grow suspicious of a secret. Their concerns draw her into a twisted story that challenges her understanding of the quiet world around her.

title: Plankton: The Movie
plot: A famously scheming underwater villain’s relationship with his sentient computer wife reaches a breaking point when she takes matters into her own hands and threatens Bikini Bottom. Their chaotic adventure blends absurd comedy, musical numbers, strange science, and an unexpectedly heartfelt look at a long-running partnership.

title: Dupahiya
plot: In a Bihar village proud of its long crime-free record, a wedding gift motorcycle disappears just days before a ceremony. The bride’s family and her former lover set out to recover it, triggering a comic mystery that touches on dowry, social expectations, and the hopes of ordinary people.

title: The Rule of Jenny Pen
plot: After a stroke leaves him dependent on others, a former judge enters a secluded care home and encounters a resident who terrorizes vulnerable patients with a sinister child’s puppet. Ignored by staff and limited by his condition, he must find the resolve to protect himself and those around him.

title: The Diplomat
plot: A diplomat at the Indian High Commission in Islamabad faces a tense humanitarian crisis when a mysterious woman arrives seeking protection and a return to India after claiming she was forced into marriage in Pakistan. As bureaucracy, politics, and strained international relations complicate matters, he must navigate a dangerous diplomatic situation.

title: Another Simple Favor
plot: Two former friends reunite on the glamorous Italian island of Capri for an extravagant wedding. Among lavish guests, sharp insults, and shifting loyalties, a murder plunges the celebration into a tangled mystery filled with betrayal, suspicious behavior, and outrageous turns.

title: Deli Boys
plot: After their wealthy father suddenly dies, two pampered brothers discover that his convenience-store empire concealed a criminal operation. Forced to navigate the dangerous underworld he left behind, they struggle to take control while confronting family expectations, cultural tensions, and their own very different personalities.

title: F*** Marry Kill
plot: After being encouraged to try dating apps, a true-crime enthusiast begins seeing three men while following a podcast about murders in her city. When clues suggest one of her dates may be the suspected killer, romance turns into a wary guessing game filled with awkward encounters and danger.

title: Picture This
plot: A single photographer running a struggling London studio is encouraged by her family to find a partner. After a spiritual prediction points to romance among her next five dates, she enters a chaotic, heartfelt search for love while navigating family expectations and her own uncertain path.

title: Jay & Pamela
plot: Follows a couple — both 3 feet and four inches tall — who share the same rare brittle bone disorder.

title: With Love, Meghan
plot: A lifestyle host welcomes friends and notable guests to a picturesque California estate, sharing approachable cooking, gardening, entertaining, and hosting ideas. The series blends simple recipes and homemade touches with conversations about creating a warm, joyful home and enjoying everyday moments.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
plot: A blind lawyer with heightened abilities seeks justice through a busy New York law firm, while a former mob boss pursues political power. As their hidden identities and shared history begin to surface, both are drawn toward an unavoidable confrontation that threatens to reshape their city.

title: Novocaine
plot: When a sheltered bank employee’s new romance is interrupted by a robbery and kidnapping, he sets out to rescue her. His inability to feel physical pain helps him withstand a dangerous pursuit, but his lack of experience makes every confrontation unpredictable and increasingly chaotic.

title: Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue
plot: After a small plane crashes in a remote Mexican jungle, nine strangers struggle to survive while waiting for help. When the survivors begin dying one by one, the remaining passengers must uncover who is responsible before the killer strikes again.

title: Nadaaniyan
plot: A privileged Delhi socialite hires a middle-class student to pretend to be her boyfriend so she can protect her social standing. As their arrangement continues, the act becomes increasingly complicated when real feelings begin to emerge between them.

title: Crazxy
plot: A renowned surgeon carrying a large cash payment receives a chilling call: his teenage daughter has been kidnapped, and the ransom matches the money in his possession. As he races against time, he must navigate cryptic instructions, personal guilt, and mounting pressure while questioning whether the kidnapping is genuine or part of a larger trap.

title: Cold Wallet
plot: After losing everything in a cryptocurrency scam, a ragtag team of Redditors attempt to kidnap the kingpin who screwed them over.

title: The Accidental Getaway Driver
plot: During a routine pickup, an elderly Vietnamese cab driver is taken hostage by three recently escaped Orange County convicts. Based on a true story.

title: Mickey 17
plot: A desperate misfit accepts dangerous work on an off-world colony, where dying is treated as part of the job and a new version can be printed afterward. When an unexpected complication disrupts that routine, he must navigate questions of identity, survival, exploitation, and humanity’s uneasy encounter with an alien world.

title: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
plot: This three-part documentary examines the rise and collapse of a popular family-vlogging channel after its mother is arrested for child abuse. Using archived videos and interviews, it explores how a carefully presented image of family happiness gave way to control, exploitation, and a disturbing breakdown within the household.

title: Running Point
plot: A former party girl is unexpectedly placed in charge of her family’s professional basketball team. As she tries to prove herself in a demanding business, she must navigate family tensions, workplace challenges, and the expectations of a largely male environment.

title: House of David
plot: A gifted but unlikely teenager is chosen for a remarkable future as a powerful king rises and begins to falter under the weight of pride. Set amid faith, family tensions, political struggle, and battles, the series dramatizes a biblical story while expanding its lesser-known details for television.

title: In the Lost Lands
plot: A queen sends a feared sorceress into the ghostly wilderness of the Lost Lands to seek a magical power. Accompanied by a drifter, she must survive hostile forces, deadly creatures, and demons while pursuing her dangerous quest.

title: The Electric State
plot: In a retro-futuristic world shaped by conflict between humans and robots, an orphaned teen travels across a ruined landscape with a mysterious robot. Along the way, she joins forces with a smuggler and his wisecracking companion while searching for her long-lost brother.

title: The Americas
plot: A sweeping nature miniseries explores the remarkable wildlife, landscapes, and hidden wonders of North, Central, and South America. It celebrates the beauty and fragility of these ecosystems through rare animal behavior, dramatic environments, and stories about the challenges creatures face in the wild.

title: A Thousand Blows
plot: Two friends from Jamaica are drawn into the criminal underworld of 1880s London, where bare-knuckle fighting offers a path to survival. Their lives become entangled with a powerful female gang leader and a feared boxing boss, setting them on opposing sides of the East End’s dangerous underworld.

title: The Unbreakable Boy
plot: A family faces an uncertain future after learning that their son is autistic and has brittle bone disease. As his father’s faith grows and the boy’s remarkable spirit shines through, they discover joy, gratitude, and courage while navigating difficult circumstances together.

title: Win or Lose
plot: As a championship game approaches, eight people connected to a youth sports team face unexpected challenges away from the field. Their personal struggles, relationships, and differing perspectives shape how they handle the pressure of the big game.

title: Court of Gold
plot: This sports docuseries follows leading men's basketball teams as they prepare for and compete at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris. Alongside intense games and medal ambitions, it offers behind-the-scenes access, personal perspectives, and a look at basketball's history and international growth.

title: Jaadu Teri Nazar - Daayan Ka Mausam
plot: He is a Daavansh who holds keys to Daayan’s immortality! She’s Rewavanshi, the chosen one. Meant to be enemies, what happens when they fall in love?

title: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
plot: A county coroner reopens an investigation after thousands of bones are discovered near a former estate. Using modern DNA technology, he and his team work to identify the remains and provide answers for families, while examining questions about missing evidence, possible accomplices, and a witness whose account changes over time.

title: American Murder: Gabby Petito
plot: This three-part true-crime miniseries examines the disappearance and murder of a young woman during a cross-country van trip with her fiancé. Through personal footage, interviews, police recordings, and social media, it traces the investigation while considering domestic violence, media attention, and the warning signs surrounding the relationship.

title: Chhaava
plot: After a powerful ruler’s death, his son takes charge of the Maratha resistance against the Mughal forces led by a determined emperor. As battles, political intrigue, and shifting loyalties intensify, the young leader faces mounting pressure while fighting to protect his people and preserve his kingdom.

title: Dhoom Dhaam
plot: On their wedding night, an unlikely newlywed couple is pulled into a frantic chase involving goons, cops, and a mysterious person known as Charlie. As they race through a series of chaotic encounters, their clashing personalities create awkward, funny, and occasionally romantic situations.

title: The Gorge
plot: Two highly trained operatives are assigned to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge, communicating only from a distance. As an evil presence emerges from below, their growing connection is tested when they must work together to survive the dangers within.

title: My Fault: London
plot: An 18-year-old moves from America to London with her mother, who is starting a new life with a wealthy businessman. There, she meets his rebellious son and finds herself drawn into an intense romance while adapting to her unfamiliar surroundings and confronting painful parts of her past.

title: La Dolce Villa
plot: When a successful businessman travels to Tuscany to stop his daughter from buying a crumbling villa, he becomes drawn into restoring the property and connecting with the local community. Along the way, the trip encourages him to reconsider family, romance, success, and the life he truly wants.

title: Surviving Black Hawk Down
plot: This miniseries revisits the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu through detailed firsthand accounts from American soldiers, Somali fighters, civilians, and a cameraman who recorded the conflict. It examines the chaos, courage, sacrifice, and human cost surrounding a mission that left troops trapped in a hostile city after helicopters were downed.

title: The Witcher: Sirens of the Deep
plot: When human sailors come under attack from mysterious sea creatures, a conflict between land and sea threatens to escalate. A monster hunter is drawn into the danger and must seek a way to prevent war while navigating tense relationships, dangerous battles, and a world of moral uncertainty.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar
plot: Two young women build public identities around wellness remedies and personal illness, drawing vulnerable people into their orbit. As their stories gain attention online, the miniseries examines deception, desperation, health misinformation, and the consequences of trusting charismatic influencers over qualified medical advice.

title: Heart Eyes
plot: When a masked killer targeting couples appears in Seattle on Valentine's Day, two co-workers are mistaken for a romantic pair and become targets. Forced to flee together through a dangerous night, they must navigate their uneasy partnership while trying to survive the killer's pursuit.

title: Becoming Led Zeppelin
plot: This documentary follows four British musicians through their early careers in the 1960s, from small clubs and session work to a defining rehearsal in 1968. Featuring personal reflections, archival material, and performances, it explores how their influences and ambitions came together to create a groundbreaking rock band.

title: Kinda Pregnant
plot: When a woman's plans to settle down and start a family fall apart, she wears a fake baby bump and tells a lie. Her deception leads to an unexpected romance, while she navigates the awkward attention and complications that come with pretending to be pregnant.

title: Deva
plot: After a ruthless police officer loses his memory in an accident, he must secretly reinvestigate a murder case he had already solved. With only one trusted senior officer aware of his condition, he pieces together clues while hiding his memory loss from everyone else.

title: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson
plot: This documentary series revisits a shocking double-murder case, the nationwide manhunt that followed, and the trial that became a cultural phenomenon. Through interviews and archival material, it examines the investigation, courtroom battle, racial tensions, media frenzy, and lasting impact on those connected to it.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
plot: A teenage Peter Parker is beginning his journey toward becoming a hero, but this version of his path takes unexpected turns. Alongside the challenges of school and everyday life, he must learn what it means to use his emerging abilities responsibly.

title: Enigma
plot: Two legends contested their identities as women in the court of public opinion: April Ashley, who was immortalized as a trailblazer by embracing her transgender history; and Amanda Lear, who has consciously denied and obfuscated her history for decades. Their divergent paths reveal disparate but intertwined legacies.

title: Ms. Rachel
plot: Come learn, play, sing and grow with Ms. Rachel in a fun series of interactive lessons teaching letters, numbers, colors, shapes — and so much more!

title: Paradise
plot: In a serene, wealthy community sheltering some of the world’s most prominent people, a shocking murder disrupts daily life. As a high-stakes investigation begins, political tensions, hidden questions, and uncertainty about the community’s origins draw residents and investigators deeper into a dangerous mystery.

title: Selena y Los Dinos
plot: Archival footage and intimate interviews explore the life, music, cultural impact, and lasting legacy of an iconic Mexican American singer and her family band. The documentary offers a personal look at her journey, background, and the moments that shaped her artistry and connection with devoted fans.

title: Sky Force
plot: During the 1965 Indo-Pak War, a devastating attack prompts an Indian commander to lead a retaliatory mission. When a pilot disappears after a daring solo encounter, the commander spends decades seeking answers and confronting the possibility that the truth was deliberately hidden.

title: Dog Man
plot: After a police dog and his officer owner are injured on the job, an unusual surgery combines them into one crime-fighting hero. As he adjusts to his new identity and tries to earn his chief’s approval, he faces a feline supervillain whose latest schemes threaten the city.

title: Sly Lives! (aka the Burden of Black Genius)
plot: This documentary traces the rise, cultural impact, and lasting musical legacy of a groundbreaking multiracial, multigender band. Through archival footage and interviews, it explores their innovative sound, extraordinary success, and the pressures placed on Black artists navigating fame, expectation, and personal struggles.

title: The Thundermans: Undercover
plot: Two superhero twins head to a seaside town to investigate a growing threat while helping their younger sister develop her powers. When suspicious activity at a local school draws them deeper into the mission, the siblings must remain undercover and navigate family responsibilities, new friendships, and rising danger.

title: Companion
plot: During a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside estate, a group of friends becomes caught in a dangerous tangle of secrets, deception, and advanced technology. As tensions rise and trust collapses, unsettling truths about control, relationships, and personal freedom emerge.

title: Flight Risk
plot: A pilot flies a U.S. Marshal and a government witness across the Alaskan wilderness toward a New York trial. When trust begins to fracture inside the small aircraft, the journey becomes a claustrophobic struggle involving danger, suspicion, and shifting loyalties.

title: The Hunting Party
plot: A small team of investigators is tasked with tracking down exceptionally dangerous killers who have escaped from a secret prison. As each fugitive is pursued, the team confronts new threats while working to understand how such a breach could happen.

title: Molly-Mae: Behind It All
plot: Go beyond the headlines to uncover the real Molly-Mae, following her journey after her highly publicised break-up and adapting to the challenges of motherhood, all while preparing to launch her biggest business venture to date: ‘Maebe’.

title: Robogobo
plot: Five adorable adopted pets are given super-powered Robo-Suits by kid inventor Dax, then going on a mission to save other pets in trouble and learning how to become a family in the process.

title: Wish You Were Here
plot: Charlotte finds herself in a rut, searching for a spark that seems just out of reach. After she has a whirlwind night of romance and imagining a future with a man named Adam, he ghosts her. When Charlotte finally discovers that Adam is terminally ill, she helps him spend his last days living life to the fullest.

title: One of Them Days
plot: Two best friends and roommates face eviction after one of them discovers the rent money is gone. With only hours to solve the crisis, they race across Los Angeles through a string of chaotic misadventures, testing their resourcefulness, resilience, and friendship along the way.

title: Star Trek: Section 31
plot: A former emperor joins a covert Starfleet division charged with protecting the Federation. As the team pursues a dangerous threat, she must confront the consequences of her past while working alongside a group of unconventional operatives.

title: An Update on Our Family
plot: Myka and James Stauffer were the picture of the 21st century American Dream: happy marriage, beautiful kids, and a self-built YouTube vlogging empire. At the center of it all was Huxley, an adorable young boy they adopted from China. Huxley was more than just their star — he was their son. Until one day, he wasn’t.

title: Back in Action
plot: Years after leaving the CIA to raise a family, two former elite spies are pulled back into espionage when their cover is exposed. Forced to balance dangerous missions with family responsibilities, they face globe-trotting action, quirky humor, and the challenges of returning to a life they left behind.

title: Wolf Man
plot: A troubled couple takes their daughter to a remote childhood farmhouse in rural Oregon, hoping to reconnect away from the city. After an unseen animal attacks them, they barricade themselves inside while danger circles outside—and one family member begins undergoing a frightening, unnatural transformation.

title: Baylen Out Loud
plot: This reality series follows a young woman living with Tourette Syndrome as she navigates everyday challenges, independence, relationships, and family life. With support from her loved ones, she faces difficult moments with honesty, humor, resilience, and a willingness to share her experiences with viewers.

title: The Curious Case of...
plot: Take a deep dive into real-life scandals, exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Beth Karas, each gripping story uncovers deceit, greed, and manipulation, proving truth is far more chilling than fiction.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
plot: A young sailor is wrongly imprisoned after betrayal derails his future. After escaping and discovering hidden treasure, he returns under a new identity as a wealthy count, carefully pursuing those who wronged him while confronting the personal cost of revenge.

title: American Primeval
plot: A mother and her young son flee their past across the unforgiving American West, where they encounter a solitary outsider and form an uneasy found family. As they navigate a lawless frontier shaped by violence, belief, and competing claims for power, survival becomes their only certainty.

title: The Pitt
plot: Staff at an overcrowded, underfunded Pittsburgh emergency department work through demanding shifts as they try to save lives. The series follows the urgency of emergency medicine while highlighting the humanity, skill, pressure, and mishaps behind each case.

title: On Call
plot: A veteran training officer and her rookie ride-along patrol Long Beach while navigating difficult calls, department politics, and the aftermath of losing a fellow officer. Their developing partnership brings them into contact with the pressures, conflicts, and everyday realities of modern policing.

title: Den of Thieves: Pantera
plot: A determined former detective tracks a skilled thief to Europe, where the thief is drawn into the dangerous world of diamond robbers and a powerful crime syndicate. Their uneasy alliance takes shape around an ambitious plan to steal from the world’s largest diamond exchange, bringing shifting loyalties, elaborate preparation, and high-stakes danger.

title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
plot: Two very different teenagers meet by chance during the winter of their senior year. Across four days together, spaced throughout the changing seasons, they form a meaningful connection that challenges their plans and shapes how they see the future.

title: Babygirl
plot: A powerful chief executive risks her career and family when she begins a secret affair with a much younger intern. Their relationship explores desire, control, and the uneasy collision between professional authority, private fantasies, and everyday responsibilities.

title: Nosferatu
plot: A haunted young woman becomes the focus of a terrifying vampire’s obsession, while her husband’s journey to meet the mysterious count unleashes a spreading supernatural threat. As dread closes in around their community, loved ones and outsiders search for answers amid plague, possession, and mounting horror.

title: Beast Games
plot: One thousand contestants enter a massive competition where they face group decisions, physical challenges, luck-based tests, and difficult choices for a life-changing cash prize. Along the way, they can also compete for extraordinary rewards, including a private island, luxury cars, and additional money.

title: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
plot: A well-meaning inventor creates a smart garden gnome to make life easier, but his loyal dog worries that the invention has become too independent. When sinister forces exploit the technology, the dog must protect his friend and stop the growing chaos before everything spirals further out of control.

title: Dexter: Original Sin
plot: In 1991 Miami, a young forensic intern struggles to control his violent urges while beginning his transformation into an avenging killer. Guided by his father, he develops a strict code and tries to target dangerous people without drawing attention from his new colleagues at the police department.

title: The Last Showgirl
plot: When a long-running Las Vegas revue announces its closure, a veteran showgirl faces an uncertain future. As she searches for another opportunity, she must reckon with the choices and sacrifices that shaped her life, while trying to reconnect with her estranged daughter and rely on a close friend from the same fading world.

title: Paris & Nicole: The Encore
plot: More than 20 years since OG reality icons Paris Hilton and Nicole Richie first took the world by storm, the life-long friends reunite in a new special. Follow the dynamic duo as they try to produce a once-in-a-lifetime operatic performance based on their self-coined phrase, "Sanasa."

title: No Good Deed
plot: The sale of a picture-perfect Los Angeles home brings several hopeful buyers together while forcing its owners to confront painful family secrets. As competing couples reveal hidden troubles and personal motives, the property becomes the center of a darkly comic mystery filled with tension, tangled relationships, and shifting suspicions.

title: Mary
plot: A young woman accepts a miraculous pregnancy while facing fear, social pressure, and a ruthless king determined to eliminate a perceived threat. As danger closes in, she and her protector struggle to survive and bring her child safely into the world.

title: Dream Productions
plot: As Riley grows up, her Core Emotions send her memories to a dream-making department for extra processing. Inside this imaginative studio, a team works to create dreams that can help Riley handle new experiences, while navigating creative disagreements and the changing needs of a young mind.

title: Dirty Angels
plot: During the 2021 U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, a team of female soldiers disguises itself as medical relief workers to rescue kidnapped teenagers caught between ISIS and the Taliban. Their mission unfolds amid a dangerous conflict, forcing the team to rely on teamwork, courage, and combat skills.

title: Richard Ramirez: The Night Stalker Tapes
plot: Nearly 40 years after his summertime reign of terror on the streets of Los Angeles, the myth of the "Night Stalker" still looms large. Now, a series of prison recordings of Richard Ramirez unearths new truths

title: The Sticky
plot: A determined maple syrup farmer facing financial and bureaucratic pressure joins forces with an awkward warehouse guard and a low-level mobster. Together, they attempt an ambitious theft that brings danger, comic complications, and unexpected challenges to their rural Quebec community.

title: Y2K
plot: On New Year’s Eve 1999, two socially awkward high school friends leave their quiet plans to attend a party before the millennium arrives. When household electronics turn dangerously hostile at midnight, they join forces with other teenagers to survive a bizarre technological uprising.

title: Agni
plot: As Mumbai faces a growing series of mysterious fires, a dedicated fireman and his policeman brother-in-law must overcome personal tensions and work together. Their urgent investigation uncovers a dangerous pattern, while the firefighters confront exhausting risks, limited recognition, and the responsibility of protecting the city.

title: Unstoppable
plot: A determined young wrestler born with one leg pursues a place on a top college team, backed by his devoted mother and supportive coaches. Facing demanding competition, family difficulties, and intense physical and mental challenges, he must summon extraordinary discipline and resilience to chase his dream of becoming an NCAA champion.

title: Nightbitch
plot: A former artist now caring for a toddler in the suburbs feels isolated, exhausted, and increasingly disconnected from her old identity. As strange physical and behavioral changes emerge, she begins confronting the feral instincts, frustrations, and complicated emotions that can accompany motherhood.

title: Jentry Chau vs. The Underworld
plot: As her 16th birthday nears, a teenager discovers that the fiery powers she has long suppressed are returning. She must face supernatural threats while trying to navigate the challenges of high school and understand more about her unusual abilities.

title: The Order
plot: A veteran federal agent investigates a string of violent robberies in the Pacific Northwest and uncovers a white supremacist group planning an armed challenge to the federal government. Working with a local police officer, he follows a dangerous trail through rural communities, extremist recruitment, and escalating crimes.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
plot: When a vengeful lord launches a sudden attack, a king and his people retreat to an ancient stronghold for a desperate last stand. His independent-minded daughter becomes central to the struggle as the defenders face war, harsh winter, divided loyalties, and the threat of losing their home.

title: Skeleton Crew
plot: Four ordinary children accidentally leave their sheltered home planet and become lost in the wider Star Wars galaxy. With danger, pirates, unfamiliar worlds, and an uncertain guide ahead, they must rely on one another as they search for a way home.

title: The Agency
plot: A covert operative is ordered to leave an undercover life and return to a London station. When a former lover reappears, renewed feelings complicate his loyalty, identity, and mission, drawing them into a dangerous world of international espionage and divided allegiances.

title: Heartbeats: Pyaar aur Armaan
plot: Heartbeats is a hospital drama that follows Akshat as he pursues his dream of becoming a neurosurgeon while navigating a budding romance with Sanjh, a "nepo kid" from a family of doctors.

title: Caddo Lake
plot: When a young girl disappears from a remote lake, a grieving young man and a troubled teenager are drawn into a mystery involving old deaths, disappearances, and their fractured family histories. As the investigation unfolds, the isolated wetlands reveal connections that challenge what they think they know.
